4.180.s:
.. yudhiṣṭhira uvāca .. ..
bhagavankṣatriyaiḥ śūraiḥ svavīryopāttasaṃcayaiḥ ..
kāni dānāni deyāni pavitrāṇi śubhāni ca .. 1 ..
4.180.d:
॥ युधिष्ठिर उवाच ॥ ॥
भगवन्क्षत्रियैः शूरैः स्ववीर्योपात्तसंचयैः ॥
कानि दानानि देयानि पवित्राणि शुभानि च ॥ 1 ॥
4.180.m: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / O Blessed One, by heroic kṣatriyas who have accumulated wealth through their own valor, / what pure and auspicious gifts should be given?

4.180.s:
anyairvā puruṣaiḥ kṛṣṇa adharmabhayabhīrubhiḥ ..
grahapīḍāṅisaṃtaptairduḥsvapnādyupatāpitaiḥ .. 2 ..
4.180.d:
अन्यैर्वा पुरुषैः कृष्ण अधर्मभयभीरुभिः ॥
ग्रहपीडाङिसंतप्तैर्दुःस्वप्नाद्युपतापितैः ॥ 2 ॥
4.180.m: Or by other men, O Kṛṣṇa, who are fearful of the dread of unrighteousness, / afflicted by the torment of the planets, and tormented by bad dreams and the like—

4.180.s:
iha loke pare caiva vihitaṃ sarvakāmadam ..
viśeṣavihitaṃ dānaṃ kathayasva mahāmate .. 3 ..
4.180.d:
इह लोके परे चैव विहितं सर्वकामदम् ॥
विशेषविहितं दानं कथयस्व महामते ॥ 3 ॥
4.180.m: prescribed in this world and the next, granting all desires, / tell me, O wise one, the specially ordained gift.

4.180.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
śṛṇu bhūpāla bhadraṃ te dānadharmamanuttamam ..
viśeṣeṇa mahīpānāṃ hitāya ca na saṃśayaḥ .. 4 ..
4.180.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
शृणु भूपाल भद्रं ते दानधर्ममनुत्तमम् ॥
विशेषेण महीपानां हिताय च न संशयः ॥ 4 ॥
4.180.m: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / Hear, O king—may you have good fortune—the unsurpassed virtue of gifts, / especially for the benefit of kings, beyond doubt.

4.180.s:
dānāni bahurūpāṇi nānāśāstroditāni ca ..
godānādīni rājendra pradhānāni na saṃśayaḥ .. 5 ..
4.180.d:
दानानि बहुरूपाणि नानाशास्त्रोदितानि च ॥
गोदानादीनि राजेन्द्र प्रधानानि न संशयः ॥ 5 ॥
4.180.m: Gifts are manifold, spoken of in various treatises; / the gifts of cattle and the like, O best of kings, are foremost, without doubt.

4.180.s:
kiṃ tu pradhānamekaṃ te dānaṃ vakṣyāmi bhārata ..
vairocanāya yatsarvaṃ śukraḥ provāca bhārata .. 6 ..
4.180.d:
किं तु प्रधानमेकं ते दानं वक्ष्यामि भारत ॥
वैरोचनाय यत्सर्वं शुक्रः प्रोवाच भारत ॥ 6 ॥
4.180.m: However, I shall tell you of one foremost gift, O Bhārata, / which Śukra declared in full to the son of Virocana, O Bhārata.

4.180.s:
.. śukra uvāca .. ..
śṛṇu daityapate dānaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam ..
ādhayo vyādhayaścaiva grahapīḍā sudāruṇāḥ .. 7 ..
4.180.d:
॥ शुक्र उवाच ॥ ॥
शृणु दैत्यपते दानं सर्वपापप्रणाशनम् ॥
आधयो व्याधयश्चैव ग्रहपीडा सुदारुणाः ॥ 7 ॥
4.180.m: Śukra said: / Hear, O lord of the Daityas, the gift that destroys all sins, / mental agonies, physical diseases, and very dreadful afflictions of the planets,

4.180.s:
yena dattena naśyaṃti puṇyamāpnoti cottamam ..
kārttikyāmayane caiva grahaṇe śaśisūryayoḥ .. .. 8 ..
4.180.d:
येन दत्तेन नश्यंति पुण्यमाप्नोति चोत्तमम् ॥
कार्त्तिक्यामयने चैव ग्रहणे शशिसूर्ययोः ॥ ॥ 8 ॥
4.180.m: by giving which they are destroyed, and one obtains the highest merit. / On the full moon of Kārttika, at a solstice, and during an eclipse of the moon or the sun,

4.180.s:
dānametatpradātavyaṃ viṣuve sūryasaṃkrame ..
puṇyaṃ dinamathāsādya jitakrodho jiteṃdriyaḥ .. 9 ..
4.180.d:
दानमेतत्प्रदातव्यं विषुवे सूर्यसंक्रमे ॥
पुण्यं दिनमथासाद्य जितक्रोधो जितेंद्रियः ॥ 9 ॥
4.180.m: at an equinox, or during a solar transit, this gift should be given. / Having reached an auspicious day, having conquered anger and subdued the senses,

4.180.s:
saṃsthāpya dārujaṃ divyaṃ hemapaṭṭairalaṃkṛtam ..
rathaṃ sucakrākṣadharaṃ yugayoktrasamanvitam .. 4.180.10 ..
4.180.d:
संस्थाप्य दारुजं दिव्यं हेमपट्टैरलंकृतम् ॥
रथं सुचक्राक्षधरं युगयोक्त्रसमन्वितम् ॥ 4.180.10 ॥
4.180.m: having set up a divine wooden chariot adorned with golden fillets, / bearing fine wheels and axles, fitted with a yoke and traces,

4.180.s:
suvarṇadhvajasaṃyuktaṃ sitāsitapatākinam ..
puṣpaprakarasaṃkīrṇe prāgudakpravaṇe śubhe .. 11 ..
4.180.d:
सुवर्णध्वजसंयुक्तं सितासितपताकिनम् ॥
पुष्पप्रकरसंकीर्णे प्रागुदक्प्रवणे शुभे ॥ 11 ॥
4.180.m: endowed with a golden banner and white and dark pennants, / on an auspicious ground strewn with heaps of flowers, sloping to the east or north,

4.180.s:
nadyāstīre'tha vā goṣṭhe vicitre vā gṛhāṃgaṇe ..
rathasya pūrvabhāge tu kṛtvā vedīmanuttamām .. 12 ..
4.180.d:
नद्यास्तीरेऽथ वा गोष्ठे विचित्रे वा गृहांगणे ॥
रथस्य पूर्वभागे तु कृत्वा वेदीमनुत्तमाम् ॥ 12 ॥
4.180.m: on the bank of a river, or in a cow-pen, or in a wonderful house courtyard, / having constructed an excellent altar in the eastern part of the chariot,

4.180.s:
purāṇavedavidyāvānvinayācārasaṃyutaḥ ..
tasyāṃ saṃsthāpayeddevānbrahmādīnkathayāmi te .. 13 ..
4.180.d:
पुराणवेदविद्यावान्विनयाचारसंयुतः ॥
तस्यां संस्थापयेद्देवान्ब्रह्मादीन्कथयामि ते ॥ 13 ॥
4.180.m: one learned in the Purāṇas and Vedas, endowed with modesty and proper conduct, / should install upon it the gods, beginning with Brahmā, whom I shall describe to you.

4.180.s:
madhye brahmā pratiṣṭhāpyaḥ pūjayetpraṇavena tam ..
viṣṇuruttarataḥ sthāpyaḥ pauruṣeṇa tamarcayet .. 14 ..
4.180.d:
मध्ये ब्रह्मा प्रतिष्ठाप्यः पूजयेत्प्रणवेन तम् ॥
विष्णुरुत्तरतः स्थाप्यः पौरुषेण तमर्चयेत् ॥ 14 ॥
4.180.m: Brahmā is to be established in the middle; one should worship him with the Praṇava. / Viṣṇu is to be placed to the north; one should worship him with the Puruṣasūkta.

4.180.s:
sūktena rudraṃ raudreṇa dakṣiṇasyāṃ samarcayet ..
grahānsūryamukhāṃścaiva vidhivatpūjayettathā ..
puṣpairgaṃdhaiḥ phalairbhakṣyairdīpamālābhireva ca .. 15 ..
4.180.d:
सूक्तेन रुद्रं रौद्रेण दक्षिणस्यां समर्चयेत् ॥
ग्रहान्सूर्यमुखांश्चैव विधिवत्पूजयेत्तथा ॥
पुष्पैर्गंधैः फलैर्भक्ष्यैर्दीपमालाभिरेव च ॥ 15 ॥
4.180.m: One should worship Rudra in the south with the Raudra hymn. / And one should also worship the planets headed by the Sun according to the rules, / with flowers, perfumes, fruits, sweetmeats, and rows of lamps;

4.180.s:
pūjayedgaṃdhakusumaiḥ śvetavastraiḥ sacaṃdanaiḥ ..
śaṃkhabherīmṛdaṃgānāṃ śabdaiḥ sarvatragāmibhiḥ .. 16 ..
4.180.d:
पूजयेद्गंधकुसुमैः श्वेतवस्त्रैः सचंदनैः ॥
शंखभेरीमृदंगानां शब्दैः सर्वत्रगामिभिः ॥ 16 ॥
4.180.m: one should worship with fragrant flowers, white clothes, and sandalwood paste. / With the sounds of conches, kettle-drums, and mṛdaṅgas spreading everywhere,

4.180.s:
brahmaghoṣavimiśraiśca kārayeta mahotsavam ..
kuṃḍaṃ kṛtvā vidhānena hastamātrapramāṇataḥ .. 17 ..
4.180.d:
ब्रह्मघोषविमिश्रैश्च कारयेत महोत्सवम् ॥
कुंडं कृत्वा विधानेन हस्तमात्रप्रमाणतः ॥ 17 ॥
4.180.m: and mingled with the chanting of the Veda, he should cause a great festival to take place. / Having made a sacrificial pit according to the rules, one cubit in size,

4.180.s:
āgneyyāṃ diśi rājeṃdra brāhmaṇāṃstatra pūjayet ..
catuścāraṇikānviprānpūjitānbrahmabhūṣaṇaiḥ .. 18 ..
4.180.d:
आग्नेय्यां दिशि राजेंद्र ब्राह्मणांस्तत्र पूजयेत् ॥
चतुश्चारणिकान्विप्रान्पूजितान्ब्रह्मभूषणैः ॥ 18 ॥
4.180.m: in the south-eastern direction, O best of kings, he should worship the brāhmaṇas there. / Four brāhmaṇas [or] wandering ascetics, honored with ornaments worthy of Brahmā,

4.180.s:
caturoṣṭau mahārāja gurureko'thavā bhavet ..
homopakaraṇaṃ sarvaṃ melayitvā tilānghṛtam .. 19 ..
4.180.d:
चतुरोष्टौ महाराज गुरुरेकोऽथवा भवेत् ॥
होमोपकरणं सर्वं मेलयित्वा तिलान्घृतम् ॥ 19 ॥
4.180.m: there should be four, [or] eight, O great king, or there may be one preceptor. / Having gathered all the oblational equipment, sesame seeds, and clarified butter,

4.180.s:
agnikāryaṃ tataḥ kuryādyathāvadvidhipūrvakam ..
āghārāvājyabhāgau tu hutvā prāgvacca tau tataḥ .. 4.180.20 ..
4.180.d:
अग्निकार्यं ततः कुर्याद्यथावद्विधिपूर्वकम् ॥
आघारावाज्यभागौ तु हुत्वा प्राग्वच्च तौ ततः ॥ 4.180.20 ॥
4.180.m: he should then perform the rite of the fire properly, preceded by the injunctions. / Then, having offered the two libations of clarified butter and the two portions of clarified butter as previously stated,

4.180.s:
viṣṇave śitikaṇṭhāya maṃtraiḥ pūrvoditaiḥ śubhaiḥ ..
grahayajñoditaiścaiva grahāṇāṃ homa iṣyate .. 21 ..
4.180.d:
विष्णवे शितिकण्ठाय मंत्रैः पूर्वोदितैः शुभैः ॥
ग्रहयज्ञोदितैश्चैव ग्रहाणां होम इष्यते ॥ 21 ॥
4.180.m: an oblation for the planets is prescribed for Viṣṇu and for Śitikaṇṭha, / with the auspicious mantras mentioned previously and those prescribed for the planetary sacrifice.

4.180.s:
evaṃ yajñavidhiṃ kṛtvā yajamāno dvijaiḥ saha ..
yojayeta rathe dāṃtau gajau lakṣaṇasaṃyutau .. 22 ..
4.180.d:
एवं यज्ञविधिं कृत्वा यजमानो द्विजैः सह ॥
योजयेत रथे दांतौ गजौ लक्षणसंयुतौ ॥ 22 ॥
4.180.m: Having thus performed the sacrificial rite together with the twice-born, the patron of the sacrifice / should yoke to the chariot two tamed elephants endowed with auspicious marks,

4.180.s:
vicitratanusaṃvītau śubhakakṣau sughaṃṭikī ..
hemapaṭṭaiḥ sutilakaiḥ śobhitau śaṃkhacāmaraiḥ .. 23 ..
4.180.d:
विचित्रतनुसंवीतौ शुभकक्षौ सुघंटिकी ॥
हेमपट्टैः सुतिलकैः शोभितौ शंखचामरैः ॥ 23 ॥
4.180.m: covered with multicolored cloths, with auspicious girths, having fine bells, / adorned with golden bands, with foreheads painted, with conches and chowries,

4.180.s:
divyamuktāparicchannau divyāṃkuśasamanvitau ..
mahāmātrānvitau caiva sarvābharaṇabhūṣitau .. 24 ..
4.180.d:
दिव्यमुक्तापरिच्छन्नौ दिव्यांकुशसमन्वितौ ॥
महामात्रान्वितौ चैव सर्वाभरणभूषितौ ॥ 24 ॥
4.180.m: covered with divine pearls, equipped with divine goads, / accompanied by mahouts, and adorned with all ornaments.

4.180.s:
evaṃ vidhiṃ tataḥ kṛtvā rathaṃ taṃ sagajaṃ naraḥ ..
āropayettatastasminbrāhmaṇaṃ śaṃsitavratam .. 25 ..
4.180.d:
एवं विधिं ततः कृत्वा रथं तं सगजं नरः ॥
आरोपयेत्ततस्तस्मिन्ब्राह्मणं शंसितव्रतम् ॥ 25 ॥
4.180.m: Having then performed the rite thus, that man, upon that chariot with the elephants, / should then seat a brāhmaṇa of celebrated vows,

4.180.s:
bhūṣitaṃ kaṇṭhakaṭakaiḥ karṇaveṣṭāṃgulīyakaiḥ ..
āguptacolakacchatra vastrāyudhasamanvitam .. 26 ..
4.180.d:
भूषितं कण्ठकटकैः कर्णवेष्टांगुलीयकैः ॥
आगुप्तचोलकच्छत्र वस्त्रायुधसमन्वितम् ॥ 26 ॥
4.180.m: adorned with necklaces and bracelets, ear-ornaments and rings, / equipped with a fully protective coat of mail, a royal parasol, garments, and weapons,

4.180.s:
baddhatūṇiṃ dhanuṣpāṇiṃ bahucarmavibhūṣitam ..
khaḍgadhenukayā naddhaṃ hārālaṃkṛtavigraham .. 27 ..
4.180.d:
बद्धतूणिं धनुष्पाणिं बहुचर्मविभूषितम् ॥
खड्गधेनुकया नद्धं हारालंकृतविग्रहम् ॥ 27 ॥
4.180.m: with a quiver fastened, holding a bow in hand, adorned with many shields, / girt with a dagger, his body adorned with a necklace.

4.180.s:
yajamānastataḥ prājñaḥ śuklāṃbaradharaḥ śuciḥ ..
rathaṃ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya gṛhītakusumāṃjaliḥ .. 28 ..
4.180.d:
यजमानस्ततः प्राज्ञः शुक्लांबरधरः शुचिः ॥
रथं प्रदक्षिणीकृत्य गृहीतकुसुमांजलिः ॥ 28 ॥
4.180.m: Then the wise patron of the sacrifice, wearing white garments, pure, / having circumambulated the chariot, with anjali of flowers taken up,

4.180.s:
imamuccārayenmantraṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam ..
kumudairāvaṇau padmaḥ puṣpadaṃto'tha vāmanaḥ ..
supratīkoṃjanaḥ sārvabhaumo'ṣṭau devayonayaḥ .. 29 ..
4.180.d:
इममुच्चारयेन्मन्त्रं सर्वपापप्रणाशनम् ॥
कुमुदैरावणौ पद्मः पुष्पदंतोऽथ वामनः ॥
सुप्रतीकोंजनः सार्वभौमोऽष्टौ देवयोनयः ॥ 29 ॥
4.180.m: should utter this mantra that destroys all sins: / “Kumuda, Airāvaṇa, Padma, Puṣpadanta, then Vāmana, / Supratīka, Añjana, Sārvabhauma—the eight born of divine origin—

4.180.s:
teṣāṃ vaṃśaprasūtau tu balarūpasamanvitau ..
tadyuktarathadānena mama syātāṃ varapradau ..4.180.30....
4.180.d:
तेषां वंशप्रसूतौ तु बलरूपसमन्वितौ ॥
तद्युक्तरथदानेन मम स्यातां वरप्रदौ ॥4.180.30॥॥
4.180.m: born in their lineages, endowed with strength and beauty, / by the gift of this chariot equipped with them, may they bestow boons upon me!

4.180.s:
ratho'yaṃ yajñapuruṣo brāhmaṇotra śivaḥ svayam ..
mamebharathadānena prīyetāṃ śivakeśavau ..31..
4.180.d:
रथोऽयं यज्ञपुरुषो ब्राह्मणोत्र शिवः स्वयम् ॥
ममेभरथदानेन प्रीयेतां शिवकेशवौ ॥31॥
4.180.m: This chariot is the Spirit of Sacrifice; the brāhmaṇa here is Śiva himself. / Through my gift of this elephant chariot, may Śiva and Keśava be pleased!”

4.180.s:
ityuccārya mahābhāge pūjayitvā punaḥpunaḥ ..
āropayettatastasminbrāhmaṇaṃ śaṃsitavratam ..32..
4.180.d:
इत्युच्चार्य महाभागे पूजयित्वा पुनःपुनः ॥
आरोपयेत्ततस्तस्मिन्ब्राह्मणं शंसितव्रतम् ॥32॥
4.180.m: Having spoken thus, O highly fortunate one, and having worshipped him again and again, / he should then seat upon it a brāhmaṇa of praised vows,

4.180.s:
svadāranirataṃ śāṃtaṃ vedavedāṃgapāragam ..
pañcāgnyabhimataṃ caiva avyaṃgaṃ vyādhivarjitam .. 33 ..
4.180.d:
स्वदारनिरतं शांतं वेदवेदांगपारगम् ॥
पञ्चाग्न्यभिमतं चैव अव्यंगं व्याधिवर्जितम् ॥ 33 ॥
4.180.m: one devoted to his own wife, calm, fully versed in the Vedas and Vedāṅgas, / respected by the keepers of the five fires, unmaimed, and free from disease.

4.180.s:
punaḥ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya rathasthaṃ dvijasattamam ..
ādvāramanugacchecca praṇipatya gṛhaṃ viśet .. 34 ..
4.180.d:
पुनः प्रदक्षिणीकृत्य रथस्थं द्विजसत्तमम् ॥
आद्वारमनुगच्छेच्च प्रणिपत्य गृहं विशेत् ॥ 34 ॥
4.180.m: Having circumambulated the best of the twice-born seated on the chariot, / he should follow him to the doorway, and having prostrated, enter his house.

4.180.s:
tato yajñāvasāne tu dīnāṃdhādīñjaḍānkṛśān ..
pūjayedvividhairdānairvastragodānabhojanaiḥ ..35..
4.180.d:
ततो यज्ञावसाने तु दीनांधादीञ्जडान्कृशान् ॥
पूजयेद्विविधैर्दानैर्वस्त्रगोदानभोजनैः ॥35॥
4.180.m: Then, at the conclusion of the sacrifice, the poor, the blind, the dull-witted, and the emaciated / he should honour with diverse gifts: clothes, gifts of cows, and meals.

4.180.s:
anenaiva vidhānena saṃkalpya rathamuttamam..
kuṇḍamaṃḍapasaṃbhārabhūṣaṇācchādanādikam ..36..
4.180.d:
अनेनैव विधानेन संकल्प्य रथमुत्तमम्॥
कुण्डमंडपसंभारभूषणाच्छादनादिकम् ॥36॥
4.180.m: Following this very rule, having prepared an excellent chariot / with the sacrificial pit, pavilion, provisions, ornaments, coverings, and the like,

4.180.s:
tadeva homadravyaṃ ca homamaṃtrāsta eva hi ..
viśeṣo'śvarathe rājankathyamāno nibodhyatām ..37..
4.180.d:
तदेव होमद्रव्यं च होममंत्रास्त एव हि ॥
विशेषोऽश्वरथे राजन्कथ्यमानो निबोध्यताम् ॥37॥
4.180.m: the offering substance is the same, and the offering mantras are indeed the very same. / Hear now, O king, the specific rule for the horse-chariot being described.

4.180.s:
hayau lakṣaṇasaṃyuktau khalīnālaṃkṛtānanau..
vicitravastusaṃvītau kaṇṭhābharaṇabhūṣitau.. .. 38 ..
4.180.d:
हयौ लक्षणसंयुक्तौ खलीनालंकृताननौ॥
विचित्रवस्तुसंवीतौ कण्ठाभरणभूषितौ॥ ॥ 38 ॥
4.180.m: Two horses possessing auspicious marks, their muzzles adorned with bits, / covered in variegated garments, adorned with neck-ornaments,

4.180.s:
supragrahayutau yojyau dātā tasminnathottame ..
taṃ pradakṣiṇamāvṛttya maṃtrametamudīrayet .. 39 ..
4.180.d:
सुप्रग्रहयुतौ योज्यौ दाता तस्मिन्नथोत्तमे ॥
तं प्रदक्षिणमावृत्त्य मंत्रमेतमुदीरयेत् ॥ 39 ॥
4.180.m: and fitted with good reins, the giver should harness to that excellent chariot. / Having circumambulated it, he should utter this mantra:

4.180.s:
namostu te vedaturaṃgamāya trayīmayāya triguṇātmakāya ..
sudurgamārge sukhapānapātre namo'stu te vājidharāya nityam .. 4.180.40 ..
4.180.d:
नमोस्तु ते वेदतुरंगमाय त्रयीमयाय त्रिगुणात्मकाय ॥
सुदुर्गमार्गे सुखपानपात्रे नमोऽस्तु ते वाजिधराय नित्यम् ॥ 4.180.40 ॥
4.180.m: "Homage to you whose steed is the Veda, who consist of the three Vedas, whose nature is of the three guṇas! / On the very difficult path, you are a vessel of pleasant drink; homage be to you who constantly bear the steeds!

4.180.s:
ratho'yaṃ savitā sākṣādvedāścāmī turaṃgamāḥ ..
aruṇo brāhmaṇaścāyaṃ prayacchaṃtu sukhaṃ mama .. 41 ..
4.180.d:
रथोऽयं सविता साक्षाद्वेदाश्चामी तुरंगमाः ॥
अरुणो ब्राह्मणश्चायं प्रयच्छंतु सुखं मम ॥ 41 ॥
4.180.m: This chariot is Savitṛ visibly, and these steeds are the Vedas; / and this brāhmaṇa is Aruṇa. May they bestow happiness upon me!"

4.180.s:
ityuccārya tatastasminrathe brāhmaṇasattamam ..
āropayedgṛhāddvāraṃ yāvadetamanuvrajet .. 42 ..
4.180.d:
इत्युच्चार्य ततस्तस्मिन्रथे ब्राह्मणसत्तमम् ॥
आरोपयेद्गृहाद्द्वारं यावदेतमनुव्रजेत् ॥ 42 ॥
4.180.m: Having spoken thus, he should then seat the best of brāhmaṇas upon that chariot, / and follow him from the house as far as the doorway.

4.180.s:
anena vidhinā yastu dadyādvājirathaṃ budhaḥ ..
tasmādvāharathaṃ rājyaṃ tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu .. 43 ..
4.180.d:
अनेन विधिना यस्तु दद्याद्वाजिरथं बुधः ॥
तस्माद्वाहरथं राज्यं तस्य पुण्यफलं शृणु ॥ 43 ॥
4.180.m: The wise man who gives a horse-chariot according to this rule— / from that chariot-mount he attains kingship; hear its meritorious reward:

4.180.s:
sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ sarvāmayavivarjitaḥ ..
manvaṃtaraśataṃ yāvatsarvabhogasamanvitaḥ .. 44 ..
4.180.d:
सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तः सर्वामयविवर्जितः ॥
मन्वंतरशतं यावत्सर्वभोगसमन्वितः ॥ 44 ॥
4.180.m: Freed from all sins, released from all sickness, / endowed with all enjoyments for a hundred manvantaras,

4.180.s:
apsarogaṇasaṃkīrṇe vimāne sūryavarcase ..
divyabhogānvitaḥ śrīmānkāmacārī vaseddivi .. 45 ..
4.180.d:
अप्सरोगणसंकीर्णे विमाने सूर्यवर्चसे ॥
दिव्यभोगान्वितः श्रीमान्कामचारी वसेद्दिवि ॥ 45 ॥
4.180.m: in a celestial chariot filled with hosts of apsarases and possessing the splendour of the sun, / endowed with heavenly enjoyments, glorious, moving wherever he desires, he dwells in heaven.

4.180.s:
puṇyakṣayādihābhyetya rājā bhavati dhārmikaḥ ..
putrapautrānvitaścaiva ciraṃjīvī priyātithiḥ ..46..
4.180.d:
पुण्यक्षयादिहाभ्येत्य राजा भवति धार्मिकः ॥
पुत्रपौत्रान्वितश्चैव चिरंजीवी प्रियातिथिः ॥46॥
4.180.m: When his merit is exhausted, returning here, he becomes a righteous king, / endowed with sons and grandsons, long-lived, and affectionate to guests.

4.180.s:
gajenaikena nirdiṣṭaḥ kaścidgajaratho nṛpa ..
ekenāśvenāśvarathaḥ kathyate vedavādibhiḥ .. 47 ..
4.180.d:
गजेनैकेन निर्दिष्टः कश्चिद्गजरथो नृप ॥
एकेनाश्वेनाश्वरथः कथ्यते वेदवादिभिः ॥ 47 ॥
4.180.m: Some describe an elephant-chariot with one elephant, O king; / a horse-chariot is declared with one horse by the expounders of the Veda.

4.180.s: dānamaṃtrāsta evoktāḥ phalaṃ tatra nigadyate .. 48 ..
4.180.d: दानमंत्रास्त एवोक्ताः फलं तत्र निगद्यते ॥ 48 ॥
4.180.m: The gift-mantras are said to be the same; the fruit thereof is declared [now]:

4.180.s:
yacchaṃti ye rathavaraṃ sudhurākṣacakraṃ vikrāṃtavāraṇayutaṃ turagānvitaṃ vā ..
sopaskaraṃ kanakapaṭṭavicitritāgaṃ te syaṃdanena surarājapuraṃ prayāṃti .. 49 ..
kālapuruṣadānavidhivarṇanam
4.180.d:
यच्छंति ये रथवरं सुधुराक्षचक्रं विक्रांतवारणयुतं तुरगान्वितं वा ॥
सोपस्करं कनकपट्टविचित्रितागं ते स्यंदनेन सुरराजपुरं प्रयांति ॥ 49 ॥
कालपुरुषदानविधिवर्णनम्
4.180.m:
Those who give an excellent chariot with sturdy poles, axles, and wheels, harnessed with a valiant elephant or equipped with horses, / complete with furnishings, its body adorned with golden plates, go to the city of the king of gods in a chariot.
Description of the Rule for the Gift of the Kālapuruṣa

4.181.s:
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca .. ..
dānānyanyāni me kṛṣṇa kathayasva yadūttama ..
maṃgalyāni pavitrāṇi sarvapāpaharāṇi ca .. 1 ..
4.181.d:
युधिष्ठिर उवाच ॥ ॥
दानान्यन्यानि मे कृष्ण कथयस्व यदूत्तम ॥
मंगल्यानि पवित्राणि सर्वपापहराणि च ॥ 1 ॥
4.181.m: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / Tell me of other gifts, O Kṛṣṇa, O best of the Yadus, / that are auspicious, purifying, and take away all sins.

4.181.s:
saṃsārasāgarottārahetubhūto'si mādhava ..
dharmādharmaparijñāne tvadanyo neha kaścana ..2..
4.181.d:
संसारसागरोत्तारहेतुभूतोऽसि माधव ॥
धर्माधर्मपरिज्ञाने त्वदन्यो नेह कश्चन ॥2॥
4.181.m: You are the cause of crossing over the ocean of worldly existence, O Mādhava; / there is none other here than you in discerning dharma and adharma.

4.181.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
dānāni bahurūpāṇi kathitāni mayā tava ..
punareva pravakṣyāmi yadyasti tava kautukam .. 3 ..
4.181.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
दानानि बहुरूपाणि कथितानि मया तव ॥
पुनरेव प्रवक्ष्यामि यद्यस्ति तव कौतुकम् ॥ 3 ॥
4.181.m: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / Many kinds of gifts have been described by me to you. / I shall speak again if there is curiosity in you.

4.181.s:
kathitāni mayā tubhyaṃ kathayiṣyāmi yāni ca ..
mahatārthena sidhyaṃti prayacchaṃti mahatphalam .. 4 ..
4.181.d:
कथितानि मया तुभ्यं कथयिष्यामि यानि च ॥
महतार्थेन सिध्यंति प्रयच्छंति महत्फलम् ॥ 4 ॥
4.181.m: Those that have been described by me to you, and those that I shall describe, / are accomplished at great cost and bestow a great reward.

4.181.s:
kāmyo dānavidhiḥ pārtha kriyamāṇaḥ prayatnataḥ ..
phalāya munibhiḥ prokto viparīto bhayāya ca .. 5 ..
4.181.d:
काम्यो दानविधिः पार्थ क्रियमाणः प्रयत्नतः ॥
फलाय मुनिभिः प्रोक्तो विपरीतो भयाय च ॥ 5 ॥
4.181.m: A voluntary rule of donation, O son of Pṛthā, performed with effort, / is declared by the sages to bring reward; if performed improperly, it brings fear.

4.181.s:
jñeyaṃ niṣkaśataṃ sarvadāneṣu vidhiruttamaḥ ..
madhyamastu tadardhena tadarddhenāvaraḥ smṛtaḥ .. 6 ..
4.181.d:
ज्ञेयं निष्कशतं सर्वदानेषु विधिरुत्तमः ॥
मध्यमस्तु तदर्धेन तदर्द्धेनावरः स्मृतः ॥ 6 ॥
4.181.m: One should know that one hundred niṣkas is the highest rule in all gifts; / the middling is with half of that, and the lowest is regarded as with half of that.

4.181.s:
evaṃ vṛkṣaratheṃdrāṇāṃ dhenoḥ kṛṣṇājinasya ca ..
aśaktasyāpi kṛṣṭo'yaṃ paṃcasauvarṇiko vidhiḥ .. 7 ..
4.181.d:
एवं वृक्षरथेंद्राणां धेनोः कृष्णाजिनस्य च ॥
अशक्तस्यापि कृष्टोऽयं पंचसौवर्णिको विधिः ॥ 7 ॥
4.181.m: Thus for trees, lordly chariots, a cow, and a black antelope skin; / even for one unable, this rule of five sauvarṇikas has been drawn up.

4.181.s:
ato'nyūnena yo dadyānmahādānaṃ narādhipa ..
pratigṛhṇāti vā tasya duḥkhaśokāvahaṃ bhavet .. 8 ..
4.181.d:
अतोऽन्यूनेन यो दद्यान्महादानं नराधिप ॥
प्रतिगृह्णाति वा तस्य दुःखशोकावहं भवेत् ॥ 8 ॥
4.181.m: Whoever gives a great gift of less than this, O lord of men, / or receives it, it will bring him pain and grief.

4.181.s:
ādau tāvatpravakṣyāmi kālākhyaṃ puruṣaṃ tava ..
saptasāgaradānaṃ ca mahābhūtaghaṭantathā .. 9 ..
4.181.d:
आदौ तावत्प्रवक्ष्यामि कालाख्यं पुरुषं तव ॥
सप्तसागरदानं च महाभूतघटन्तथा ॥ 9 ॥
4.181.m: First I will tell you of the man called Kāla, / and the gift of the seven oceans, and the jar of the great elements,

4.181.s:
ardhyapradānamaṃtrokta mātmapratikṛtistathā ..
suvarṇāśvaḥ smṛtaḥ ṣaṣṭhaḥ suvarṇāśvaratho'paraḥ .. 4.181.10 ..
4.181.d:
अर्ध्यप्रदानमंत्रोक्त मात्मप्रतिकृतिस्तथा ॥
सुवर्णाश्वः स्मृतः षष्ठः सुवर्णाश्वरथोऽपरः ॥ 4.181.10 ॥
4.181.m: a personal likeness accompanied by the mantra for offering arghya, / a golden horse is regarded as the sixth, and a golden horse-chariot as the other,

4.181.s:
sarvadānottamaṃ rājankṛṣṇājinamathāṣṭamam ..
viśvacakraṃ ca navamaṃ haimo gajarathastathā .. 11 ..
4.181.d:
सर्वदानोत्तमं राजन्कृष्णाजिनमथाष्टमम् ॥
विश्वचक्रं च नवमं हैमो गजरथस्तथा ॥ 11 ॥
4.181.m: and the black antelope skin as the eighth, the highest of all gifts, O king, / and the universal wheel as the ninth, and likewise a golden elephant-chariot.

4.181.s:
etatte dānadaśakaṃ vedmi pārthivasattama ..
dehi dāpaya sadbudiṃ dāne nṛpanarottama .. 12 ..
4.181.d:
एतत्ते दानदशकं वेद्मि पार्थिवसत्तम ॥
देहि दापय सद्बुदिं दाने नृपनरोत्तम ॥ 12 ॥
4.181.m: I know this set of ten gifts for you, O best of rulers; / give, and inspire a good mind toward giving, O best of kings, best of men.

4.181.s:
dānādṛte nopakāro vidyate dhanino'paraḥ ..
dīyamāno hi nāpaiti bhūya evābhivardhate .. 13 .
4.181.d:
दानादृते नोपकारो विद्यते धनिनोऽपरः ॥
दीयमानो हि नापैति भूय एवाभिवर्धते ॥ 13 ।
4.181.m: Other than giving, there is no benefit for a wealthy man; / for what is given does not depart, but indeed increases all the more.

4.181.s:
kūpa ullikhyamāno'pi bhavatyeva bahūdakaḥ ..
puṇyaṃ dinamathāsādya bhūmibhāge same śubhe .. 14 ..
4.181.d:
कूप उल्लिख्यमानोऽपि भवत्येव बहूदकः ॥
पुण्यं दिनमथासाद्य भूमिभागे समे शुभे ॥ 14 ॥
4.181.m: A well, even when being dug out, becomes full of water. / Then, having found an auspicious day on an even, pure plot of ground,

4.181.s:
caturthyāṃ vā caturdaśyāṃ viṣṭyāṃ vā pāṃḍunaṃdana ..
pumānkṛṣṇatilaiḥ kāryo raupyadaṃtaḥ suvarṇadṛk .. 15 ..
4.181.d:
चतुर्थ्यां वा चतुर्दश्यां विष्ट्यां वा पांडुनंदन ॥
पुमान्कृष्णतिलैः कार्यो रौप्यदंतः सुवर्णदृक् ॥ 15 ॥
4.181.m: either on the fourth or the fourteenth [lunar day], or in Viṣṭi, O son of Pāṇḍu, / an effigy of a man should be made of black sesame, with silver teeth and gold eyes,

4.181.s:
khaḍgodyatakaro dīrṇo japā kusumakuṃḍalaḥ ..
raktāṃbaradharaḥ sragvī śaṃkhamālāvibhūṣitaḥ .. 16 ..
4.181.d:
खड्गोद्यतकरो दीर्णो जपा कुसुमकुंडलः ॥
रक्तांबरधरः स्रग्वी शंखमालाविभूषितः ॥ 16 ॥
4.181.m: his hand raised with a sword, terrible, with earrings of hibiscus flowers, / wearing red garments, garlanded, adorned with a necklace of conches,

4.181.s:
tīkṣṇāsipatradhanuṣā visphāritakaṭītaṭaḥ ..
upānadyugayukto hi kṛṣṇakaṃbala pārśvagaḥ .. 17 ..
4.181.d:
तीक्ष्णासिपत्रधनुषा विस्फारितकटीतटः ॥
उपानद्युगयुक्तो हि कृष्णकंबल पार्श्वगः ॥ 17 ॥
4.181.m: his waist expanded with a sharp sword-leaf bow, / equipped with a pair of shoes, with a black blanket at his side,

4.181.s:
gṛhītamāṃsapiṃḍaśca vāme karatale tathā ..
evaṃ vidhaṃ naraṃ kṛtvā gṛhītakusumāṃjaliḥ .. 18 ..
4.181.d:
गृहीतमांसपिंडश्च वामे करतले तथा ॥
एवं विधं नरं कृत्वा गृहीतकुसुमांजलिः ॥ 18 ॥
4.181.m: and with a lump of flesh held in the palm of his left hand. / Having made such an effigy of a man, taking a handful of flowers,

4.181.s:
saṃpūjya gaṃdhakusumairnaivedyaṃ vinivedya ca ..
tilājyaṃ juhuyāttatra tryaṃbaketi ca maṃtrataḥ .. 19 ..
4.181.d:
संपूज्य गंधकुसुमैर्नैवेद्यं विनिवेद्य च ॥
तिलाज्यं जुहुयात्तत्र त्र्यंबकेति च मंत्रतः ॥ 19 ॥
4.181.m: having worshipped it with perfumes and flowers and presented an offering of food, / he should offer an oblation of sesame and ghee there with the mantra "Tryambaka..."

4.181.s:
svagṛhyoktavidhānena śatamaṣṭottaraṃ yajet ..
yajamānaḥ prasannātmā imaṃ maṃtramudīrayet ..4.181.20...
4.181.d:
स्वगृह्योक्तविधानेन शतमष्टोत्तरं यजेत् ॥
यजमानः प्रसन्नात्मा इमं मंत्रमुदीरयेत् ॥4.181.20॥।
4.181.m: He should sacrifice one hundred and eight times according to the rule declared in his own Gṛhyasūtra. / With a joyful mind, the patron of the sacrifice should utter this mantra:

4.181.s:
sarvaṃ kalayase yasmātkālastvaṃ tena bhaṇyase ..
brahmaviṣṇuśivādīnāṃ tvamasādhyo'si suvrata .. 21 ..
4.181.d:
सर्वं कलयसे यस्मात्कालस्त्वं तेन भण्यसे ॥
ब्रह्मविष्णुशिवादीनां त्वमसाध्योऽसि सुव्रत ॥ 21 ॥
4.181.m: "Because you reckon everything, you are therefore called Time. / You cannot be mastered even by Brahmā, Viṣṇu, Śiva, and the others, O you of noble vows!

4.181.s:
pūjitastvaṃ mayā bhaktyā prārthitaśca tathā sukham ..
yaducyate tava vibho tatkuruṣva namonamaḥ .. 22 ..
4.181.d:
पूजितस्त्वं मया भक्त्या प्रार्थितश्च तथा सुखम् ॥
यदुच्यते तव विभो तत्कुरुष्व नमोनमः ॥ 22 ॥
4.181.m: You have been worshipped by me with devotion and prayed to for happiness; / fulfill what has been spoken to you, O all-pervading one! Homage, homage!"

4.181.s:
evaṃ saṃpūjayitvā taṃ brāhmaṇāya nivedayet ..
brahmāṇaṃ prathamaṃ pūjya vāsobhirbhūṣaṇaistathā .. 23 ..
4.181.d:
एवं संपूजयित्वा तं ब्राह्मणाय निवेदयेत् ॥
ब्रह्माणं प्रथमं पूज्य वासोभिर्भूषणैस्तथा ॥ 23 ॥
4.181.m: Having thus worshipped him, he should present him to a brāhmaṇa, / having first worshipped the brāhmaṇa with garments and ornaments.

4.181.s:
dakṣiṇāṃ śaktito dadyātpraṇipatya visarjayet..
anena vidhinā yastu dānametatprayacchati .. 24 ..
4.181.d:
दक्षिणां शक्तितो दद्यात्प्रणिपत्य विसर्जयेत्॥
अनेन विधिना यस्तु दानमेतत्प्रयच्छति ॥ 24 ॥
4.181.m: He should give a sacrificial fee according to his capacity, and having prostrated, dismiss him. / Whoever offers this gift according to this rule,

4.181.s:
nāpamṛtyubhayaṃ tasya na ca vyādhikṛtaṃ bhayam ..
bhavatyavyāhataiśvaryaḥ sarvabādhāvivarjitaḥ .. 25 ..
4.181.d:
नापमृत्युभयं तस्य न च व्याधिकृतं भयम् ॥
भवत्यव्याहतैश्वर्यः सर्वबाधाविवर्जितः ॥ 25 ॥
4.181.m: has no fear of untimely death, nor fear caused by disease; / his sovereignty becomes unobstructed, and he is free from all afflictions.

4.181.s:
dehāṃte sūryabhavanaṃ bhittvā yāti paraṃ padam ..
puṇyakṣayādihābhyetya rājā bhavati dhārmikaḥ ..
saṃtatyā ca śriyā yuktaḥ putrapautrasamanvitaḥ .. 26 ..
4.181.d:
देहांते सूर्यभवनं भित्त्वा याति परं पदम् ॥
पुण्यक्षयादिहाभ्येत्य राजा भवति धार्मिकः ॥
संतत्या च श्रिया युक्तः पुत्रपौत्रसमन्वितः ॥ 26 ॥
4.181.m: At the end of his body, piercing the solar realm, he goes to the supreme abode. / When his merit is exhausted, he comes here and becomes a righteous king, / endowed with lineage and fortune, accompanied by sons and grandsons.

4.181.s:
saṃpūjya kālapuruṣaṃ vidhivaddvijāya dattvā śubhāśubhaphalodayahetubhūtaḥ ..
rogāṃtare sakaladoṣamaye ca dehī no vadhyabhāvamupagacchati tatprabhāvāt .. 27 .. ..
saptasāgaradānavidhivarṇanam
4.181.d:
संपूज्य कालपुरुषं विधिवद्द्विजाय दत्त्वा शुभाशुभफलोदयहेतुभूतः ॥
रोगांतरे सकलदोषमये च देही नो वध्यभावमुपगच्छति तत्प्रभावात् ॥ 27 ॥ ॥
सप्तसागरदानविधिवर्णनम्
4.181.m:
Having duly worshipped the Time-Person and given it to a brāhmaṇa, he who is the source of the rise of auspicious and inauspicious results, / the embodied soul does not meet death amidst diseases and full of all afflictions, by that power.
Description of the procedure for the gift of the seven oceans

4.182.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi pārthadānamanuttamam ..
saptasāgarakaṃ nāma sarvapāpapraṇāśanam .. 1 ..
4.182.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
अथातः संप्रवक्ष्यामि पार्थदानमनुत्तमम् ॥
सप्तसागरकं नाम सर्वपापप्रणाशनम् ॥ 1 ॥
4.182.m: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / Now, therefore, O son of Pṛthā, I shall describe an unsurpassed gift / named the Seven Oceans, which destroys all sins.

4.182.s:
puṇyaṃ dinamathāsādya yugādigrahaṇādikam ..
kārayetsaptakuṇḍāni kāṃcanāni vicakṣaṇaḥ .. 2 ..
4.182.d:
पुण्यं दिनमथासाद्य युगादिग्रहणादिकम् ॥
कारयेत्सप्तकुण्डानि कांचनानि विचक्षणः ॥ 2 ॥
4.182.m: Having reached an auspicious day, such as an eclipse, the start of a yuga, or similar occasions, / the wise person should cause seven sacrificial pits to be made of gold,

4.182.s:
prādeśamātrāṇi tathā ratnimātrāṇi vā punaḥ ..
kuryātsaptaśatādūrdhvamāsahasrācca śaktitaḥ .. 3 ..
4.182.d:
प्रादेशमात्राणि तथा रत्निमात्राणि वा पुनः ॥
कुर्यात्सप्तशतादूर्ध्वमासहस्राच्च शक्तितः ॥ 3 ॥
4.182.m: measuring a span, or else measuring a cubit. / According to one's capacity, one should make them from seven hundred [palas] up to a thousand.

4.182.s:
saṃsthāpyāni ca sarvāṇi kṛṣṇājinatilopari ..
prathamaṃ pūrayetkuṃḍaṃ lavaṇena vicakṣaṇaḥ .. 4 ..
4.182.d:
संस्थाप्यानि च सर्वाणि कृष्णाजिनतिलोपरि ॥
प्रथमं पूरयेत्कुंडं लवणेन विचक्षणः ॥ 4 ॥
4.182.m: And all of them are to be set upon black antelope skin and sesame seeds. / The wise person should fill the first sacrificial pit with salt;

4.182.s:
dvitīyaṃ payasā tadvattṛtīyaṃ sarpiṣā punaḥ ..
caturthaṃ tu guḍenaiva dadhnā paṃcamameva ca .. 5 ..
4.182.d:
द्वितीयं पयसा तद्वत्तृतीयं सर्पिषा पुनः ॥
चतुर्थं तु गुडेनैव दध्ना पंचममेव च ॥ 5 ॥
4.182.m: the second likewise with milk; again, the third with clarified butter; / the fourth indeed with molasses; and the fifth with curds;

4.182.s:
ṣaṣṭhaṃ śarkarayā tadvatsaptamaṃ tīrthavāriṇā ..
sthāpayellavaṇasyāṃte brahmāṇaṃ kāṃcanaṃ śubham .. 6 ..
4.182.d:
षष्ठं शर्करया तद्वत्सप्तमं तीर्थवारिणा ॥
स्थापयेल्लवणस्यांते ब्रह्माणं कांचनं शुभम् ॥ 6 ॥
4.182.m: the sixth likewise with sugar; the seventh with sacred water. / At the end of the salt one should place an auspicious golden Brahmā;

4.182.s:
keśavaṃ kṣīramadhye tu ghṛtamadhye maheśvaram ..
bhāskaraṃ guḍamadhye tu dadhimadhye surādhipam .. 7 ..
4.182.d:
केशवं क्षीरमध्ये तु घृतमध्ये महेश्वरम् ॥
भास्करं गुडमध्ये तु दधिमध्ये सुराधिपम् ॥ 7 ॥
4.182.m: Keśava in the middle of the milk; Maheśvara in the middle of the clarified butter; / Bhāskara in the middle of the molasses; the lord of the gods in the middle of the curds;

4.182.s:
śarkarāyāṃ nyasellakṣmīṃ jalamadhye tu pārvatīm ..
sarveṣu sarvaratnāni dhānyāni ca samaṃtataḥ .. 8 ..
4.182.d:
शर्करायां न्यसेल्लक्ष्मीं जलमध्ये तु पार्वतीम् ॥
सर्वेषु सर्वरत्नानि धान्यानि च समंततः ॥ 8 ॥
4.182.m: upon the sugar one should place Lakṣmī; and Pārvatī in the middle of the water. / In all of them, all jewels and grains all around,

4.182.s:
sthāpayetpuruṣaśreṣṭha yathālābhaṃ yathāsukham ..
tataḥ parvasamīpe tu snātaḥ śuklāṃbaro gṛhī .. 9 ..
4.182.d:
स्थापयेत्पुरुषश्रेष्ठ यथालाभं यथासुखम् ॥
ततः पर्वसमीपे तु स्नातः शुक्लांबरो गृही ॥ 9 ॥
4.182.m: O best of men, one should place according to what is available and comfortably. / Then, near the sacred festival time, bathed and wearing white garments, the householder,

4.182.s:
triḥpradakṣiṇamāvṛtya maṃtrānetānudīrayet ..
namo vaḥ sarvasiṃdhūnāmādhārebhyaḥ sanātanāḥ .. 4.182.10 ..
4.182.d:
त्रिःप्रदक्षिणमावृत्य मंत्रानेतानुदीरयेत् ॥
नमो वः सर्वसिंधूनामाधारेभ्यः सनातनाः ॥ 4.182.10 ॥
4.182.m: having circled three times clockwise, should utter these mantras: / 'Homage to you, eternal foundations of all rivers!

4.182.s:
jaṃtūnāṃ prāṇadebhyaśca samudrebhya namonamaḥ ..
pūrṇāḥ sarve bhavaṃto vai kṣāra kṣīraghṛtaikṣavaiḥ .. 11 ..
4.182.d:
जंतूनां प्राणदेभ्यश्च समुद्रेभ्य नमोनमः ॥
पूर्णाः सर्वे भवंतो वै क्षार क्षीरघृतैक्षवैः ॥ 11 ॥
4.182.m: To the oceans, givers of life to living creatures, homage, homage! / May all of you indeed become full with salt water, milk, clarified butter, and sugarcane juice,

4.182.s:
dadhnā śarkarayā tadvattīrthavāribhireva ca ..
tasmādaghaughavidhvaṃsaṃ kurudhvaṃ mama mānadāḥ .. 12 ..
4.182.d:
दध्ना शर्करया तद्वत्तीर्थवारिभिरेव च ॥
तस्मादघौघविध्वंसं कुरुध्वं मम मानदाः ॥ 12 ॥
4.182.m: with curds, with sugar, and with sacred waters! / Therefore, O honorers, destroy the mass of my sins!

4.182.s:
alakṣmīḥ praśamaṃ yātu lakṣmīścāstu gṛhe mama ..
evamuccārya tāndadyādbrāhmaṇebhyo yudhiṣṭhira.. 13 ..
4.182.d:
अलक्ष्मीः प्रशमं यातु लक्ष्मीश्चास्तु गृहे मम ॥
एवमुच्चार्य तान्दद्याद्ब्राह्मणेभ्यो युधिष्ठिर॥ 13 ॥
4.182.m: May misfortune be calmed, and may fortune reside in my home!' / Having uttered this, he should give them to brāhmaṇas, O Yudhiṣṭhira.

4.182.s:
ekamevamathābhyarcya puṣpavastravilepanaiḥ ..
bahūnāmetaduddiṣṭaṃ dānamekasya vā punaḥ .. 14 ..
4.182.d:
एकमेवमथाभ्यर्च्य पुष्पवस्त्रविलेपनैः ॥
बहूनामेतदुद्दिष्टं दानमेकस्य वा पुनः ॥ 14 ॥
4.182.m: Having worshipped [them] thus one by one with flowers, garments, and ointments, / this gift is prescribed for many or else for one [brāhmaṇa];

4.182.s:
deyaṃ vā sarvasāmānyaṃ kriyāviprānurūpataḥ ..
dānaṃ saptasamudrākhyaṃ yaḥ prayacchati pārthiva .. 15 ..
4.182.d:
देयं वा सर्वसामान्यं क्रियाविप्रानुरूपतः ॥
दानं सप्तसमुद्राख्यं यः प्रयच्छति पार्थिव ॥ 15 ॥
4.182.m: or it may be given equally to all, in accordance with the deeds and the brāhmaṇas. / The king who offers the gift called the Seven Oceans,

4.182.s:
tasya gṛhānna calati lakṣmīryāvatkulāṣṭakam ..
pūjyamānaḥ suragaṇaiḥ siddhavidyādharoragaiḥ .. 16 ..
4.182.d:
तस्य गृहान्न चलति लक्ष्मीर्यावत्कुलाष्टकम् ॥
पूज्यमानः सुरगणैः सिद्धविद्याधरोरगैः ॥ 16 ॥
4.182.m: from his house fortune does not depart for eight generations. / Being worshipped by hosts of gods, siddhas, vidyādharas, and uragas,

4.182.s:
devalokānna cyavate saptamanvatarāṇyasau ..
tataśca vedasaṃskārātparaṃ brahmādhigacchati .. 17 ..
4.182.d:
देवलोकान्न च्यवते सप्तमन्वतराण्यसौ ॥
ततश्च वेदसंस्कारात्परं ब्रह्माधिगच्छति ॥ 17 ॥
4.182.m: he does not fall from the world of the gods for seven Manvantaras; / and then, through the consecration of the Veda, he attains the supreme Brahman.

4.182.s:
iti dadāti rasāmarasaṃyutāñchuciravismayadāniha sāgarān ..
analakāṃcanaratnamayānasau padamupaiti hare ramayā vṛtam .. .. 16 ..
4.182.d:
इति ददाति रसामरसंयुताञ्छुचिरविस्मयदानिह सागरान् ॥
अनलकांचनरत्नमयानसौ पदमुपैति हरे रमया वृतम् ॥ ॥ 16 ॥
4.182.m: He who, pure and offering wondrous things here, gives the oceans containing the nectar of the earth / and consisting of pure gold and jewels, reaches the abode of Hari, accompanied by Ramā.

4.182.s:
dānaṃ pradhānatarametadatīva vipre proktaṃ yudhiṣṭhira samādhidhiyā viciṃtya ..
haimānvidhāya jaladhīnvitarasva śaktyā prāpnoṣi yena sarasāni samīhitāni .. 19 ..
mahābhūtaghaṭadānavarṇanam
4.182.d:
दानं प्रधानतरमेतदतीव विप्रे प्रोक्तं युधिष्ठिर समाधिधिया विचिंत्य ॥
हैमान्विधाय जलधीन्वितरस्व शक्त्या प्राप्नोषि येन सरसानि समीहितानि ॥ 19 ॥
महाभूतघटदानवर्णनम्
4.182.m:
This gift is proclaimed as exceedingly preeminent when given to a brāhmaṇa, O Yudhiṣṭhira; having considered this with a focused mind, / having fashioned the golden oceans, give them according to your means, by which you will obtain your desired charming things.
Description of the gift of the jar of the great elements

4.183.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi dānamanyattavottamam ..
mahābhūtaghaṭaṃ nāma mahāpātakanāśanam .. 1 ..
4.183.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
अथातः संप्रवक्ष्यामि दानमन्यत्तवोत्तमम् ॥
महाभूतघटं नाम महापातकनाशनम् ॥ 1 ॥
4.183.m: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / Now, therefore, I shall describe another excellent gift for you, / named the Jar of the Great Elements, which destroys great sins.

4.183.s:
puṇyāṃ tithiṃ samāsādya svanulipte gṛhāṃgaṇe ..
kārayetkāṃcanaṃ kuṃbhaṃ mahāratnānvitaṃ punaḥ .. 2 ..
4.183.d:
पुण्यां तिथिं समासाद्य स्वनुलिप्ते गृहांगणे ॥
कारयेत्कांचनं कुंभं महारत्नान्वितं पुनः ॥ 2 ॥
4.183.m: Having reached an auspicious lunar day, in a well-smeared courtyard of the house, / one should cause a golden jar to be made, further adorned with great jewels,
from a span up to a hundred fingers in measure; / according to one's capacity, from five palas up to a hundred, O best of men.
Having made it filled with milk and clarified butter, accompanied by a wish-fulfilling tree, / seated on lotus postures there are Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and Maheśvara;

4.183.s:
lokapālā mahendrāśca svavāhanasamāsthitāḥ ..
ṛgvedaḥ sākṣasūtraśca yajurvedaḥ sapaṃkajaḥ .. 5 ..
4.183.d:
लोकपाला महेन्द्राश्च स्ववाहनसमास्थिताः ॥
ऋग्वेदः साक्षसूत्रश्च यजुर्वेदः सपंकजः ॥ 5 ॥
4.183.m: the world protectors and great Indras mounted on their respective vehicles; / the Ṛgveda with a rosary; the Yajurveda with a lotus;

4.183.s:
vīṇādhārī sāmavedo hyatharvā srakchubhānvitaḥ ..
purāṇavedo varadaḥ sākṣasūtrakamaṃḍaluḥ .. 6 ..
4.183.d:
वीणाधारी सामवेदो ह्यथर्वा स्रक्छुभान्वितः ॥
पुराणवेदो वरदः साक्षसूत्रकमंडलुः ॥ 6 ॥
4.183.m: the Sāmaveda holding a lute; and indeed the Atharvaveda endowed with an auspicious ladle; / the Purāṇa-Veda, granting boons, with a rosary and a water pot.

4.183.s:
saptadhānyāni purataḥ sthāpayecchaktito budhaḥ ..
pādukopānahacchatraṃ cāmarāgryāsanāyudhān .. 7 ..
4.183.d:
सप्तधान्यानि पुरतः स्थापयेच्छक्तितो बुधः ॥
पादुकोपानहच्छत्रं चामराग्र्यासनायुधान् ॥ 7 ॥
4.183.m: In front, the wise man should place the seven grains according to his means, / sandals, shoes, royal parasol, chowrie, supreme seat, and weapons.

4.183.s:
evaṃ prakalpya vidhivanmahābhūtaghaṭaṃ naraḥ ..
guḍasāroparigataṃ mālyavastrairathārcayet .. 8 ..
4.183.d:
एवं प्रकल्प्य विधिवन्महाभूतघटं नरः ॥
गुडसारोपरिगतं माल्यवस्त्रैरथार्चयेत् ॥ 8 ॥
4.183.m: Having thus prepared according to rule the jar of the great elements, / placed on top of molasses, a man should then worship it with garlands and garments.

4.183.s:
atha parvasamīpe tu snātvā niyatamānasaḥ ..
triḥ pradakṣiṇamāvṛtya maṃtrametamudīrayet .. 9 ..
4.183.d:
अथ पर्वसमीपे तु स्नात्वा नियतमानसः ॥
त्रिः प्रदक्षिणमावृत्य मंत्रमेतमुदीरयेत् ॥ 9 ॥
4.183.m: Then, near the festival time, having bathed with a restrained mind, / having circled three times clockwise, he should utter this mantra:

4.183.s:
yasmānna kiṃcidapyasti mahābhūtairvinā kṛtam ..
mahābhūtamayaścāyaṃ tasmācchāṃtiṃ dadātu me .. 4.183.10 ..
4.183.d:
यस्मान्न किंचिदप्यस्ति महाभूतैर्विना कृतम् ॥
महाभूतमयश्चायं तस्माच्छांतिं ददातु मे ॥ 4.183.10 ॥
4.183.m: 'Since nothing at all is made without the great elements, / and this consists of the great elements, therefore may it grant me peace!

4.183.s:
atra sannihitā devāḥ sthāpitā viśvakarmaṇā ..
te me śāṃtiṃ prayacchaṃtu bhaktibhāvena pūjitāḥ .. 11 ..
4.183.d:
अत्र सन्निहिता देवाः स्थापिता विश्वकर्मणा ॥
ते मे शांतिं प्रयच्छंतु भक्तिभावेन पूजिताः ॥ 11 ॥
4.183.m: The gods present here were established by Viśvakarman; / worshipped with devotion, may they grant peace to me!'

4.183.s:
ityevaṃ pūjayitvā tu mahābhūtaghaṭaṃ naraḥ ..
brāhmaṇaṃ pūjayitvā tu bhūṣaṇācchādanādibhiḥ .. 12 ..
4.183.d:
इत्येवं पूजयित्वा तु महाभूतघटं नरः ॥
ब्राह्मणं पूजयित्वा तु भूषणाच्छादनादिभिः ॥ 12 ॥
4.183.m: Having thus worshipped the jar of the great elements, a man, / having worshipped a brāhmaṇa with ornaments, clothing, and the like,

4.183.s:
mahābhūtaghaṭaṃ dadyātparvakāle yatavrataḥ ..
punaḥ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya brāhmaṇaṃ taṃ kṣamāpayet.. 13 ..
4.183.d:
महाभूतघटं दद्यात्पर्वकाले यतव्रतः ॥
पुनः प्रदक्षिणीकृत्य ब्राह्मणं तं क्षमापयेत्॥ 13 ॥
4.183.m: should give the jar of the great elements at the festival time, observing his vow. / Having circled the brāhmaṇa clockwise again, he should ask his pardon.

4.183.s:
anena vidhinā yaśca dānametatprayacchati ..
ekaviṃśatkulopetaḥ śivaloke prayātyasau .. 14 ..
4.183.d:
अनेन विधिना यश्च दानमेतत्प्रयच्छति ॥
एकविंशत्कुलोपेतः शिवलोके प्रयात्यसौ ॥ 14 ॥
4.183.m: And he who presents this gift by this procedure, / accompanied by twenty-one generations of his family, goes to the world of Śiva.

4.183.s:
puṇyakṣayādihābhyetya rājā bhavati dhārmikaḥ ..
ajeyaḥ śatrusaṃghātairmahābala parākramaḥ .. 15 ..
4.183.d:
पुण्यक्षयादिहाभ्येत्य राजा भवति धार्मिकः ॥
अजेयः शत्रुसंघातैर्महाबल पराक्रमः ॥ 15 ॥
4.183.m: When his merit is exhausted, he comes here and becomes a righteous king, / invincible to hosts of enemies, possessed of great strength and prowess,
devoted to the duty of the kṣatriya, learned, worshipping gods and brāhmaṇas.

4.183.s:
aṣṭāpadottamaghaṭaṃ vimalaṃ vidhāya brahmeśakeśavayutaṃ sahalokapālaiḥ ..
kṣīrājyapūrṇavivaraṃ praṇipatya bhaktyā viprāya dehi tava dānaśataiḥ kimanyaiḥ ...17..
śayyādānavidhivarṇanam
4.183.d:
अष्टापदोत्तमघटं विमलं विधाय ब्रह्मेशकेशवयुतं सहलोकपालैः ॥
क्षीराज्यपूर्णविवरं प्रणिपत्य भक्त्या विप्राय देहि तव दानशतैः किमन्यैः ॥.17॥
शय्यादानविधिवर्णनम्
4.183.m:
Having made a spotless jar of the best gold, joined with Brahmā, Īśa, and Keśava along with the world protectors, / its cavity filled with milk and clarified butter, give it with devotion, having bowed down, to a brāhmaṇa; what need have you of hundreds of other gifts?
Description of the Rules for the Gift of a Bed

4.184.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
śayyādānaṃ pravakṣyāmi tava pāṃḍukulodvaha ..
yaddattvā sukhabhāgī syādiha loke paratra ca .. 1 ..
4.184.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
शय्यादानं प्रवक्ष्यामि तव पांडुकुलोद्वह ॥
यद्दत्त्वा सुखभागी स्यादिह लोके परत्र च ॥ 1 ॥
4.184.m:
Śrī Kṛṣṇa said:
I shall explain to you the gift of a bed, O uplifter of the Pāṇḍu line, / by giving which one attains happiness in this world and in the next.

4.184.s:
śayyādānaṃ prayacchaṃti sarvadaiva dvijottamāḥ ..
anityaṃ jīvitaṃ yasmātkonyaḥ paścātpradāsyati .. 2 ..
4.184.d:
शय्यादानं प्रयच्छंति सर्वदैव द्विजोत्तमाः ॥
अनित्यं जीवितं यस्मात्कोन्यः पश्चात्प्रदास्यति ॥ 2 ॥
4.184.m: The best of the twice-born always give the gift of a bed, / because life is transient; who else will give it afterwards?

4.184.s:
tāvatsa baṃdhuḥ sa pitā yāvajjīvati bhārata ..
mṛto mṛta iti jñātvā kṣaṇātsneho nivartate .. 3 ..
4.184.d:
तावत्स बंधुः स पिता यावज्जीवति भारत ॥
मृतो मृत इति ज्ञात्वा क्षणात्स्नेहो निवर्तते ॥ 3 ॥
4.184.m: He is a kinsman, he is a father, only so long as he lives, O descendant of Bharata; / knowing that the dead is dead, affection ceases in an instant.

4.184.s:
tasmātsvayaṃ pradātavyaṃ śayyābhojyajalādikam ..
ātmaiva hyātmano bandhuriti saṃciṃtya cetasi .. 4 ..
4.184.d:
तस्मात्स्वयं प्रदातव्यं शय्याभोज्यजलादिकम् ॥
आत्मैव ह्यात्मनो बन्धुरिति संचिंत्य चेतसि ॥ 4 ॥
4.184.m: Therefore, one should give a bed, food, water, and so forth oneself, / reflecting in one's heart: “The self indeed is the friend of the self.”

4.184.s:
ātmaiva yo hi nātmānaṃ dānabhogaiḥ samarcayet ..
ko'nyo hitatarastasmātkaḥ paścātpūjayiṣyati .. 5 ..
4.184.d:
आत्मैव यो हि नात्मानं दानभोगैः समर्चयेत् ॥
कोऽन्यो हिततरस्तस्मात्कः पश्चात्पूजयिष्यति ॥ 5 ॥
4.184.m: For whoever does not worship his own self with gifts and enjoyments— / who else is more beneficial than he himself? Who will worship him afterwards?

4.184.s:
tasmācchayyāṃ samāsādya sāradārumayīṃ dṛḍhām ..
daṃtapatracitāṃ ramyāṃ himapaṭṭairalaṃkṛtām .. 6 ..
4.184.d:
तस्माच्छय्यां समासाद्य सारदारुमयीं दृढाम् ॥
दंतपत्रचितां रम्यां हिमपट्टैरलंकृताम् ॥ 6 ॥
4.184.m: Therefore, having obtained a bed made of solid wood, sturdy, / charming, inlaid with ivory plaques, adorned with fine white silks,

4.184.s:
haṃsatūlīpraticchannāṃ subhagāṃ sopadhānikām ..
pracchādanapaṭīyuktāṃ gaṃdhadhūpādhivāsitām .. 7 ..
4.184.d:
हंसतूलीप्रतिच्छन्नां सुभगां सोपधानिकाम् ॥
प्रच्छादनपटीयुक्तां गंधधूपाधिवासिताम् ॥ 7 ॥
4.184.m: covered with swansdown, beautiful, provided with pillows, / furnished with a bedspread, perfumed with fragrant incense,

4.184.s:
tasyāṃ saṃsthāpayeddhaimaṃ hariṃ lakṣmīsamanvitam ..
ucchīrṣake dhṛtaṃ caiva kalaśaṃ parikalpayet .. 8 ..
4.184.d:
तस्यां संस्थापयेद्धैमं हरिं लक्ष्मीसमन्वितम् ॥
उच्छीर्षके धृतं चैव कलशं परिकल्पयेत् ॥ 8 ॥
4.184.m: upon it one should place a golden Hari accompanied by Lakṣmī, / and at the head of the bed one should arrange a pot placed [there].

4.184.s:
vijñeyaṃ pāṃḍava sadā sanidrākalpakaṃ budhaiḥ ..
tāṃbūlaṃ kuṃkumakṣodakarpūrāgaru caṃdanam .. 9 ..
4.184.d:
विज्ञेयं पांडव सदा सनिद्राकल्पकं बुधैः ॥
तांबूलं कुंकुमक्षोदकर्पूरागरु चंदनम् ॥ 9 ॥
4.184.m: It should always be understood by the wise, O Pāṇḍava, as equipped for sleep: / betel, saffron powder, camphor, agallochum, sandalwood,

4.184.s:
dīpakopānahacchatracāmarāsanabhojanam ..
pārśveṣu sthāpayecchaktyā saptadhānyāni caiva hi .. 4.184.10 ..
4.184.d:
दीपकोपानहच्छत्रचामरासनभोजनम् ॥
पार्श्वेषु स्थापयेच्छक्त्या सप्तधान्यानि चैव हि ॥ 4.184.10 ॥
4.184.m: a lamp, sandals, a royal parasol, a chowrie, a seat, and food; / and on the sides, according to one's means, one should place the seven grains,

4.184.s:
śayanasthasya bhavati yadanyadupakārakam ..
bhṛṃgārakādyapuṣpāṇi paṃcavarṇavitānakam .. 11 ..
4.184.d:
शयनस्थस्य भवति यदन्यदुपकारकम् ॥
भृंगारकाद्यपुष्पाणि पंचवर्णवितानकम् ॥ 11 ॥
4.184.m: and whatever else is useful to one lying on a bed: / ewers and other vessels, flowers, and a canopy of five colours.

4.184.s:
śayyāmevaṃvidhāṃ kṛtvā brāhmaṇāyopadāpayet ..
sapatnīkāya saṃpūjya puṇye'hni vidhipūrvakam .. 12 ..
4.184.d:
शय्यामेवंविधां कृत्वा ब्राह्मणायोपदापयेत् ॥
सपत्नीकाय संपूज्य पुण्येऽह्नि विधिपूर्वकम् ॥ 12 ॥
4.184.m: Having prepared such a bed, on an auspicious day, / having worshipped [it] according to rule, one should present it to a brāhmaṇa together with his wife.

4.184.s:
namaste sarvadeveśa śayyādānaṃ kṛtaṃ mayā ..
dehi tasmācchāṃtiphalaṃ namaste puruṣottama .. 13 ..
4.184.d:
नमस्ते सर्वदेवेश शय्यादानं कृतं मया ॥
देहि तस्माच्छांतिफलं नमस्ते पुरुषोत्तम ॥ 13 ॥
4.184.m: “Homage to you, O Lord of all the gods! The gift of a bed has been made by me; / therefore grant me the fruit of peace. Homage to you, O Supreme Person!

4.184.s:
yathā na kṛṣṇa śayanaṃ śūnyaṃ sāgarajātayā ..
śayyā mamāpyaśūnyāstu tathā janmanijanmani .. 14 ..
4.184.d:
यथा न कृष्ण शयनं शून्यं सागरजातया ॥
शय्या ममाप्यशून्यास्तु तथा जन्मनिजन्मनि ॥ 14 ॥
4.184.m: Just as your couch, O Kṛṣṇa, is never bereft of her who was born from the ocean, / likewise may my bed also not be bereft [of a spouse] birth after birth.”

4.184.s:
dattvaivaṃ talpamamalaṃ praṇipatya visarjayet ..
ekādaśāhe'pi tathā vidhireṣa prakīrtitaḥ .. 15 ..
4.184.d:
दत्त्वैवं तल्पममलं प्रणिपत्य विसर्जयेत् ॥
एकादशाहेऽपि तथा विधिरेष प्रकीर्तितः ॥ 15 ॥
4.184.m: Having thus given the spotless bed, bowing down, he should dismiss [the brāhmaṇa]. / This rite is also proclaimed for the eleventh day [after death].

4.184.s:
dadāti yadi dharmārthaṃ mānavo bāṃdhave mṛte ..
viśeṣaṃ cātra rājeṃdra kathyamānaṃ nibodha me .. 16 ..
4.184.d:
ददाति यदि धर्मार्थं मानवो बांधवे मृते ॥
विशेषं चात्र राजेंद्र कथ्यमानं निबोध मे ॥ 16 ॥
4.184.m: If a man gives it for the sake of religious merit when a kinsman has died, / understand from me the special rule mentioned here, O lord of kings:

4.184.s:
tenopabhuktaṃ yadvastu kiṃcitpūrvaṃ gṛhe satā ..
tadgātralagnaṃ ca tathā vastravāhanabhājanam .. 17 ..
4.184.d:
तेनोपभुक्तं यद्वस्तु किंचित्पूर्वं गृहे सता ॥
तद्गात्रलग्नं च तथा वस्त्रवाहनभाजनम् ॥ 17 ॥
4.184.m: Whatever article was previously enjoyed in the house by that good person, / and likewise whatever was worn on his body—garments, conveyances, vessels—

4.184.s:
yadiṣṭaṃ ca tathāsyāsīttatsarvaṃ parikalpayet ..
sa eva puruṣo haimastasyāṃtaṃ sthāpayettathā .. 18 ..
4.184.d:
यदिष्टं च तथास्यासीत्तत्सर्वं परिकल्पयेत् ॥
स एव पुरुषो हैमस्तस्यांतं स्थापयेत्तथा ॥ 18 ॥
4.184.m: and whatever was dear to him, all that one should arrange. / Likewise, that same golden figure of a man one should place near it.

4.184.s:
pūjayitvā pradātavyo mṛtaśayyā yathoditā ..
svarge puraṃdaragṛhe sūryaputrālayetha vā .. 19 ..
4.184.d:
पूजयित्वा प्रदातव्यो मृतशय्या यथोदिता ॥
स्वर्गे पुरंदरगृहे सूर्यपुत्रालयेथ वा ॥ 19 ॥
4.184.m: Having worshipped [it], the bed of the deceased should be given as prescribed. / In heaven, in the house of Purandara or in the abode of the son of Sūrya,

4.184.s:
sukhaṃ vasatyasau jaṃtuḥ śayyādānaprabhāvataḥ ..
pīḍayaṃti na taṃ yāmyāḥ puruṣā bhīṣaṇānanāḥ .. 4.184.20 ..
4.184.d:
सुखं वसत्यसौ जंतुः शय्यादानप्रभावतः ॥
पीडयंति न तं याम्याः पुरुषा भीषणाननाः ॥ 4.184.20 ॥
4.184.m: that creature dwells happily by the power of the gift of a bed. / The attendants of Yama with terrifying faces do not afflict him.

4.184.s:
na dharmeṇa na śītena bādhyate sa naraḥ kvacit ..
api pāpasamāyuktaḥ svargaloke mahīyate .. 21 ..
4.184.d:
न धर्मेण न शीतेन बाध्यते स नरः क्वचित् ॥
अपि पापसमायुक्तः स्वर्गलोके महीयते ॥ 21 ॥
4.184.m: That man is never troubled by heat or by cold; / even if burdened with sin, he is honoured in the heavenly world.

4.184.s:
vimānavaramārūḍhaḥ sevyamānopsarogaṇaiḥ ..
ābhūtasaṃplavaṃ yāvattiṣṭhetpātakavarjitaḥ .. 22 ..
4.184.d:
विमानवरमारूढः सेव्यमानोप्सरोगणैः ॥
आभूतसंप्लवं यावत्तिष्ठेत्पातकवर्जितः ॥ 22 ॥
4.184.m: Mounted upon an excellent celestial chariot, attended by hosts of apsarases, / freed from sins, he shall remain [there] until the dissolution of all beings.

4.184.s:
śayyāpradānamamalaṃ tava pāṃḍuputrasaṃkīrtitaṃ sakalasaukhyānidhānametat ..
tayo dadāti vidhivatsvayameva nāke talpe vikalparahitaḥ sa vibhāti satyam .. 23 ..
ātmapratidānavidhivarṇanam
4.184.d:
शय्याप्रदानममलं तव पांडुपुत्रसंकीर्तितं सकलसौख्यानिधानमेतत् ॥
तयो ददाति विधिवत्स्वयमेव नाके तल्पे विकल्परहितः स विभाति सत्यम् ॥ 23 ॥
आत्मप्रतिदानविधिवर्णनम्
4.184.m:
This spotless gift of a bed, the repository of all happiness, has been proclaimed to you, O son of Pāṇḍu; / he who gives it according to rule himself shines free from doubt on a couch in heaven—this is the truth.
Description of the Rules for the Gift of an Effigy of Oneself

4.185.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
ātmapratikṛtirnāma yathoktaṃ kasyacitpurā ..
tatte'haṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi dānaṃ mānavivardhanam .. 1 ..
4.185.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
आत्मप्रतिकृतिर्नाम यथोक्तं कस्यचित्पुरा ॥
तत्तेऽहं संप्रवक्ष्यामि दानं मानविवर्धनम् ॥ 1 ॥
4.185.m:
Śrī Kṛṣṇa said:
I shall explain to you that gift known as the effigy of oneself, / which enhances honour, as it was declared to someone in the past.

4.185.s:
dānakālaḥ sadā tasya munibhiḥ parikīrtitaḥ ..
puṇyaiḥ puṇyadinaṃ pārtha prāpyate jīvitairna ca .. 2 ..
4.185.d:
दानकालः सदा तस्य मुनिभिः परिकीर्तितः ॥
पुण्यैः पुण्यदिनं पार्थ प्राप्यते जीवितैर्न च ॥ 2 ॥
4.185.m: The proper time for giving it has always been declared by the sages; / an auspicious day, O son of Pṛthā, is obtained by merits, not merely by being alive.

4.185.s:
lohajāṃ prakṛtiṃ bhavyāṃ kārayitvātmano nṛpa ..
abhīṣṭavāhanagatāmiṣṭālaṃkārasaṃyutām .. 3 ..
4.185.d:
लोहजां प्रकृतिं भव्यां कारयित्वात्मनो नृप ॥
अभीष्टवाहनगतामिष्टालंकारसंयुताम् ॥ 3 ॥
4.185.m: Having caused a handsome image of oneself to be made of iron, O king, / mounted on a preferred conveyance, adorned with desired ornaments,
accompanied by favourite attendants, equipped with all implements, / then covered with garments of fine silk, adorned with gems,

4.185.s:
kuṃkumenānuliptāṃgīṃ karpūrāguruvāsitām ..
strī ceddadāti śayane śayitāṃ kārayetsvayam .. 5 ..
4.185.d:
कुंकुमेनानुलिप्तांगीं कर्पूरागुरुवासिताम् ॥
स्त्री चेद्ददाति शयने शयितां कारयेत्स्वयम् ॥ 5 ॥
4.185.m: its limbs anointed with saffron, perfumed with camphor and agallochum— / if a woman gives it, she should have it made lying on a bed.

4.185.s:
yadyadiṣṭatamaṃ kiṃcittatsarvaṃ pārśvato nyaset ..
upakārakaraṃ strīṇāṃ svaśarīre ca yadbhavet .. 6 ..
4.185.d:
यद्यदिष्टतमं किंचित्तत्सर्वं पार्श्वतो न्यसेत् ॥
उपकारकरं स्त्रीणां स्वशरीरे च यद्भवेत् ॥ 6 ॥
4.185.m: Whatever is most beloved, all that should be placed at its side, / and whatever is useful to women and for one's own body,

4.185.s:
tatsarvaṃ sthāpayetpārśve svayaṃ saṃciṃtya cetasi ..
etatsarvaṃ melayitvā svesve sthāne nidhāya ca .. 7 ..
4.185.d:
तत्सर्वं स्थापयेत्पार्श्वे स्वयं संचिंत्य चेतसि ॥
एतत्सर्वं मेलयित्वा स्वेस्वे स्थाने निधाय च ॥ 7 ॥
4.185.m: all that one should place at its side, having reflected in one's mind. / Having gathered all this together and set it each in its place,

4.185.s:
pūjayitvā lokapālāngṛhāndevīṃ vināyakam ..
tata śuklāṃbaraḥ snātvā gṛhītakusumāṃjaliḥ .. 8 ..
4.185.d:
पूजयित्वा लोकपालान्गृहान्देवीं विनायकम् ॥
तत शुक्लांबरः स्नात्वा गृहीतकुसुमांजलिः ॥ 8 ॥
4.185.m: and having worshipped the world protectors, the planets, the Goddess, and Vināyaka, / then, dressed in white garments, having bathed and taken a folded-handful of flowers,

4.185.s:
imamuccārayenmaṃtraṃ viprasya purato budhaḥ ..
ātmanaḥ pratimā ceyaṃ sarvopakaraṇairyutā .. 9 ..
4.185.d:
इममुच्चारयेन्मंत्रं विप्रस्य पुरतो बुधः ॥
आत्मनः प्रतिमा चेयं सर्वोपकरणैर्युता ॥ 9 ॥
4.185.m: the wise person should recite this mantra before the brāhmaṇa: / “This image of myself, equipped with all articles,

4.185.s:
sarvaratnasamāyuktā tava vipra niveditā ..
ātmā śaṃbhuḥ śivaḥ śauriḥ śakraḥ suragaṇairvṛtaḥ .. 4.185.10 ..
4.185.d:
सर्वरत्नसमायुक्ता तव विप्र निवेदिता ॥
आत्मा शंभुः शिवः शौरिः शक्रः सुरगणैर्वृतः ॥ 4.185.10 ॥
4.185.m: furnished with all gems, is presented to you, O brāhmaṇa. / The Self is Śambhu, Śiva, Śauri, and Śakra surrounded by the hosts of gods.

4.185.s:
tasmādātmapradānena mamātmā suprasīdatu ..
ityuccārya tato dadyādbrāhmaṇāya yudhiṣṭhira .. 11 ..
4.185.d:
तस्मादात्मप्रदानेन ममात्मा सुप्रसीदतु ॥
इत्युच्चार्य ततो दद्याद्ब्राह्मणाय युधिष्ठिर ॥ 11 ॥
4.185.m: Therefore, by the gift of myself, may my Self be well pleased!” / Having recited this, one should then give it to a brāhmaṇa, O Yudhiṣṭhira.

4.185.s:
brāhmaṇaścāpi gṛhṇīyātkodāditi ca kīrtayan ..
tataḥ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya praṇipatya visarjayet .. 12 ..
4.185.d:
ब्राह्मणश्चापि गृह्णीयात्कोदादिति च कीर्तयन् ॥
ततः प्रदक्षिणीकृत्य प्रणिपत्य विसर्जयेत् ॥ 12 ॥
4.185.m: And the brāhmaṇa should accept it, uttering “Who gave [it]?” / Then, having circumambulated him and bowed down, he should dismiss him.

4.185.s:
vidhinānena rājendra dānametatprayacchati ..
yaḥ pumānatha vā nārī śṛṇuyātphalamāpnuyāt .. 13 ..
4.185.d:
विधिनानेन राजेन्द्र दानमेतत्प्रयच्छति ॥
यः पुमानथ वा नारी शृणुयात्फलमाप्नुयात् ॥ 13 ॥
4.185.m: Whatever man or woman offers this gift according to this rule, O lord of kings, / or hears of it, shall obtain the fruit:

4.185.s:
sāgraṃ varṣaśataṃ divyaṃ svargaloke surairvṛtaḥ ..
abhīṣṭaphaladānena hyabhīṣṭaphalabhāgbhavet .. 14 ..
4.185.d:
साग्रं वर्षशतं दिव्यं स्वर्गलोके सुरैर्वृतः ॥
अभीष्टफलदानेन ह्यभीष्टफलभाग्भवेत् ॥ 14 ॥
4.185.m: Surrounded by gods in the heavenly world for more than a hundred divine years, / by giving the desired fruit he shall indeed become a partaker of the desired fruit.

4.185.s:
yatraivotpadyate jaṃtuḥ prāpte karmakṣaye punaḥ ..
tatraiva sarvakāmānāṃ phalabhāgbhavate nṛpaḥ .. 15 ..
4.185.d:
यत्रैवोत्पद्यते जंतुः प्राप्ते कर्मक्षये पुनः ॥
तत्रैव सर्वकामानां फलभाग्भवते नृपः ॥ 15 ॥
4.185.m: Wherever that creature is reborn when his store of karma is exhausted, / there he becomes a king who enjoys the fruit of all desires.

4.185.s:
iṣṭabaṃdhujanaiḥ sārddhaṃ na viyogaṃ kadācana ..
prāpnoti puruṣo rājansvarge cānaṃtyamaśnute .. 16 ..
4.185.d:
इष्टबंधुजनैः सार्द्धं न वियोगं कदाचन ॥
प्राप्नोति पुरुषो राजन्स्वर्गे चानंत्यमश्नुते ॥ 16 ॥
4.185.m: A man never suffers separation from his beloved kinsfolk, O king, / and he attains endless [bliss] in heaven.

4.185.s:
yaścātmanaḥ pratikṛtiṃ varavāhanasthā haimīṃ vidhāya dhanadhānyasamākulāṃ ca ..
sopaskaraṃ dvijavarāya dadāti bhaktyā caṃdrārkavatsa divi bhāti hi rājarājaḥ .. 17 ..
hiraṇyāśvadānavidhivarṇanam
4.185.d:
यश्चात्मनः प्रतिकृतिं वरवाहनस्था हैमीं विधाय धनधान्यसमाकुलां च ॥
सोपस्करं द्विजवराय ददाति भक्त्या चंद्रार्कवत्स दिवि भाति हि राजराजः ॥ 17 ॥
हिरण्याश्वदानविधिवर्णनम्
4.185.m:
And he who makes an effigy of himself out of gold, mounted on an excellent vehicle, surrounded by wealth and grain, / and gives it with all its implements to an excellent twice-born with devotion, shines indeed like the sun and the moon in heaven as a king of kings.
Description of the Rule for the Gift of a Golden Horse

4.186.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
sāṃprataṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi hiraṇyāśvavidhiṃ param ..
yasya prasādātpuruṣaḥ śāśvataṃ phalamaśnute .. 1 ..
4.186.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
सांप्रतं संप्रवक्ष्यामि हिरण्याश्वविधिं परम् ॥
यस्य प्रसादात्पुरुषः शाश्वतं फलमश्नुते ॥ 1 ॥
4.186.m: The holy Kṛṣṇa said: / Now I shall fully explain the supreme rule of the golden horse, / by whose grace a man attains an everlasting fruit.

4.186.s:
puṇyaṃ dinamathāsādya pātraṃ vāpi guṇādhikam ..
śaktitastripalādūrdhvamāśatācca narottama .. 2 ..
4.186.d:
पुण्यं दिनमथासाद्य पात्रं वापि गुणाधिकम् ॥
शक्तितस्त्रिपलादूर्ध्वमाशताच्च नरोत्तम ॥ 2 ॥
4.186.m: Having reached an auspicious day, or finding a recipient of superior virtue, / [a horse should be made] according to one's means, from three palas up to a hundred, O best of men.

4.186.s:
khalīnālaṃkṛtamukhaṃ kārayeddhemavājinam ..
mukharaṃ sonnataskaṃdhaṃ dṛḍhajānuṃ savāladhim .. 3 ..
4.186.d:
खलीनालंकृतमुखं कारयेद्धेमवाजिनम् ॥
मुखरं सोन्नतस्कंधं दृढजानुं सवालधिम् ॥ 3 ॥
4.186.m: One should have a golden horse fashioned, its mouth adorned with a bridle, / neighing, with high shoulders, firm knees, and a tail.

4.186.s:
sthāpayedvedimadhye tu kṛṣṇājinatilopari ..
kauśeyavastrasaṃvītaṃ kuṃkumena vilepitam .. 4 ..
4.186.d:
स्थापयेद्वेदिमध्ये तु कृष्णाजिनतिलोपरि ॥
कौशेयवस्त्रसंवीतं कुंकुमेन विलेपितम् ॥ 4 ॥
4.186.m: One should place it in the middle of an altar, upon sesame seeds and a black antelope skin, / wrapped in a silk garment, and smeared with saffron.

4.186.s:
saṃpūjya kusumaiḥ śvetaiścaṇakānvinivedya ca ..
tataḥ parvasamīpe tu gṛhītakusumāṃjaliḥ .. 5 ..
4.186.d:
संपूज्य कुसुमैः श्वेतैश्चणकान्विनिवेद्य च ॥
ततः पर्वसमीपे तु गृहीतकुसुमांजलिः ॥ 5 ॥
4.186.m: Having worshipped it with white flowers and offered chickpeas, / then, close to the auspicious occasion, with folded hands holding flowers,

4.186.s:
imamuccārayenmaṃtraṃ purāṇoktaṃ yatavrataḥ ..
namaste sarvadeveśa vedāharaṇalaṃpaṭa .. 6 ..
4.186.d:
इममुच्चारयेन्मंत्रं पुराणोक्तं यतव्रतः ॥
नमस्ते सर्वदेवेश वेदाहरणलंपट ॥ 6 ॥
4.186.m: one who has restrained his vows should recite this mantra spoken in the Purāṇas: / 'Salutations to you, O Lord of all gods, eager to bring back the Vedas!

4.186.s:
vājirūpeṇa māmasmātpāhi saṃsārasāgarāt ..
tvameva saptadhā bhūtvā chaṃdorūpeṇa bhāskaram .. 7 ..
4.186.d:
वाजिरूपेण मामस्मात्पाहि संसारसागरात् ॥
त्वमेव सप्तधा भूत्वा छंदोरूपेण भास्करम् ॥ 7 ॥
4.186.m: In the form of a horse, protect me from this ocean of worldly existence! / You alone, having become sevenfold in the form of the metres, [protect] the Sun,

4.186.s:
yasmāddhārayase lokānataḥ pāhi sanātana ..
evamuccārya taṃ rājanviprāya pratipādayet .. 6 ..
4.186.d:
यस्माद्धारयसे लोकानतः पाहि सनातन ॥
एवमुच्चार्य तं राजन्विप्राय प्रतिपादयेत् ॥ 6 ॥
4.186.m: since you uphold the worlds; therefore, protect me, O Eternal One!' / Having spoken thus, O king, he should give it to a brāhmaṇa.

4.186.s:
pradakṣiṇaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā praṇipatya visarjayet ..
anena vidhinā rājanhiraṇyāśvama laṃkṛtam .. 9 ..
4.186.d:
प्रदक्षिणं ततः कृत्वा प्रणिपत्य विसर्जयेत् ॥
अनेन विधिना राजन्हिरण्याश्वम लंकृतम् ॥ 9 ॥
4.186.m: Then, having performed circumambulation and bowed down, he should dismiss [him]. / Having given a decorated golden horse according to this rule, O king,

4.186.s:
dattvā pāpakṣayādbhānorlokamāpnoti śāśvatam ..
tasminnahani bhuṃjīta tailakṣāravivarjitam .. 4.186.10 ..
4.186.d:
दत्त्वा पापक्षयाद्भानोर्लोकमाप्नोति शाश्वतम् ॥
तस्मिन्नहनि भुंजीत तैलक्षारविवर्जितम् ॥ 4.186.10 ॥
4.186.m: through the destruction of sins he attains the everlasting world of the Sun. / On that day he should eat food free from oil and alkaline substances.

4.186.s: purāṇaśravaṇaṃ tadvatkārayedbhojanādanu .. 11 ..
4.186.d: पुराणश्रवणं तद्वत्कारयेद्भोजनादनु ॥ 11 ॥
4.186.m: Likewise, after eating, he should arrange for the hearing of the Purāṇa.

4.186.s:
itthaṃ hiraṇyāśvavidhiṃ karoti yaḥ supuṇyamāsādya dinaṃ nareṃdra ..
vimuktapāpaḥ sa puraṃ murāreḥ prāpnoti siddhairabhipūjitaṃ yat.. 12 ..
4.186.d:
इत्थं हिरण्याश्वविधिं करोति यः सुपुण्यमासाद्य दिनं नरेंद्र ॥
विमुक्तपापः स पुरं मुरारेः प्राप्नोति सिद्धैरभिपूजितं यत्॥ 12 ॥
4.186.m: The man who, having reached a very auspicious day, performs the rule of the golden horse thus, O king, / is freed from sin and attains the city of Murāri, which is worshipped by the Siddhas.

4.186.s:
iti paṭhati ya itthaṃ haimavājipradānaṃ sakalakaluṣamuktaḥ so'śvayuktena bhūpaḥ ..
kanakamayavimānenārkalokaṃ prayātastridaśapativadhūbhiḥ pūjyate harmyabhogaiḥ .. 13 ..
4.186.d:
इति पठति य इत्थं हैमवाजिप्रदानं सकलकलुषमुक्तः सोऽश्वयुक्तेन भूपः ॥
कनकमयविमानेनार्कलोकं प्रयातस्त्रिदशपतिवधूभिः पूज्यते हर्म्यभोगैः ॥ 13 ॥
4.186.m: The king who thus recites [the rule of] the gift of a golden horse, freed from all blemishes, / goes to the world of the Sun in a golden celestial chariot drawn by horses, and is revered by the wives of the lord of the thirty [gods] with the pleasures of palaces.

4.186.s:
yo vā śṛṇoti puruṣo'pyatha vā smaredvā haimāśvadānamabhinaṃdati dīyamānam ..
so'pi prayāti hatakalmaṣaśuddhadehaḥ sthānaṃ puraṃdaramahe śvaralokajuṣṭam .. 14 .. ..
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
puṇyā mahānavamyasti tithīnāṃ pravarā tithiḥ..
sānuṣṭheyā suraiḥ sarvaiḥ prajāpālairviśeṣataḥ..1..
bhavānutthāpayetpārtha saṃvatsarasukhāya vai ..
bhūtapretapiśācānāṃ prītyarthaṃ cotsavāya vā .. 2 ..
.. yudhiṣṭhira uvāca .. ..
kasmātkālātpravṛtteyaṃ navamī mahaśabdayuk ..
kimādāvupānno'sti bhagavannavamīvidhiḥ .. 3 ..
yaśodāgarbhasaṃbhūteruta yātrā pravartate ..
utāho pṛrvamevāsītkṛtatretāyugādiṣu ..4..
yadasyāṃ prāṇinaḥ kecinmanyaṃte ghātayaṃti ca ..
hatānāṃ prāṇināṃ teṣāṃ kā gatiḥ pāralaukikī .. 5 ..
svayaṃ ghnatāṃ ghātayatāmanumodayatāṃ tathā ..
etanme saṃśayaṃ pūrvaṃ vaktumarhasi keśava .. 6 ..
4.186.d:
यो वा शृणोति पुरुषोऽप्यथ वा स्मरेद्वा हैमाश्वदानमभिनंदति दीयमानम् ॥
सोऽपि प्रयाति हतकल्मषशुद्धदेहः स्थानं पुरंदरमहे श्वरलोकजुष्टम् ॥ 14 ॥ ॥
श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
पुण्या महानवम्यस्ति तिथीनां प्रवरा तिथिः॥
सानुष्ठेया सुरैः सर्वैः प्रजापालैर्विशेषतः॥1॥
भवानुत्थापयेत्पार्थ संवत्सरसुखाय वै ॥
भूतप्रेतपिशाचानां प्रीत्यर्थं चोत्सवाय वा ॥ 2 ॥
॥ युधिष्ठिर उवाच ॥ ॥
कस्मात्कालात्प्रवृत्तेयं नवमी महशब्दयुक् ॥
किमादावुपान्नोऽस्ति भगवन्नवमीविधिः ॥ 3 ॥
यशोदागर्भसंभूतेरुत यात्रा प्रवर्तते ॥
उताहो पृर्वमेवासीत्कृतत्रेतायुगादिषु ॥4॥
यदस्यां प्राणिनः केचिन्मन्यंते घातयंति च ॥
हतानां प्राणिनां तेषां का गतिः पारलौकिकी ॥ 5 ॥
स्वयं घ्नतां घातयतामनुमोदयतां तथा ॥
एतन्मे संशयं पूर्वं वक्तुमर्हसि केशव ॥ 6 ॥
4.186.m:
Or the man who hears it, or remembers it, or rejoices in the gift of a golden horse being given, / he too, his sins destroyed and his body purified, goes to the place frequented by the worlds of Purandara and Maheśvara.
The holy Kṛṣṇa said: / The holy Mahānavamī is the most excellent lunar day among lunar days; / it should be observed by all gods, and especially by rulers of subjects.
You should celebrate it, O Pārtha, for the happiness of the year, / and for the pleasure of ghosts, pretas, and piśācas, or as a festival.
Yudhiṣṭhira said: / From what time did this navamī bearing the word 'mahā' begin? / O Blessed One, was the rule of navamī introduced at the beginning?
Did this procession begin from the birth from Yaśodā's womb, / or did it already exist in the Kṛta, Tretā, and other yugas?
Since on this [day] some revere living beings and slaughter them, / what is the otherworldly destiny of those slaughtered creatures?
And what of those who kill them themselves, those who have them killed, and those who approve? / You ought first to resolve this doubt of mine, O Keśava.

4.186.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
pārtha yā paramā śaktiranaṃtā lokaviśrutā ..
ādyā sarvagatā śuddhā bhāva gamyā manoharā .. 7 ..
ādyāṣṭamī kalākālī dvitīyā sarvamaṃgalā ..
māyā kātyāyanī durgā cāmuṃḍā śaṃkarapriyā .. 8 ..
dhyāyaṃti yāṃ yogaratāṃ sā devī parameśvarī ..
rūpabhedairnāmabhedairbhavānī pūjyate śivā..9..
aṣṭamyāṃ tu navamyāṃ tu devadānavarākṣasaiḥ..
gaṃdharvairuragairyajñaiḥ pūjyate kinnarairnaraiḥ..10..
anyeṣvapi yugeṣvādau sṛṣṭeḥ pūrvaṃ pradarśitā..
pūjyateyaṃ purā devī tebhyaḥ pūrvataraiḥ śubhaiḥ..11..
āśvayukśuklapakṣe ca yāṣṭamī mūla saṃyutā ..
sā mahānavamī nāma trailokye'pi sudurlabhā .. 12 ..
kanyāgate savitari śuklapakṣe'ṣṭamī tu yā ..
mūlanakṣatrasaṃyuktā sā mahānavamī smṛtā .. 13 ..
4.186.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
पार्थ या परमा शक्तिरनंता लोकविश्रुता ॥
आद्या सर्वगता शुद्धा भाव गम्या मनोहरा ॥ 7 ॥
आद्याष्टमी कलाकाली द्वितीया सर्वमंगला ॥
माया कात्यायनी दुर्गा चामुंडा शंकरप्रिया ॥ 8 ॥
ध्यायंति यां योगरतां सा देवी परमेश्वरी ॥
रूपभेदैर्नामभेदैर्भवानी पूज्यते शिवा॥9॥
अष्टम्यां तु नवम्यां तु देवदानवराक्षसैः॥
गंधर्वैरुरगैर्यज्ञैः पूज्यते किन्नरैर्नरैः॥10॥
अन्येष्वपि युगेष्वादौ सृष्टेः पूर्वं प्रदर्शिता॥
पूज्यतेयं पुरा देवी तेभ्यः पूर्वतरैः शुभैः॥11॥
आश्वयुक्शुक्लपक्षे च याष्टमी मूल संयुता ॥
सा महानवमी नाम त्रैलोक्येऽपि सुदुर्लभा ॥ 12 ॥
कन्यागते सवितरि शुक्लपक्षेऽष्टमी तु या ॥
मूलनक्षत्रसंयुक्ता सा महानवमी स्मृता ॥ 13 ॥
4.186.m:
The holy Kṛṣṇa said: / O Pārtha, that supreme power which is endless, famed throughout the world, / primeval, all-pervading, pure, accessible through devotion, and enchanting,
is the first aṣṭamī, the digit, Kālī; the second is Sarvamaṅgalā, / Māyā, Kātyāyanī, Durgā, Cāmuṇḍā, beloved of Śaṅkara.
She whom those devoted to yoga meditate upon is the goddess Parameśvarī; / through different forms and different names, Bhavānī, Śivā, is worshipped.
On the aṣṭamī and on the navamī, she is worshipped by gods, dānavas, and rākṣasas, / by gandharvas, serpents, yakṣas, kinnaras, and men.
In other yugas as well, revealed at the beginning before creation, / this goddess was worshipped of old by the auspicious ones who came before them.
And in the bright fortnight of Āśvayuja, that aṣṭamī which is conjoined with Mūla / is called Mahānavamī, very difficult to obtain even in the three worlds.
When the sun has entered Virgo, that aṣṭamī in the bright fortnight / which is conjoined with the lunar mansion Mūla is known as Mahānavamī.

4.186.s:
aṣṭamyāṃ ca navamyāṃ ca jaganmātaramambikām ..
pūjayitvā''śvine māsi viśoko jayati dviṣaḥ .. 14 ..
4.186.d:
अष्टम्यां च नवम्यां च जगन्मातरमम्बिकाम् ॥
पूजयित्वा'ऽश्विने मासि विशोको जयति द्विषः ॥ 14 ॥
4.186.m: Having worshipped the mother of the universe, Ambikā, on the aṣṭamī and on the navamī / in the month of Āśvina, one becomes free of sorrow and conquers one's enemies.

4.186.s:
saṃtarjayaṃtī huṃkāraiḥ khaḍgādibhiraharniśam ..
navamyāṃ pūjitā devī dadāti navamaṃ phalam .. 15 ..
4.186.d:
संतर्जयंती हुंकारैः खड्गादिभिरहर्निशम् ॥
नवम्यां पूजिता देवी ददाति नवमं फलम् ॥ 15 ॥
4.186.m: Terrifying [enemies] day and night with hum-cries and swords and other weapons, / the goddess, worshipped on the navamī, grants a fresh fruit.

4.186.s:
sā puṇyā sā pavitrā ca sā dharmasukhadāyinī ..
tasmātsadā pūjanīyā cāmuṃḍā muṃḍamālinī .. 16 ..
4.186.d:
सा पुण्या सा पवित्रा च सा धर्मसुखदायिनी ॥
तस्मात्सदा पूजनीया चामुंडा मुंडमालिनी ॥ 16 ॥
4.186.m: She is meritorious, she is purifying, she is the giver of virtue and happiness; / therefore, Cāmuṇḍā, garlanded with severed heads, should always be worshipped.

4.186.s:
tasyāṃ yadyupayujyaṃte prāṇino mahiṣādayaḥ ..
sarve te svargatiṃ yāṃti ghnatāṃ pāpaṃ na vidyate .. 17 ..
4.186.d:
तस्यां यद्युपयुज्यंते प्राणिनो महिषादयः ॥
सर्वे ते स्वर्गतिं यांति घ्नतां पापं न विद्यते ॥ 17 ॥
4.186.m: If on that [day] creatures such as buffaloes are employed [in sacrifice], / they all go to heaven, and no sin accrues to those who slaughter them.

4.186.s:
na tathā balidānena puṣpadhūpavilepanaiḥ ..
yathā saṃtuṣyate loke mahiṣairviṃdhyavāsinī .. 18 ..
4.186.d:
न तथा बलिदानेन पुष्पधूपविलेपनैः ॥
यथा संतुष्यते लोके महिषैर्विंध्यवासिनी ॥ 18 ॥
4.186.m: Not by animal sacrifice, flowers, incense, or unguents / is Vindhyavāsinī so pleased in the world as she is with buffaloes.

4.186.s:
uddiśya durgāṃ hanyaṃte vidhānādye'tra jaṃtavaḥ ..
svargaṃ te yāṃti kauṃteya ghātayaṃto'pi bhaktiḥ .. 19 ..
4.186.d:
उद्दिश्य दुर्गां हन्यंते विधानाद्येऽत्र जंतवः ॥
स्वर्गं ते यांति कौंतेय घातयंतोऽपि भक्तिः ॥ 19 ॥
4.186.m: Those creatures that are slain here in accordance with the rule in dedication to Durgā / go to heaven, O son of Kuntī, as do those who have them slain with devotion.

4.186.s:
bhavānīprāṅgaṇe prāṇā yeṣāṃ yātā yudhiṣṭhira ..
teṣāṃ svarge dhruvaṃ vāso varāste'pyarasāṃ priyāḥ .. 20 ..
4.186.d:
भवानीप्राङ्गणे प्राणा येषां याता युधिष्ठिर ॥
तेषां स्वर्गे ध्रुवं वासो वरास्तेऽप्यरसां प्रियाः ॥ 20 ॥
4.186.m: Those whose lives depart in the courtyard of Bhavānī, O Yudhiṣṭhira, / have their dwelling assured in heaven, and they become the beloved husbands of apsarases.

4.186.s:
manvantareṣu sarveṣu kalpeṣu kurunadana ..
teṣu sarveṣu caivāsannavamīyaṃ purārcitā .. 21 ..
4.186.d:
मन्वन्तरेषु सर्वेषु कल्पेषु कुरुनदन ॥
तेषु सर्वेषु चैवासन्नवमीयं पुरार्चिता ॥ 21 ॥
4.186.m: In all the manvantaras and kalpas, O delight of the Kurus, / in all of them this navamī was worshipped of old.

4.186.s:
prasiddhānādinidhanā varṣevarṣe yudhiṣṭhira ..
bhūyobhūyo'vatāraiśca bhavānīpūjya tesuraiḥ .. 22 ..
4.186.d:
प्रसिद्धानादिनिधना वर्षेवर्षे युधिष्ठिर ॥
भूयोभूयोऽवतारैश्च भवानीपूज्य तेसुरैः ॥ 22 ॥
4.186.m: Renowned, without beginning or end, year after year, O Yudhiṣṭhira, / through repeated incarnations, Bhavānī is worshipped by the gods.

4.186.s:
avatīrṇā bhuvi sadā nityaṃ daityanibarhiṇī ..
svargapātālamartyeṣu karoti sthitipālanam .. 23 ..
4.186.d:
अवतीर्णा भुवि सदा नित्यं दैत्यनिबर्हिणी ॥
स्वर्गपातालमर्त्येषु करोति स्थितिपालनम् ॥ 23 ॥
4.186.m: Ever descended to the earth, constantly destroying the Daityas, / she maintains the preservation of the worlds in heaven, the netherworld, and the mortal realm.

4.186.s:
punaścaiṣā mahādevī yaśodā garbhasaṃbhavā ..
kaṃsāsurasyottamāṅge pādaṃ dattvā gatāyuṣaḥ .. 24 ..
4.186.d:
पुनश्चैषा महादेवी यशोदा गर्भसंभवा ॥
कंसासुरस्योत्तमाङ्गे पादं दत्त्वा गतायुषः ॥ 24 ॥
4.186.m: And once again this great goddess was born from the womb of Yaśodā, / placing her foot on the head of the asura Kaṃsa whose lifespan had expired.

4.186.s:
tataḥ prabhṛti lokeṣu yaśodānaṃdadāyinīm ..
viṃdhyācale sthāpayitvā punaḥ pūjā pravartitā .. 25 ..
4.186.d:
ततः प्रभृति लोकेषु यशोदानंददायिनीम् ॥
विंध्याचले स्थापयित्वा पुनः पूजा प्रवर्तिता ॥ 25 ॥
4.186.m: From then on, having established on the Vindhya mountain her who gives joy to Yaśodā, / her worship was once again set in motion throughout the worlds.

4.186.s:
pūrvapravṛddho'pi punarbhaginyā mahimā kṛtaḥ ..
bhuvi sarvopakārāya sarvopadravaśāṃtaye .. 26 ..
4.186.d:
पूर्वप्रवृद्धोऽपि पुनर्भगिन्या महिमा कृतः ॥
भुवि सर्वोपकाराय सर्वोपद्रवशांतये ॥ 26 ॥
4.186.m: Though already flourishing from of old, the greatness of the sister was established once more / on earth for the benefit of all and for the pacification of all afflictions.

4.186.s:
evaṃ viṃdhyopavāsinyā navarātropavāsinaḥ ..
ekarātreṇa naktena svaśaktyā'yācitena vā .. 27 ..
4.186.d:
एवं विंध्योपवासिन्या नवरात्रोपवासिनः ॥
एकरात्रेण नक्तेन स्वशक्त्याऽयाचितेन वा ॥ 27 ॥
4.186.m: In this manner, by fasting during the Navarātra for Vindhyavāsinī, / or by a single night's fast, by a nocturnal meal, or by unasked-for food according to one's capacity,

4.186.s:
yajanairyājanairdevāḥ sthānesthāne purepure ..
gṛhegṛhe bhaktipare rgrāmegrāme vanevane .. 28 ..
4.186.d:
यजनैर्याजनैर्देवाः स्थानेस्थाने पुरेपुरे ॥
गृहेगृहे भक्तिपरे र्ग्रामेग्रामे वनेवने ॥ 28 ॥
4.186.m: with sacrifices and officiations, the gods [are worshipped] in every place, every city, / every house, devoted to piety, in every village, and in every forest,

4.186.s:
snātaiḥ pramuditairhṛṣṭairbrāhmaṇaiḥ kṣatriyairnṛpaiḥ ..
vaiśyaiḥ śūdrairbhakticitrairmlecchairanyaiśca mānavaiḥ .. 29 ..
4.186.d:
स्नातैः प्रमुदितैर्हृष्टैर्ब्राह्मणैः क्षत्रियैर्नृपैः ॥
वैश्यैः शूद्रैर्भक्तिचित्रैर्म्लेच्छैरन्यैश्च मानवैः ॥ 29 ॥
4.186.m: by Brahmins, Kṣatriyas, and kings, bathed, delighted, and joyful, / by Vaiśyas, Śūdras filled with devotion, Mlecchas, and other men,

4.186.s:
strībhiśca kuruśārdūla tadvidhānamidaṃ śṛṇu ..
jayābhilāṣī nṛpatiḥ pratipatprabhṛtikramāt .. 30 ..
4.186.d:
स्त्रीभिश्च कुरुशार्दूल तद्विधानमिदं शृणु ॥
जयाभिलाषी नृपतिः प्रतिपत्प्रभृतिक्रमात् ॥ 30 ॥
4.186.m: and by women, O tiger among the Kurus! Listen to this procedure for it: / A king desirous of victory, starting in sequence from the first lunar day,

4.186.s:
lohābhihārikaṃ karma kārayedyāvadaṣṭami ..
prāgudakpravaṇe deśe patākābhiralaṃkṛtam .. 31 ..
4.186.d:
लोहाभिहारिकं कर्म कारयेद्यावदष्टमि ॥
प्रागुदक्प्रवणे देशे पताकाभिरलंकृतम् ॥ 31 ॥
4.186.m: should have the iron-lustration rite performed up until the aṣṭamī. / In an area sloping towards the northeast, decorated with banners,

4.186.s:
maṇḍapaṃ kārayeddivyaṃ navasaptakaraṃ varam ..
āgneyyāṃ kārayetkuṇḍaṃ hastamātraṃ suśobhanam .. 32 ..
4.186.d:
मण्डपं कारयेद्दिव्यं नवसप्तकरं वरम् ॥
आग्नेय्यां कारयेत्कुण्डं हस्तमात्रं सुशोभनम् ॥ 32 ॥
4.186.m: he should have an excellent, splendid pavilion constructed, nine cubits by seven. / In the south-east he should have a sacrificial pit made, measuring a cubit, very beautiful,

4.186.s:
mekhalātrayasaṃ yuktaṃ yonyaśvatthadalābhayā ..
rājacihnāni sarvāṇi śastrāṇyastrāṇi yāni ca .. 33 ..
4.186.d:
मेखलात्रयसं युक्तं योन्यश्वत्थदलाभया ॥
राजचिह्नानि सर्वाणि शस्त्राण्यस्त्राणि यानि च ॥ 33 ॥
4.186.m: furnished with three step-tiers, having a vulva-spout shaped like a leaf of the sacred fig tree. / All the insignia of royalty, and whatever weapons and missiles there are,

4.186.s:
ānīya maṇḍape tāni sarvāṇyevādhivāsayet ..
tatastu brāhmaṇaḥ snātaḥ śuklāṃbaradharaḥ śuciḥ.. 34 ..
4.186.d:
आनीय मण्डपे तानि सर्वाण्येवाधिवासयेत् ॥
ततस्तु ब्राह्मणः स्नातः शुक्लांबरधरः शुचिः॥ 34 ॥
4.186.m: having brought them into the pavilion, he should consecratedly seat them all. / Then a Brahmin, bathed, wearing white garments, pure,

4.186.s:
oṃkārapūrvakairmantraistalliṃgairjuhuyādghṛtam..
lohanāmābhavatpūrvaṃ dānavastu mahābalaḥ .. 35 ..
4.186.d:
ओंकारपूर्वकैर्मन्त्रैस्तल्लिंगैर्जुहुयाद्घृतम्॥
लोहनामाभवत्पूर्वं दानवस्तु महाबलः ॥ 35 ॥
4.186.m: should offer clarified butter with mantras preceded by Om and bearing their respective marks. / Formerly there was a Danava named Loha of great strength;

4.186.s:
sa devaiḥ samare kruddhairbahudhā śakalīkṛtaḥ ..
tadaṃgasambhavaṃ lohaṃ yatsarvaṃdṛśyate kṣitau .. 36 ..
4.186.d:
स देवैः समरे क्रुद्धैर्बहुधा शकलीकृतः ॥
तदंगसम्भवं लोहं यत्सर्वंदृश्यते क्षितौ ॥ 36 ॥
4.186.m: he was hacked into many pieces by the enraged gods in battle. / From his body arose all the iron that is seen upon the earth.

4.186.s:
śastrāstramantrairhotavyaṃ pāyasaṃ ghṛtasaṃyutam ..
hutaśeṣaṃ turaṃgāṇāṃ gajānāmupahārayet .. 37 ..
4.186.d:
शस्त्रास्त्रमन्त्रैर्होतव्यं पायसं घृतसंयुतम् ॥
हुतशेषं तुरंगाणां गजानामुपहारयेत् ॥ 37 ॥
4.186.m: One should offer into the fire milk-rice mixed with clarified butter, accompanied by mantras for weapons and missiles; / the remainder of the offering he should present to the horses and elephants.

4.186.s:
lohābhihārikaṃ karma tenaitadṛṣibhiḥ smṛtam ..
baddhapratiśaravyaṃ ca gajāśvasamalaṃkṛtam .. 38 ..
4.186.d:
लोहाभिहारिकं कर्म तेनैतदृषिभिः स्मृतम् ॥
बद्धप्रतिशरव्यं च गजाश्वसमलंकृतम् ॥ 38 ॥
4.186.m: Therefore this has been declared by the sages as the iron-lustration rite. / Having mounted a dummy target, adorned with elephants and horses,

4.186.s:
bhrāmayennagare nityaṃ naṃdi ghoṣapurassaram..
pratyahaṃ nṛpatiḥ snātvā saṃpūjya pitṛdevatāḥ .. 39 ..
4.186.d:
भ्रामयेन्नगरे नित्यं नंदि घोषपुरस्सरम्॥
प्रत्यहं नृपतिः स्नात्वा संपूज्य पितृदेवताः ॥ 39 ॥
4.186.m: he should process through the city daily, preceded by joyful sounding. / Daily the king, having bathed and worshipped the ancestors and deities,

4.186.s:
pūjayedrājacihnāni phalamālyānulepanaiḥ ..
hutaśeṣaṃ pradātavyamaupanāyanike dvije .. 40 ..
4.186.d:
पूजयेद्राजचिह्नानि फलमाल्यानुलेपनैः ॥
हुतशेषं प्रदातव्यमौपनायनिके द्विजे ॥ 40 ॥
4.186.m: should worship the insignia of royalty with fruits, garlands, and ointments. / The remainder of the offering should be given to an initiated twice-born Brahmin;

4.186.s:
tasyābhiharaṇādrājño vijayaḥ samudāhṛtaḥ ..
pūjāmaṃtrānpravakṣyāmi purāṇoktānahaṃ tava .. 41 ..
4.186.d:
तस्याभिहरणाद्राज्ञो विजयः समुदाहृतः ॥
पूजामंत्रान्प्रवक्ष्यामि पुराणोक्तानहं तव ॥ 41 ॥
4.186.m: by its presentation, victory for the king is proclaimed. / I shall declare to you the mantras for worship proclaimed in the Purāṇas,

4.186.s:
yaiḥ pūjitāḥ prayacchanti kīrtimāyu ryaśobalama..
yathāṃbudaśchādayati śivāyemāṃ vasundharām .. 42 ..
4.186.d:
यैः पूजिताः प्रयच्छन्ति कीर्तिमायु र्यशोबलम॥
यथांबुदश्छादयति शिवायेमां वसुन्धराम् ॥ 42 ॥
4.186.m: worshipped with which they bestow renown, long life, fame, and strength: / 'Just as the cloud covers this earth for its welfare,

4.186.s:
tathācchādaya rājānaṃ vijayārogyavṛddhaye .. ( iti chatramantraḥ) ..
gandharva kulajātastvaṃ mābhūyāḥ kuladūṣakaḥ .. 43 ..
4.186.d:
तथाच्छादय राजानं विजयारोग्यवृद्धये ॥ ( इति छत्रमन्त्रः) ॥
गन्धर्व कुलजातस्त्वं माभूयाः कुलदूषकः ॥ 43 ॥
4.186.m: so cover the king for the increase of victory and health.' (Thus the royal parasol mantra.) / 'You are born from the lineage of the Gandharvas; do not become a disgrace to your race!

4.186.s:
brahmaṇaḥ satyavākyena somasya varuṇasya ca ..
prabhāvāñca hutāśasya varddhasva tvaṃ turaṃgama .. 44 ..
4.186.d:
ब्रह्मणः सत्यवाक्येन सोमस्य वरुणस्य च ॥
प्रभावाञ्च हुताशस्य वर्द्धस्व त्वं तुरंगम ॥ 44 ॥
4.186.m: By the truthful word of Brahmā, of Soma, and of Varuṇa, / and by the power of the Fire-god, may you thrive, O horse!

4.186.s:
tejasā caiva sūryasya munīnāṃ tapasā yathā ..
rudrasya brahmacaryeṇa pavanasya valena ca.. smṛ ..
smara tvaṃ rājaputro'si kaustubhaṃ ca maṇiṃ smara ..
yāṃ gatiṃ brahmahā gacchetpitṛhā mātṛhā tathā .. 46 ..
4.186.d:
तेजसा चैव सूर्यस्य मुनीनां तपसा यथा ॥
रुद्रस्य ब्रह्मचर्येण पवनस्य वलेन च॥ स्मृ ॥
स्मर त्वं राजपुत्रोऽसि कौस्तुभं च मणिं स्मर ॥
यां गतिं ब्रह्महा गच्छेत्पितृहा मातृहा तथा ॥ 46 ॥
4.186.m: Just as by the splendour of the Sun, the asceticism of the sages, / the celibacy of Rudra, and the strength of the Wind— / remember: you are a prince! Remember the Kaustubha jewel! / Whatever destination a killer of a Brahmin reaches, or a killer of a father or mother,

4.186.s:
bhūmyarthenṛtavādī ca kṣatriyaśca parāṅmukhaḥ ..
sūryācandramasau vāyuḥ pāvakaśca na yatra vai .. 47..
4.186.d:
भूम्यर्थेनृतवादी च क्षत्रियश्च पराङ्मुखः ॥
सूर्याचन्द्रमसौ वायुः पावकश्च न यत्र वै ॥ 47॥
4.186.m: or a liar for the sake of land, or a Kṣatriya who turns his back in flight— / where there is neither sun nor moon, neither wind nor fire—

4.186.s:
vrajecca tāṃ gatiṃ kṣipraṃ tacca pāpaṃ bhavetkila ..
vikṛtiṃ yadi gacchestvaṃ yuddhedhvani turaṃgama ..
ripūnvijitya samare saha bhartrā sukhī bhava .. 48 .... .. ( ityaśvamaṃtraḥ) .. ..
4.186.d:
व्रजेच्च तां गतिं क्षिप्रं तच्च पापं भवेत्किल ॥
विकृतिं यदि गच्छेस्त्वं युद्धेध्वनि तुरंगम ॥
रिपून्विजित्य समरे सह भर्त्रा सुखी भव ॥ 48 ॥॥ ॥ ( इत्यश्वमंत्रः) ॥ ॥
4.186.m: may you swiftly go to that destination, and indeed may that sin be yours, / if you should falter in battle or on the march, O horse! / Having conquered your enemies in battle, be happy together with your master!' (Thus the horse mantra.)

4.186.s:
śakraketo mahāvīrya suparṇastvayyupasthitaḥ ..
patatrirāḍvainateyastathā nārāyaṇadhvajaḥ .. 49 ..
4.186.d:
शक्रकेतो महावीर्य सुपर्णस्त्वय्युपस्थितः ॥
पतत्रिराड्वैनतेयस्तथा नारायणध्वजः ॥ 49 ॥
4.186.m: 'O banner of Indra of great heroism! The fair-winged Garuḍa is present upon you, / the king of birds, son of Vinatā, and the emblem of Nārāyaṇa,

4.186.s:
kāśyapeyo'mṛto jñeyo nāgārirviṣṇuvāhanaḥ ..
aprameyo durādharṣo devaśatruniṣūdanaḥ .. 50 ..
4.186.d:
