āyudhaṃ cādhivāsaśca tasmācchāntiṃ dadātu me .. 21 ..
4.190.d:
विश्वचक्रमिदं यस्मात्सर्वपापहरं हरेः ॥
आयुधं चाधिवासश्च तस्माच्छान्तिं ददातु मे ॥ 21 ॥
4.190.m: Since this Viśvacakra of Hari, which takes away all sins, / is both his weapon and his abode, therefore may it grant me peace.”

4.190.s:
ityāmaṃtrya ca yo dadyādviśvacakraṃ vimatsaraḥ ..
vimuktaḥ sarvapāpebhyo viṣṇuloke mahīyate .. 22 ..
4.190.d:
इत्यामंत्र्य च यो दद्याद्विश्वचक्रं विमत्सरः ॥
विमुक्तः सर्वपापेभ्यो विष्णुलोके महीयते ॥ 22 ॥
4.190.m: Having thus addressed it, he who gives the Viśvacakra without envy, / freed from all sins, is glorified in the world of Viṣṇu.

4.190.s:
vaikuṇṭhalokamāsādya caturbāhunarāvṛtam ..
sevyate'psarasāṃ saṃghaistiṣṭhetkalpaśatatrayam .. 23 ..
4.190.d:
वैकुण्ठलोकमासाद्य चतुर्बाहुनरावृतम् ॥
सेव्यतेऽप्सरसां संघैस्तिष्ठेत्कल्पशतत्रयम् ॥ 23 ॥
4.190.m: Having attained the world of Vaikuṇṭha, surrounded by four-armed men, / he is attended by hosts of apsarases and remains there for three hundred kalpas.

4.190.s:
praṇamedvātha yaḥ kṛtvā viśvacakraṃ dinedine ..
tasyāyurvarddhate dīrghaṃ lakṣmīstu vipulā bhavet .. 24 ..
4.190.d:
प्रणमेद्वाथ यः कृत्वा विश्वचक्रं दिनेदिने ॥
तस्यायुर्वर्द्धते दीर्घं लक्ष्मीस्तु विपुला भवेत् ॥ 24 ॥
4.190.m: Or he who, having fashioned the Viśvacakra, bows to it day by day, / his life-span increases long and his fortune becomes vast.

4.190.s:
tasmāccakraṃ sadā kāryaṃ dhāryaṃ ca svagṛhe naraiḥ ..
kāṃcanaṃ vātha raupyaṃ vā tadabhāve'tha tāmrajam .. 25 ..
4.190.d:
तस्माच्चक्रं सदा कार्यं धार्यं च स्वगृहे नरैः ॥
कांचनं वाथ रौप्यं वा तदभावेऽथ ताम्रजम् ॥ 25 ॥
4.190.m: Therefore, men should always fashion the wheel and keep it in their house, / either of gold or of silver, or in the absence of that, made of copper.

4.190.s:
iti sakalajagatsurādhivāsaṃ vitarati yastapanīyaṣoḍaśāram ..
haribhuvanagataḥ sa siddhasaṃghaiściramadhigamya namasyate'psarobhiḥ .. 26 ..
4.190.d:
इति सकलजगत्सुराधिवासं वितरति यस्तपनीयषोडशारम् ॥
हरिभुवनगतः स सिद्धसंघैश्चिरमधिगम्य नमस्यतेऽप्सरोभिः ॥ 26 ॥
4.190.m: He who thus presents the golden sixteen-spoked [wheel], the abode of all gods of the universe, / having gone to the world of Hari and met with hosts of siddhas, is bowed to for a long time by apsarases.

4.190.s:
atha sudarśanatāṃ prayāti śatrormadanasudarśanatāṃ ca kāminībhyaḥ ..
sa sudarśanakeśavānurūpaḥ kanakasudarśanadānadagdhapāpaḥ .. 27 ..
4.190.d:
अथ सुदर्शनतां प्रयाति शत्रोर्मदनसुदर्शनतां च कामिनीभ्यः ॥
स सुदर्शनकेशवानुरूपः कनकसुदर्शनदानदग्धपापः ॥ 27 ॥
4.190.m: Then he becomes a fair sight for his enemy and a handsome sight like Love for longing women; / he becomes like Kesava of fair sight, his sins burned away by the gift of the golden Sudarśana.

4.190.s:
kṛtagurudurito'pi ṣoḍaśārapravitaraṇātpravarākṛtirmurāreḥ..
abhibhavati bhavodbhavāni bhittvā bhavamabhito bhavane bhavāni bhūyaḥ .. 28 .. ..
bhuvanapratiṣṭhāvarṇanam
4.190.d:
कृतगुरुदुरितोऽपि षोडशारप्रवितरणात्प्रवराकृतिर्मुरारेः॥
अभिभवति भवोद्भवानि भित्त्वा भवमभितो भवने भवानि भूयः ॥ 28 ॥ ॥
भुवनप्रतिष्ठावर्णनम्
4.190.m:
Even if he has committed grave sins, having attained the excellent form of Murāri through the gift of the sixteen-spoked [wheel], / he breaks through the worldly conditions born of existence and repeatedly overcomes them everywhere in the world.
Description of the Consecration of the Worlds

4.191.s:
.. yudhiṣṭhira uvāca .. ..
pratiṣṭhā śāśvatī kena dānena madhusūdana ..
iha loke pare caiva kīrtiratyadbhutā tathā ..1..
4.191.d:
॥ युधिष्ठिर उवाच ॥ ॥
प्रतिष्ठा शाश्वती केन दानेन मधुसूदन ॥
इह लोके परे चैव कीर्तिरत्यद्भुता तथा ॥1॥
4.191.m: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / By what gift, O Madhusūdana, is there eternal establishment / and most wondrous fame in this world and the next,

4.191.s:
sadgatiṃ ca tathā yāṃti sarve pitṛpitāmahāḥ ..
saṃtatiścākṣayā loke vibhavaścāpi puṣkalaḥ ..2..
4.191.d:
सद्गतिं च तथा यांति सर्वे पितृपितामहाः ॥
संततिश्चाक्षया लोके विभवश्चापि पुष्कलः ॥2॥
4.191.m: and all fathers and grandfathers go to a good destination, / and there is imperishable lineage and abundant prosperity in the world?

4.191.s:
sthāpanātsarvadevānāṃ kathaṃ syādyadunaṃdana ..
tadācakṣva mahābhāga dānena niyamena vā .. 3 ..
4.191.d:
स्थापनात्सर्वदेवानां कथं स्याद्यदुनंदन ॥
तदाचक्ष्व महाभाग दानेन नियमेन वा ॥ 3 ॥
4.191.m: How can it be through the establishment of all the gods, O Delighter of the Yadus? / Declare that, O fortunate one, whether through a gift or a restriction.

4.191.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
sādhu pṛṣṭaṃ tvayā rājam̐llokānāmupakārakam ..
śṛṇuṣvaikamanā bhūtvā guhyaṃ paramamuttamam.. ..4..
4.191.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
साधु पृष्टं त्वया राजम्̐ल्लोकानामुपकारकम् ॥
शृणुष्वैकमना भूत्वा गुह्यं परममुत्तमम्॥ ॥4॥
4.191.m: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / Well asked by you, O King, for the benefit of the worlds! / Listen with an attentive mind to this supreme, most excellent secret.

4.191.s:
bhuvanānāṃ samāsena pratiṣṭhāṃ kathayāmi te ..
devāsurāstathā nāgā gaṃdharvā yakṣarākṣasāḥ ..5..
4.191.d:
भुवनानां समासेन प्रतिष्ठां कथयामि ते ॥
देवासुरास्तथा नागा गंधर्वा यक्षराक्षसाः ॥5॥
4.191.m: I shall tell you in brief of the establishment of the worlds, / of gods and asuras, and likewise nāgas, gandharvas, yakṣas, and rākṣasas.

4.191.s:
pretāḥ piśācā bhūtāśca sthāpitāḥ syurna saṃśayaḥ..
kārakasyānukūle tu muhūrte vijaye śubhe ..6..
4.191.d:
प्रेताः पिशाचा भूताश्च स्थापिताः स्युर्न संशयः॥
कारकस्यानुकूले तु मुहूर्ते विजये शुभे ॥6॥
4.191.m:
pretas, piśācas, and ghosts are undoubtedly installed.
At a victorious, auspicious moment favourable to the patron,

4.191.s:
puṇye tithau śivakṣetre dine saumyagrahānvite ..
sapta hastaṃ paṭaṃ kṛtvā caturasraṃ susaṃhatam ..7..
4.191.d:
पुण्ये तिथौ शिवक्षेत्रे दिने सौम्यग्रहान्विते ॥
सप्त हस्तं पटं कृत्वा चतुरस्रं सुसंहतम् ॥7॥
4.191.m:
on an auspicious lunar day, in a sacred field of Śiva, on a day accompanied by auspicious planets,
having made a canvas seven cubits [in size], square and very compact,

4.191.s:
abhinnāṃgaṃ dṛḍhaṃ śuddhaṃ śuddhasphaṭikavarcasam ..
tasminsarvāṇi rājeṃdra bhuvanāni ca lekhayet .. 8 ..
4.191.d:
अभिन्नांगं दृढं शुद्धं शुद्धस्फटिकवर्चसम् ॥
तस्मिन्सर्वाणि राजेंद्र भुवनानि च लेखयेत् ॥ 8 ॥
4.191.m:
with unbroken fabric, firm, clean, and radiant like pure crystal,
upon it, O king of kings, he should cause all the worlds to be painted.

4.191.s:
cāturvarṇyakamānīya vicitraṃ citrakarmaṇi ..
yuvānaṃ vyādhirahitaṃ bhavyaṃ citrakaraṃ śubham .. 9 ..
4.191.d:
चातुर्वर्ण्यकमानीय विचित्रं चित्रकर्मणि ॥
युवानं व्याधिरहितं भव्यं चित्रकरं शुभम् ॥ 9 ॥
4.191.m:
Having brought four-coloured pigments and an expert painter,
young, free from disease, handsome, skilled, and auspicious,

4.191.s:
saṃpūjayitvā yatnena divyavāsovibhūṣaṇaiḥ ..
tasminkarmaṇi yuṃjīta paṭhyamānairdvijottamaiḥ .. 4.191.10 ..
4.191.d:
संपूजयित्वा यत्नेन दिव्यवासोविभूषणैः ॥
तस्मिन्कर्मणि युंजीत पठ्यमानैर्द्विजोत्तमैः ॥ 4.191.10 ॥
4.191.m:
having worshipped him carefully with divine garments and ornaments,
he should employ him in that task, while the best of twice-born [priests] recite.

4.191.s:
śaṃkhabherīninādaiśca gītamaṃgalanisvanaiḥ ..
puṇyāhajayaghoṣaiśca brāhmaṇānpūjyettataḥ .. 11 ..
4.191.d:
शंखभेरीनिनादैश्च गीतमंगलनिस्वनैः ॥
पुण्याहजयघोषैश्च ब्राह्मणान्पूज्येत्ततः ॥ 11 ॥
4.191.m:
With the sounds of conches and kettle-drums, with the auspicious sounds of songs,
and with the proclamation of an auspicious day and cries of victory, he should then worship the brāhmaṇas.

4.191.s:
ācāryamapi saṃpūjya vāsobhirbhūṣaṇaistathā ..
prāraṃbhaṃ kārayedrājanpaṭe tasminyathoditam .. 12 ..
4.191.d:
आचार्यमपि संपूज्य वासोभिर्भूषणैस्तथा ॥
प्रारंभं कारयेद्राजन्पटे तस्मिन्यथोदितम् ॥ 12 ॥
4.191.m:
Having also worshipped the preceptor with garments and ornaments,
he should cause the beginning [of the work] on that canvas to be made as prescribed, O king.

4.191.s:
madhye ca lekhayedrājañjaṃbūdvīpaṃ savistaram ..
tasya madhye sthito merurmerorupari devatāḥ ..13..
4.191.d:
मध्ये च लेखयेद्राजञ्जंबूद्वीपं सविस्तरम् ॥
तस्य मध्ये स्थितो मेरुर्मेरोरुपरि देवताः ॥13॥
4.191.m:
In the centre, O king, he should cause Jambūdvīpa to be painted in full detail;
in its centre stands Meru, and above Meru the deities.

4.191.s:
diśāsu lokapālānāṃ puro'ṣṭau surasaṃyutāḥ ..
saptadvīpavatī pṛthvī sapta caiva kulācalāḥ .. 14 ..
4.191.d:
दिशासु लोकपालानां पुरोऽष्टौ सुरसंयुताः ॥
सप्तद्वीपवती पृथ्वी सप्त चैव कुलाचलाः ॥ 14 ॥
4.191.m:
In the directions [are] the eight cities of the world protectors, accompanied by gods.
The earth has seven continents, and there are seven mountain ranges.

4.191.s:
sāgarāḥ sapta cātraiva nadyo hradāḥ sarāṃsi ca ..
pātālāḥ sapta cātraiva sapta svargavibhūtayaḥ .. 15 ..
4.191.d:
सागराः सप्त चात्रैव नद्यो ह्रदाः सरांसि च ॥
पातालाः सप्त चात्रैव सप्त स्वर्गविभूतयः ॥ 15 ॥
4.191.m:
Here too are the seven oceans, the rivers, lakes, and pools.
Here too are the seven underworlds and the seven heavenly splendours,

4.191.s:
brahmaviṣṇuśivādīnāṃ bhuvanāni yathākramam ..
dhruvamārgastathādityo grahatārāgaṇairyutaḥ .. 16 ..
4.191.d:
ब्रह्मविष्णुशिवादीनां भुवनानि यथाक्रमम् ॥
ध्रुवमार्गस्तथादित्यो ग्रहतारागणैर्युतः ॥ 16 ॥
4.191.m:
the worlds of Brahmā, Viṣṇu, Śiva, and others in due order,
the path of Dhruva, and the sun accompanied by the host of planets and stars,

4.191.s:
devadānavagandharvā yakṣa rākṣasapannagāḥ ..
ṛṣayo munayo gāvo devamātara eva ca ..17..
4.191.d:
देवदानवगन्धर्वा यक्ष राक्षसपन्नगाः ॥
ऋषयो मुनयो गावो देवमातर एव च ॥17॥
4.191.m:
gods, dānavas, gandharvas, yakṣas, rākṣasas, serpents,
ṛṣis, sages, cows, and the divine mothers,

4.191.s:
suparṇādyāśca vihagā nāgāścairāvatādayaḥ ..
diggajāṣṭakamatraiva lekhayenmadamaṃḍitam .. .. 18 ..
4.191.d:
सुपर्णाद्याश्च विहगा नागाश्चैरावतादयः ॥
दिग्गजाष्टकमत्रैव लेखयेन्मदमंडितम् ॥ ॥ 18 ॥
4.191.m:
birds such as eagles, and elephants such as Airāvata;
here too he should cause the group of eight directional elephants to be painted, adorned with temporal rut.

4.191.s:
evaṃvidhaṃ paṭaṃ rājankārayitvā suśobhanam ..
daśottareṇa payasā etatsarvasamāvṛtam .. 19 ..
4.191.d:
एवंविधं पटं राजन्कारयित्वा सुशोभनम् ॥
दशोत्तरेण पयसा एतत्सर्वसमावृतम् ॥ 19 ॥
4.191.m:
Having caused such a most splendid canvas to be made, O king,
all this is surrounded by water, tenfold [greater].

4.191.s:
tattejasā vṛtaṃ bhūyo mahatogreṇa sarvataḥ ..
tejastadvāyunā vāyurākāśena samāvṛtaḥ .. 4.191.20 ..
4.191.d:
तत्तेजसा वृतं भूयो महतोग्रेण सर्वतः ॥
तेजस्तद्वायुना वायुराकाशेन समावृतः ॥ 4.191.20 ॥
4.191.m:
That [water] is further surrounded on all sides by fierce, vast fire;
that fire is surrounded by wind, and the wind is surrounded by space.

4.191.s:
bhūtādinā tathākāśaṃ bhūtādirmahatā tathā ..
avyaktena mahāṃścaiva vyāpto vai śuddhilakṣaṇaḥ .. 21 ..
4.191.d:
भूतादिना तथाकाशं भूतादिर्महता तथा ॥
अव्यक्तेन महांश्चैव व्याप्तो वै शुद्धिलक्षणः ॥ 21 ॥
4.191.m:
Space is likewise surrounded by the origin of elements (ego), and the origin of elements by the great principle;
and the great principle, characterised by purity, is pervaded by the unmanifest.

4.191.s:
avyaktaṃ tamasā vyāptaṃ tamaśca rajasā tathā ..
rajaḥ sattvena saṃvyāptaṃ tridhā prakṛtirucyate .. 22 ..
4.191.d:
अव्यक्तं तमसा व्याप्तं तमश्च रजसा तथा ॥
रजः सत्त्वेन संव्याप्तं त्रिधा प्रकृतिरुच्यते ॥ 22 ॥
4.191.m:
The unmanifest is pervaded by darkness, and darkness likewise by passion;
passion is thoroughly pervaded by goodness; nature is said to be threefold.

4.191.s:
evamāvaraṇopetaṃ brahmāṃḍamakhilaṃ nṛpa ..
puruṣeṇāvṛtaṃ sarvaṃ sabāhyābhyaṃtaraṃ tathā .. 23 ..
4.191.d:
एवमावरणोपेतं ब्रह्मांडमखिलं नृप ॥
पुरुषेणावृतं सर्वं सबाह्याभ्यंतरं तथा ॥ 23 ॥
4.191.m:
Thus the entire cosmic egg is provided with coverings, O king;
all is pervaded by the Supreme Person, both externally and internally.

4.191.s:
etatsarvaṃ paṭasthaṃ tu kṛtvā citramayaṃ sudhīḥ ..
kārtikyāmayane caiva viṣuve grahaṇe'pi vā .. 24 ..
4.191.d:
एतत्सर्वं पटस्थं तु कृत्वा चित्रमयं सुधीः ॥
कार्तिक्यामयने चैव विषुवे ग्रहणेऽपि वा ॥ 24 ॥
4.191.m:
Having depicted all of this upon the canvas, full of paintings, the wise man,
on the full moon of Kārttika, at an equinox, a solstice, or during an eclipse,

4.191.s:
pūjayedyena vidhinā tatsamāsena me śṛṇu ..
purato maṃḍapaṃ tasya vicitraṃ kārayedbudhaḥ .. 25 ..
4.191.d:
पूजयेद्येन विधिना तत्समासेन मे शृणु ॥
पुरतो मंडपं तस्य विचित्रं कारयेद्बुधः ॥ 25 ॥
4.191.m:
should worship it according to the rite; listen to that in brief from me.
In front of it, the wise man should cause a splendid pavilion to be built.

4.191.s:
tatra kuṇḍāni catvāri caturasrāṇi kārayet ..
dvaudvau niyojayetteṣu brāhmaṇau vedapāragau .. 26 ..
4.191.d:
तत्र कुण्डानि चत्वारि चतुरस्राणि कारयेत् ॥
द्वौद्वौ नियोजयेत्तेषु ब्राह्मणौ वेदपारगौ ॥ 26 ॥
4.191.m:
There he should cause four square sacrificial pits to be made;
at each of them he should appoint two brāhmaṇas who have mastered the Vedas,

4.191.s:
yajñopakaraṇopetau vastrābharaṇabhūṣitau ..
homaṃ kuryurjitātmāno mauninaḥ sarva eva te .. 27 ..
4.191.d:
यज्ञोपकरणोपेतौ वस्त्राभरणभूषितौ ॥
होमं कुर्युर्जितात्मानो मौनिनः सर्व एव ते ॥ 27 ॥
4.191.m:
equipped with the implements of sacrifice, adorned with garments and ornaments.
Self-controlled and observant of silence, they all should perform the fire oblation

4.191.s:
paṭe sthitānāṃ devānāṃ maṃtrairoṃkārapūrvakaiḥ ..
yajamānastataḥ snātaḥ sarvālaṃkārabhūṣitaḥ .. 28 ..
4.191.d:
पटे स्थितानां देवानां मंत्रैरोंकारपूर्वकैः ॥
यजमानस्ततः स्नातः सर्वालंकारभूषितः ॥ 28 ॥
4.191.m:
to the deities present on the canvas with mantras preceded by the syllable Om.
Then the patron, having bathed and adorned with all ornaments,

4.191.s:
ācāryeṇasamaṃ kuryātpūjāmagre paṭasya tu ..
puṣpairvastraiḥ samabhyarcya maṃtrametamudīrayet .. 29 ..
4.191.d:
आचार्येणसमं कुर्यात्पूजामग्रे पटस्य तु ॥
पुष्पैर्वस्त्रैः समभ्यर्च्य मंत्रमेतमुदीरयेत् ॥ 29 ॥
4.191.m:
should perform the worship together with the preceptor in front of the canvas.
Having worshipped with flowers and garments, he should utter this mantra:

4.191.s:
brahmāṃḍodaravartīni bhuvanāni caturdaśa ..
tāni saṃnihitānyatra pūjitāni bhavaṃtu me .. 4.191.30 ..
4.191.d:
ब्रह्मांडोदरवर्तीनि भुवनानि चतुर्दश ॥
तानि संनिहितान्यत्र पूजितानि भवंतु मे ॥ 4.191.30 ॥
4.191.m:
“May the fourteen worlds residing within the womb of the cosmic egg,
present here, be worshipped by me!

4.191.s:
brahmā viṣṇustathā rudro hyādityā vasavastathā ..
pūjitāḥ supratiṣṭhāśca bhavaṃtu satataṃ mama .. 31 ..
4.191.d:
ब्रह्मा विष्णुस्तथा रुद्रो ह्यादित्या वसवस्तथा ॥
पूजिताः सुप्रतिष्ठाश्च भवंतु सततं मम ॥ 31 ॥
4.191.m:
May Brahmā, Viṣṇu, Rudra, the Ādityas, and the Vasus
be worshipped and well established for me always!”

4.191.s:
evaṃ paṭaṃ taṃ saṃpūjya kṛtvā caiva pradakṣiṇam ..
bhakṣyānnānāvidhāṃścaiva naivedyaṃ tatra dāpayet .. 32 ..
4.191.d:
एवं पटं तं संपूज्य कृत्वा चैव प्रदक्षिणम् ॥
भक्ष्यान्नानाविधांश्चैव नैवेद्यं तत्र दापयेत् ॥ 32 ॥
4.191.m:
Having thus worshipped that canvas and circumambulated it,
he should offer various kinds of edible foods as an oblation there.

4.191.s:
śaṃkhatūryaninādaiśca jāgaraṃ kārayettataḥ..
brahmaghoṣaivicitraiśca gītamaṃgalanisvanaiḥ .. 33 ..
4.191.d:
शंखतूर्यनिनादैश्च जागरं कारयेत्ततः॥
ब्रह्मघोषैविचित्रैश्च गीतमंगलनिस्वनैः ॥ 33 ॥
4.191.m:
Then he should keep a night vigil with the sounds of conches and musical instruments,
with diverse recitations of the Veda, and with auspicious sounds of singing.

4.191.s:
punaḥ prabhāte vimale snātvā śuciralaṃkṛtaḥ ..
pūrvoktavidhinānena punaḥ saṃpūjya taṃ paṭam .. 34 ..
4.191.d:
पुनः प्रभाते विमले स्नात्वा शुचिरलंकृतः ॥
पूर्वोक्तविधिनानेन पुनः संपूज्य तं पटम् ॥ 34 ॥
4.191.m:
Again at the clear daybreak, having bathed, pure and adorned,
having worshipped that canvas once more according to this aforementioned rule,

4.191.s:
ṛtvikpūjāṃ tataḥ kṛtvā gośatena vicakṣaṇaḥ ..
athavā goyugaṃ dadyādekaika syātyalaṃkṛtam .. 35 ..
4.191.d:
ऋत्विक्पूजां ततः कृत्वा गोशतेन विचक्षणः ॥
अथवा गोयुगं दद्यादेकैक स्यात्यलंकृतम् ॥ 35 ॥
4.191.m:
and then having performed the worship of the officiating priests with a hundred cows, the discerning man
may alternatively give a pair of cows, each one well adorned,

4.191.s:
upānahau tathā chatraṃ gṛhopakaraṇāni ca ..
yadyadiṣṭatamaṃ kiṃcitsarvaṃ dadyādvicakṣaṇaḥ .. 36 ..
4.191.d:
उपानहौ तथा छत्रं गृहोपकरणानि च ॥
यद्यदिष्टतमं किंचित्सर्वं दद्याद्विचक्षणः ॥ 36 ॥
4.191.m:
shoes, a royal parasol, household utensils,
and whatever is most dear; the discerning man should give all of it.

4.191.s:
tataḥ prakalpayedyānaṃ nāgayuktamalaṃkṛtam ..
alābhe vājisaṃyuktaṃ patākādhvajaśālinam ..37..
4.191.d:
ततः प्रकल्पयेद्यानं नागयुक्तमलंकृतम् ॥
अलाभे वाजिसंयुक्तं पताकाध्वजशालिनम् ॥37॥
4.191.m:
Then he should prepare a chariot harnessed to elephants, adorned,
or, in its absence, harnessed to horses, splendid with banners and flags.

4.191.s:
sahasraṃ dakṣiṇāṃ dattvā tatastvāropayetpaṭam ..
brāhmaṇaṃ vā rathenātha nayeddevālayaṃ budhaḥ .. 38 ..
4.191.d:
सहस्रं दक्षिणां दत्त्वा ततस्त्वारोपयेत्पटम् ॥
ब्राह्मणं वा रथेनाथ नयेद्देवालयं बुधः ॥ 38 ॥
4.191.m:
Having given a thousand [coins] as priestly fee, the wise man should then mount the canvas
or a brāhmaṇa upon the chariot and convey it to the temple.

4.191.s:
tatrasthaṃ sthāpayennītvā gandhaiḥ puṣpaiśca dhūpayet ..
tatrāpi dadayānnaivedyaṃ kuryāccāpi mahotsavam .. 39 ..
4.191.d:
तत्रस्थं स्थापयेन्नीत्वा गन्धैः पुष्पैश्च धूपयेत् ॥
तत्रापि ददयान्नैवेद्यं कुर्याच्चापि महोत्सवम् ॥ 39 ॥
4.191.m:
Bringing it there, he should install it, and perfume it with fragrant scents and flowers;
there too he should present food offerings and also celebrate a great festival.

4.191.s:
yasminnāyatane tasya pratiṣṭhā kriyate nṛpa ..
pūjā tatrāpi mahatī kartavyā bhūtimicchatā .. 4.191.40 ...
4.191.d:
यस्मिन्नायतने तस्य प्रतिष्ठा क्रियते नृप ॥
पूजा तत्रापि महती कर्तव्या भूतिमिच्छता ॥ 4.191.40 ॥।
4.191.m:
In whatever temple its installation is performed, O king,
a great worship should also be performed there by one who desires prosperity.

4.191.s:
caṃdrātapatraṃ ghaṇṭāṃ ca dhvajādyaṃ dāpayetsudhīḥ ..
yathāśaktyā ca rājendra guruṃ gauravayaṃtritaḥ .. 41 ..
4.191.d:
चंद्रातपत्रं घण्टां च ध्वजाद्यं दापयेत्सुधीः ॥
यथाशक्त्या च राजेन्द्र गुरुं गौरवयंत्रितः ॥ 41 ॥
4.191.m:
The wise man should present a moon-awning, a bell, flags, and so forth,
and according to his ability, O king of kings, constrained by respect for his guru,

4.191.s:
abhyarcya dakṣiṇābhiśca brāhmaṇāṃśca visarjayet ..'
dīnāṃdhakṛpaṇānāṃ ca bhojanaṃ cāpyavāritam .. 42 ..
4.191.d:
अभ्यर्च्य दक्षिणाभिश्च ब्राह्मणांश्च विसर्जयेत् ॥'
दीनांधकृपणानां च भोजनं चाप्यवारितम् ॥ 42 ॥
4.191.m:
having honoured the brāhmaṇas with priestly fees, he should dismiss them.
And unrestricted food for the poor, the blind, and the wretched

4.191.s:
tasminnahani dātavyaṃ mitrasvajanabaṃdhuṣu ..
anena vidhinā yastu śraddadhāno jitendriyaḥ .... .. 43 ..
4.191.d:
तस्मिन्नहनि दातव्यं मित्रस्वजनबंधुषु ॥
अनेन विधिना यस्तु श्रद्दधानो जितेन्द्रियः ॥॥ ॥ 43 ॥
4.191.m:
should be given on that day, as well as to friends, his own people, and relatives.
Whoever, full of faith and with senses subdued, according to this rule,

4.191.s:
kuryānnaro vā nārī vā pratiṣṭhāṃ sārvalaukikīm ..
sthāpitaṃ tu bhavettena trailokyaṃ sacarācaram .. 44 ..
4.191.d:
कुर्यान्नरो वा नारी वा प्रतिष्ठां सार्वलौकिकीम् ॥
स्थापितं तु भवेत्तेन त्रैलोक्यं सचराचरम् ॥ 44 ॥
4.191.m:
man or woman, performs this installation of all the worlds,
by that person the three worlds, moving and unmoving, will have been established.

4.191.s:
kulaṃ ca tāritaṃ tena satputreṇa yudhiṣṭhira ..
yāvacca devatāgāre paṭastiṣṭhati pūjitaḥ .. 45 ..
4.191.d:
कुलं च तारितं तेन सत्पुत्रेण युधिष्ठिर ॥
यावच्च देवतागारे पटस्तिष्ठति पूजितः ॥ 45 ॥
4.191.m:
And his lineage is redeemed by him as a true son, O Yudhiṣṭhira.
And for as long as the canvas remains worshipped in the temple,

4.191.s:
tāvadasyākṣayā kīrtistrailokye saṃprasarpati ..
dānena kīrtiryāvaṃti martyalokeṣu gīyate .. 46 ..
4.191.d:
तावदस्याक्षया कीर्तिस्त्रैलोक्ये संप्रसर्पति ॥
दानेन कीर्तिर्यावंति मर्त्यलोकेषु गीयते ॥ 46 ॥
4.191.m:
for so long does his imperishable fame spread through the three worlds.
For as many [years] as the fame of his gift is sung in the mortal world,

4.191.s:
tāvadvarṣasahasrāṇi svargaloke mahīyate ..
gandharvairgīyamānastu apsarogaṇasevitaḥ .. 47 ..
4.191.d:
तावद्वर्षसहस्राणि स्वर्गलोके महीयते ॥
गन्धर्वैर्गीयमानस्तु अप्सरोगणसेवितः ॥ 47 ॥
4.191.m:
for that many thousands of years he is exalted in the heavenly world.
Being praised in song by gandharvas and attended by hosts of apsarases,

4.191.s:
vaseddhṛṣṭamanāḥ svarge yāvadiṃdrāścatu rdaśa ..
puṇyakṣayādihābhyetya rājā bhavati dhārmikaḥ .. 48 ..
4.191.d:
वसेद्धृष्टमनाः स्वर्गे यावदिंद्राश्चतु र्दश ॥
पुण्यक्षयादिहाभ्येत्य राजा भवति धार्मिकः ॥ 48 ॥
4.191.m:
he would reside joyful in heaven for as long as fourteen Indras [endure].
Upon the exhaustion of his merit, returning here, he becomes a righteous king,

4.191.s:
putrapautrānvitaḥ śrīmāndīrghāyuratidhārmikaḥ ..
daśa janmāni rājendra jāyamānaḥ punaḥ punaḥ .. 49 ..
4.191.d:
पुत्रपौत्रान्वितः श्रीमान्दीर्घायुरतिधार्मिकः ॥
दश जन्मानि राजेन्द्र जायमानः पुनः पुनः ॥ 49 ॥
4.191.m:
endowed with sons and grandsons, prosperous, long-lived, and exceedingly righteous,
being born again and again for ten lifetimes, O king of kings.

4.191.s:
śrūyate ca purā rājā rajirnāma mahābalaḥ ..
cakravartī dṛḍhamatirjitārirvijiteṃdriyaḥ .. 4.191.50 ..
4.191.d:
श्रूयते च पुरा राजा रजिर्नाम महाबलः ॥
चक्रवर्ती दृढमतिर्जितारिर्विजितेंद्रियः ॥ 4.191.50 ॥
4.191.m:
And it is heard that formerly there was a mighty king named Raji,
an emperor of firm resolve, who conquered his enemies and subdued his senses.

4.191.s:
mahī yena purā dattā devarājasya saṃgare ..
jitvā daityabalaṃ sarvaṃ dattavāṃstridivaṃ punaḥ .. 51 ..
4.191.d:
मही येन पुरा दत्ता देवराजस्य संगरे ॥
जित्वा दैत्यबलं सर्वं दत्तवांस्त्रिदिवं पुनः ॥ 51 ॥
4.191.m: by whom the earth was formerly given to the king of the gods in battle, / and who, having defeated the entire army of the Daityas, gave heaven back again

4.191.s:
mahendrāya mahābhāga sarvaṃ nihatakaṃṭakam ..
sa kadācitsabhāmadhye yāvadāste mahī patiḥ .. 52 ..
4.191.d:
महेन्द्राय महाभाग सर्वं निहतकंटकम् ॥
स कदाचित्सभामध्ये यावदास्ते मही पतिः ॥ 52 ॥
4.191.m: to Mahendra, O fortunate one, entirely freed from thorns. / Once, while that lord of the earth was seated in the assembly,

4.191.s:
tāvattatrājagāmātha pulastyo brahmaṇaḥ sutaḥ..
śiṣyaiḥ parivṛtaḥ śrīmānvedavedāṃgapāragaiḥ .. 53 ..
4.191.d:
तावत्तत्राजगामाथ पुलस्त्यो ब्रह्मणः सुतः॥
शिष्यैः परिवृतः श्रीमान्वेदवेदांगपारगैः ॥ 53 ॥
4.191.m: Pulastya, the son of Brahmā, arrived there, / glorious, surrounded by disciples who had mastered the Vedas and Vedāṅgas.

4.191.s:
dattārghastu tadā tena upaviṣṭo varāsane .. (pāṭhā. dattārdhastu)
śuśubhe parayā lakṣmyā pitāmaha ivāparaḥ .. 54 ..
4.191.d:
दत्तार्घस्तु तदा तेन उपविष्टो वरासने ॥ (पाठा। दत्तार्धस्तु)
शुशुभे परया लक्ष्म्या पितामह इवापरः ॥ 54 ॥
4.191.m: Offered the water of hospitality by him, seated on an excellent seat, / he shone with supreme splendor like a second Grandfather.

4.191.s:
atha taṃ pūjayitvāgre madhuparkeṇa pārthivaḥ ..
papraccha vinayopetaḥ kathāmātmodbhavāṃ nṛpaḥ .. 55 ..
4.191.d:
अथ तं पूजयित्वाग्रे मधुपर्केण पार्थिवः ॥
पप्रच्छ विनयोपेतः कथामात्मोद्भवां नृपः ॥ 55 ॥
4.191.m: Then, having first honored him with the madhuparka offering, the king, / full of humility, asked about the story of his own past:

4.191.s:
bhagavankena dānena tapasā niyamena vā ..
śrīriyaṃ mama dharmajña tejaścāvyāhataṃ bhuvi .. 56 ..
4.191.d:
भगवन्केन दानेन तपसा नियमेन वा ॥
श्रीरियं मम धर्मज्ञ तेजश्चाव्याहतं भुवि ॥ 56 ॥
4.191.m: "O Lord, by what gift, austerity, or observance, / O knower of righteousness, have I attained this fortune and unhindered power on earth,

4.191.s:
balaṃ puṣṭiṃ dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ putrapautraṃ tathottamam ..
etanme sarvamācakṣva sarvajño'si dvijottama .. 57 ..
4.191.d:
बलं पुष्टिं धनं धान्यं पुत्रपौत्रं तथोत्तमम् ॥
एतन्मे सर्वमाचक्ष्व सर्वज्ञोऽसि द्विजोत्तम ॥ 57 ॥
4.191.m: strength, nourishment, wealth, grain, and excellent sons and grandsons? / Tell me all this, O best of the twice-born, for you are omniscient."

4.191.s:
.. pulastya uvāca .. ..
śṛṇu rājankathāmetāmātmīyāṃ sumanoharām ..
kathyamānāṃ mayā samyaksaptame tava janmani .. 58 ..
4.191.d:
॥ पुलस्त्य उवाच ॥ ॥
शृणु राजन्कथामेतामात्मीयां सुमनोहराम् ॥
कथ्यमानां मया सम्यक्सप्तमे तव जन्मनि ॥ 58 ॥
4.191.m: Pulastya said: / "Listen, O king, to this charming story of your own, / related accurately by me regarding your seventh birth.

4.191.s:
katheyamabhinirvṛttā śṛṇuṣvaiśvaryavarddhinīm ..
āsīstvaṃ vaiśyajātīyo vārāṇasyāṃ narottama .. .. 59 ..
4.191.d:
कथेयमभिनिर्वृत्ता शृणुष्वैश्वर्यवर्द्धिनीम् ॥
आसीस्त्वं वैश्यजातीयो वाराणस्यां नरोत्तम ॥ ॥ 59 ॥
4.191.m: Listen to this narrative that took place, which enhances sovereignty: / You were born into the Vaiśya caste in Vārāṇasī, O best of men,

4.191.s:
bahubhṛtyaparīvāro dhanadhānyasamanvitaḥ ..
dhārmikaḥ satyanirato vaṇigdharmarataḥ sadā .. 4.191.60 ..
4.191.d:
बहुभृत्यपरीवारो धनधान्यसमन्वितः ॥
धार्मिकः सत्यनिरतो वणिग्धर्मरतः सदा ॥ 4.191.60 ॥
4.191.m: surrounded by many servants and attendants, endowed with wealth and grain, / righteous, devoted to truth, and always dedicated to the duties of a merchant.

4.191.s:
tatra tvayā śrutā dharmā dharmākhyānagatena vai..
dānāśrayā bahuvidhā vratāni vividhāni ca .. 61 ..
4.191.d:
तत्र त्वया श्रुता धर्मा धर्माख्यानगतेन वै॥
दानाश्रया बहुविधा व्रतानि विविधानि च ॥ 61 ॥
4.191.m: There, having gone to an exposition of dharma, you heard of religious duties / of many kinds based on gifts, and diverse votive observances.

4.191.s:
prasaṃgena kadācicca pratiṣṭhā bhauvanī tvayā ..
śrutā rājendra vidhivatkṛtā ca bahupuṇyadā .. .. 62 ..
4.191.d:
प्रसंगेन कदाचिच्च प्रतिष्ठा भौवनी त्वया ॥
श्रुता राजेन्द्र विधिवत्कृता च बहुपुण्यदा ॥ ॥ 62 ॥
4.191.m: In that context, O king of kings, you heard of the dedication of a world-model, / and performed it according to rule, yielding great religious merit.

4.191.s:
phalena tena jāto'si sapta janmāni bhūpatiḥ ..
kīrtiste prathitā loke valaṃ cāpi mahattava .. 63 ..
4.191.d:
फलेन तेन जातोऽसि सप्त जन्मानि भूपतिः ॥
कीर्तिस्ते प्रथिता लोके वलं चापि महत्तव ॥ 63 ॥
4.191.m: By that fruit you have been born as a lord of the earth for seven births; / your fame is celebrated in the world, and your strength is vast.

4.191.s:
aparāṇyapi janmāni sapta rājā bhaviṣyasi ..
paścādyogikule bhūtvā nirvāṇaṃ samavāpsyasi .. 64 ..
4.191.d:
अपराण्यपि जन्मानि सप्त राजा भविष्यसि ॥
पश्चाद्योगिकुले भूत्वा निर्वाणं समवाप्स्यसि ॥ 64 ॥
4.191.m: For seven other births as well you will be a king; / afterwards, being born into a family of yogins, you will attain nirvāṇa.

4.191.s:
etatte sarvamākhyātaṃ yanmāṃ paripṛcchasi ..
nārī vā puruṣo vāpi pratiṣṭhāṃ bhauvanīṃ tu yaḥ .. 65 ..
4.191.d:
एतत्ते सर्वमाख्यातं यन्मां परिपृच्छसि ॥
नारी वा पुरुषो वापि प्रतिष्ठां भौवनीं तु यः ॥ 65 ॥
4.191.m: All this has been related to you, which you asked me. / Whatever woman or man, however, performs the dedication of a world-model

4.191.s:
prakaroti vidhānena kṛtakṛtyo bhavedbudhaḥ ..
ityuktvā sa munistatra rājānaṃ śaṃsitavrataḥ ..66..
4.191.d:
प्रकरोति विधानेन कृतकृत्यो भवेद्बुधः ॥
इत्युक्त्वा स मुनिस्तत्र राजानं शंसितव्रतः ॥66॥
4.191.m: according to the rules, that wise person will have fulfilled all duties." / Having spoken thus to the king there, the sage of honored vows

4.191.s: yayāvadarśanaṃ tatra sūrye vaiśvānaropamaḥ .. 67 ..
4.191.d: ययावदर्शनं तत्र सूर्ये वैश्वानरोपमः ॥ 67 ॥
4.191.m: disappeared from sight right there like the sun, resembling the fire of Agni.

4.191.s:
dharmaṃ vivarddhayati kīrtiṃ śatāni dhatte kāmaṃ prasādhayati pāpamapākaroti ..
khyātā mayeyamadhunā tava dānaniṣṭhā tannāsti yanna kurute bhuvanapratiṣṭhā ..68..
4.191.d:
धर्मं विवर्द्धयति कीर्तिं शतानि धत्ते कामं प्रसाधयति पापमपाकरोति ॥
ख्याता मयेयमधुना तव दाननिष्ठा तन्नास्ति यन्न कुरुते भुवनप्रतिष्ठा ॥68॥
4.191.m: It increases righteousness, secures hundreds of fames, accomplishes desire, and dispels sin; / this devotion to giving of yours has now been declared by me: there is nothing that the dedication of a world-model does not effect.

4.191.s:
iti śrībhaviṣye mahāpurāṇa uttaraparvaṇi śrīkṛṣṇayudhiṣṭhirasaṃvāde bhuvanapratiṣṭhāvarṇanaṃ nāmaikanavatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 191 .. ..
nakṣatradānavidhivarṇanam
4.191.d:
इति श्रीभविष्ये महापुराण उत्तरपर्वणि श्रीकृष्णयुधिष्ठिरसंवादे भुवनप्रतिष्ठावर्णनं नामैकनवत्युत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः ॥ 191 ॥ ॥
नक्षत्रदानविधिवर्णनम्
4.191.m:
Thus ends the one hundred and ninety-first chapter, entitled 'Description of the Dedication of a World-Model,' in the dialogue between Śrī Kṛṣṇa and Yudhiṣṭhira, in the Uttaraparvan of the glorious Bhaviṣya Mahāpurāṇa.
Description of the Rite of Giving According to Asterisms

4.192.s:
.. yudhiṣṭhira uvāca .. ..
śruto dānavidhiḥ sarvaḥ prasādātte ramādhava ..
nakṣatradānasyedānī dānakalpaṃ pracakṣva me .. 1 ..
4.192.d:
॥ युधिष्ठिर उवाच ॥ ॥
श्रुतो दानविधिः सर्वः प्रसादात्ते रमाधव ॥
नक्षत्रदानस्येदानी दानकल्पं प्रचक्ष्व मे ॥ 1 ॥
4.192.m: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / "All the rites of gift have been heard by me through your grace, O Lord of Ramā; / now tell me the rule of giving for the asterism gift."

4.192.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca ..
atrāpyudāharaṃtīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam ..
devakyāścaiva saṃvādaṃ devarṣernāradasya ca .. 2 ..
4.192.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥
अत्राप्युदाहरंतीममितिहासं पुरातनम् ॥
देवक्याश्चैव संवादं देवर्षेर्नारदस्य च ॥ 2 ॥
4.192.m: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / "In this connection they also cite this ancient history, / the conversation between Devakī and the divine sage Nārada.

4.192.s:
dvārakāmanusaṃjātaṃ nāradaṃ devadarśanam ..
papracchedaṃ tathā praśnaṃ devakī dharmadarśinī .. 3 ..
4.192.d:
द्वारकामनुसंजातं नारदं देवदर्शनम् ॥
पप्रच्छेदं तथा प्रश्नं देवकी धर्मदर्शिनी ॥ 3 ॥
4.192.m: To Nārada of divine sight, who had arrived at Dvārakā, / Devakī, perceiver of righteousness, addressed this question:

4.192.s:
tasyāḥ saṃpṛcchamānāyā devarṣirnāradastataḥ ..
ācaṣṭa vidhivatsarvaṃ yattacchṛṇu viśāṃpate .. 4 ..
4.192.d:
तस्याः संपृच्छमानाया देवर्षिर्नारदस्ततः ॥
आचष्ट विधिवत्सर्वं यत्तच्छृणु विशांपते ॥ 4 ॥
4.192.m: To her, as she was inquiring, the divine sage Nārada / then related everything according to rule; listen to that, O ruler of the people:

4.192.s:
nakṣatrayogaṃ vakṣyāmi sarvapātakanāśanam ..
kṛttikāsu mahābhāga pāyasena sasarpiṣā .. 5 ..
4.192.d:
नक्षत्रयोगं वक्ष्यामि सर्वपातकनाशनम् ॥
कृत्तिकासु महाभाग पायसेन ससर्पिषा ॥ 5 ॥
4.192.m: "I shall declare the conjunction of the asterisms, which destroys all sins. / Under Kṛttikā, O fortunate one, with milk-rice mixed with clarified butter,

4.192.s:
saṃtarpya brāhmaṇānsādhūm̐llokānprāpnotyanuttamān ..
rohiṇyāṃ pāṃḍavaśreṣṭha māṃsairannena sarpiṣā .. 6 ..
4.192.d:
संतर्प्य ब्राह्मणान्साधूम्̐ल्लोकान्प्राप्नोत्यनुत्तमान् ॥
रोहिण्यां पांडवश्रेष्ठ मांसैरन्नेन सर्पिषा ॥ 6 ॥
4.192.m: having gratified virtuous brāhmaṇas, one attains unsurpassed worlds. / Under Rohiṇī, O best of Pāṇḍavas, with meat, boiled rice, and clarified butter,

4.192.s:
saṃtarpya brāhmaṇānsādhūm̐llokānprāpnotyanuttamān ..
payo''nnadānaṃ dātavyamānṛṇyārthaṃ dvijātaye .. 7 ..
4.192.d:
संतर्प्य ब्राह्मणान्साधूम्̐ल्लोकान्प्राप्नोत्यनुत्तमान् ॥
पयो'ऽन्नदानं दातव्यमानृण्यार्थं द्विजातये ॥ 7 ॥
4.192.m: having gratified virtuous brāhmaṇas, one attains unsurpassed worlds; / a gift of milk and food should be given to a twice-born man to free oneself from debt.

4.192.s:
dogdhnīṃ savatsāṃ tu naro nakṣatre somadaivate ..
dattvā divyavimānasthaḥ svargaṃ prāpnotyanuttamam .. 8 ..
4.192.d:
दोग्ध्नीं सवत्सां तु नरो नक्षत्रे सोमदैवते ॥
दत्त्वा दिव्यविमानस्थः स्वर्गं प्राप्नोत्यनुत्तमम् ॥ 8 ॥
4.192.m: Giving a milch cow along with her calf under the asterism whose deity is Soma, / a person, seated in a celestial chariot, attains unsurpassed heaven.

4.192.s:
ārdrāyāṃ kṛśarāṃ dattvā tilamiśrā samāhitaḥ ..
narastarati durgāṇi sarvāṇyeva narottama .. 9 ..
4.192.d:
आर्द्रायां कृशरां दत्त्वा तिलमिश्रा समाहितः ॥
नरस्तरति दुर्गाणि सर्वाण्येव नरोत्तम ॥ 9 ॥
4.192.m: Having given kṛśarā mixed with sesame under Ārdrā with a collected mind, / a man crosses over all difficulties, O best of men.

4.192.s:
pūṣānpunarvasau dattvā ghṛtapūrṇānsupācitān ..
yaśasvī rūpasaṃpannaḥ sajjano jāyate kule .. 4.192.10 ..
4.192.d:
पूषान्पुनर्वसौ दत्त्वा घृतपूर्णान्सुपाचितान् ॥
यशस्वी रूपसंपन्नः सज्जनो जायते कुले ॥ 4.192.10 ॥
4.192.m: Having given cakes filled with clarified butter and well-cooked under Punarvasu, / one is born in a noble family, renowned, endowed with handsome form, and virtuous.

4.192.s:
puṣye tu kāṃcanaṃ dattvā kṛtaṃ vākṛtameva vā ..
anālokeṣu lokeṣu somavatsa virājate ..11..
4.192.d:
पुष्ये तु कांचनं दत्त्वा कृतं वाकृतमेव वा ॥
अनालोकेषु लोकेषु सोमवत्स विराजते ॥11॥
4.192.m: Giving gold, whether worked or unworked, under Puṣya, / one shines like the moon even in unlit worlds.

4.192.s:
āśleṣāsu tathā raupyaṃ yaḥ surūpaṃ prayacchati ..
sarvabhayavinirmuktaḥ śāstravānabhijāyate .. 12 ..
4.192.d:
आश्लेषासु तथा रौप्यं यः सुरूपं प्रयच्छति ॥
सर्वभयविनिर्मुक्तः शास्त्रवानभिजायते ॥ 12 ॥
4.192.m: Likewise, he who gives handsome silver under Āśleṣā / is born free of all fears and learned in the treatises.

4.192.s:
maghāsu tilapūrṇāni vardhamānāni mānavaḥ ..
pradāya paśumāṃścaiva putravāṃśca prajāyate ..13..
4.192.d:
मघासु तिलपूर्णानि वर्धमानानि मानवः ॥
प्रदाय पशुमांश्चैव पुत्रवांश्च प्रजायते ॥13॥
4.192.m: A person, having given vessels filled with sesame under Maghā, / is born possessing cattle and possessing sons.

4.192.s:
phālgunīpūrvasamaye vaḍavāṃ dvijapuṃgave ..
dattvā puṇyakṛtāṃllokānprāpnoti surasevitān .. 14 ..
4.192.d:
फाल्गुनीपूर्वसमये वडवां द्विजपुंगवे ॥
दत्त्वा पुण्यकृतांल्लोकान्प्राप्नोति सुरसेवितान् ॥ 14 ॥
4.192.m: Having given a mare to an eminent twice-born man at the time of Pūrva-phālgunī, / one attains the worlds of the meritorious, frequented by the gods.

4.192.s:
uttarāphālgunīyoge dattvā sauvarṇapaṃkajam ..
sūryalokamavāpnoti sarvabādhāvivarjitaḥ .. 15 ..
4.192.d:
उत्तराफाल्गुनीयोगे दत्त्वा सौवर्णपंकजम् ॥
सूर्यलोकमवाप्नोति सर्वबाधाविवर्जितः ॥ 15 ॥
4.192.m: Having given a golden lotus under the conjunction of Uttara-phālgunī, / free of all afflictions, one attains the realm of the Sun.

4.192.s:
haste tu hastinaṃ dattvā kāṃcanaṃ śaktitaḥ kṛtam ..
yātyasau śakrasadanaṃ varavāraṇadhūrgataḥ .. 16 ..
4.192.d:
हस्ते तु हस्तिनं दत्त्वा कांचनं शक्तितः कृतम् ॥
यात्यसौ शक्रसदनं वरवारणधूर्गतः ॥ 16 ॥
4.192.m: Having given an elephant made of gold according to one's capacity under Hasta, / one goes to Śakra's abode, seated on the pole of an excellent elephant.

4.192.s:
citrāsu vṛṣabhaṃ dattvā puṇyānāṃ puṇyamuttamam ..
caratyapsarasāṃ loke modate naṃdanevane .. 17 ..
4.192.d:
चित्रासु वृषभं दत्त्वा पुण्यानां पुण्यमुत्तमम् ॥
चरत्यप्सरसां लोके मोदते नंदनेवने ॥ 17 ॥
4.192.m: Having given a bull under Citrā, the highest merit among merits, / one wanders in the world of the apsarases and rejoices in the Nandana grove.

4.192.s:
svātīṣu ca dhanaṃ dattvā yadabhīṣṭamihātmanaḥ ..
prāpnoti ca śubhāṃllokāniha loke mahadyaśaḥ .. 18 ..
4.192.d:
स्वातीषु च धनं दत्त्वा यदभीष्टमिहात्मनः ॥
प्राप्नोति च शुभांल्लोकानिह लोके महद्यशः ॥ 18 ॥
4.192.m: And having given wealth under Svātī, whatever is cherished by oneself here, / one attains auspicious worlds and great fame in this world.

4.192.s:
viśākhāsu mahārāja dhuraṃdharavibhūṣitam ..
sopaskaraṃ ca śakaṭaṃ sadhānyaṃ vastrasaṃvṛtam .. 19 ..
4.192.d:
विशाखासु महाराज धुरंधरविभूषितम् ॥
सोपस्करं च शकटं सधान्यं वस्त्रसंवृतम् ॥ 19 ॥
4.192.m: Under Viśākhā, O great king, having given a cart equipped with accessories, / adorned with a yoke-bearer, with grain, and covered with cloth,

4.192.s:
dattvā prīṇāti sa pituḥ pretya cānantyamaśnute ..
na ca durgāṇyavāpnoti rauravādīni mānavaḥ .. 4.192.20 ..
4.192.d:
दत्त्वा प्रीणाति स पितुः प्रेत्य चानन्त्यमश्नुते ॥
न च दुर्गाण्यवाप्नोति रौरवादीनि मानवः ॥ 4.192.20 ॥
4.192.m: he pleases his ancestors, and after death attains infinity, / nor does the man encounter terrible hells such as Raurava.

4.192.s:
dattvā yatheṣṭaṃ viprebhyo gatimiṣṭāṃ sa gacchati ..
kambalānyanurādhakṣeṃ dattvā prāvaraṇāni ca .. 21 ..
4.192.d:
दत्त्वा यथेष्टं विप्रेभ्यो गतिमिष्टां स गच्छति ॥
कम्बलान्यनुराधक्षें दत्त्वा प्रावरणानि च ॥ 21 ॥
4.192.m: Having given as much as desired to the vipras, he goes to his desired state; / having given blankets and outer garments under the asterism Anurādhā,

4.192.s:
svarge varṣaśataṃ sāgramāste suragaṇairvṛtaḥ ..
kālaśākaṃ ca viprebhyo dattvā martyaḥ samūlakam .. 22 ..
4.192.d:
स्वर्गे वर्षशतं साग्रमास्ते सुरगणैर्वृतः ॥
कालशाकं च विप्रेभ्यो दत्त्वा मर्त्यः समूलकम् ॥ 22 ॥
4.192.m: he resides in heaven for a full hundred years, surrounded by hosts of gods; / having given kālaśāka greens along with roots to the vipras,

4.192.s:
jyeṣṭhānujyeṣṭhatāmeti gatimiṣṭāṃ ca gacchati ..
mūle mūlaphalaṃ dattvā brāhmaṇebhyaḥ samāhitaḥ .. 23 ..
4.192.d:
ज्येष्ठानुज्येष्ठतामेति गतिमिष्टां च गच्छति ॥
मूले मूलफलं दत्त्वा ब्राह्मणेभ्यः समाहितः ॥ 23 ॥
4.192.m: under Jyeṣṭhā, a mortal attains supremacy and goes to his desired state; / having given roots and fruit to brāhmaṇas under Mūla with a collected mind,

4.192.s:
pitṝnprīṇayate sarvāngatiṃ prāpnotyanuttamām ..
atha pūrvāsvaṣāḍhāsu dadhipātrāṇi mānavaḥ .. 24 ..
4.192.d:
पितॄन्प्रीणयते सर्वान्गतिं प्राप्नोत्यनुत्तमाम् ॥
अथ पूर्वास्वषाढासु दधिपात्राणि मानवः ॥ 24 ॥
4.192.m: he pleases all the ancestors and attains an unsurpassed destination; / then under Pūrvāṣāḍhā, a man [giving] vessels of curd

4.192.s:
kulavṛttopasampanne brāhmaṇe vedapārage ..
pradāya jāyate pretya kule ca bahubhogavān .. 25 ..
4.192.d:
कुलवृत्तोपसम्पन्ने ब्राह्मणे वेदपारगे ॥
प्रदाय जायते प्रेत्य कुले च बहुभोगवान् ॥ 25 ॥
4.192.m: having given [them] to a brāhmaṇa endowed with good family and conduct, who has mastered the Veda, / he is reborn after death in a [noble] family, possessing manifold enjoyments,

4.192.s:
putrapautraiḥ parivṛtaḥ paśumāndhanavāṃstathā ..
udamaṃthaṃ sasarpiṣkaṃ prabhūtamadhuphāṇitam .. 26 ..
4.192.d:
पुत्रपौत्रैः परिवृतः पशुमान्धनवांस्तथा ॥
उदमंथं ससर्पिष्कं प्रभूतमधुफाणितम् ॥ 26 ॥
4.192.m: surrounded by sons and grandsons, possessing cattle and wealth. / Having given a barley-groat beverage with ghee and abundant honey and molasses

4.192.s:
dattvottarāsvaṣāḍhāsu sarvānkāmānavāpnuyāt..
dugdhaṃ tvabhijito bhāge
dattvā ghṛtamadhuplutam .. 27 ..
4.192.d:
दत्त्वोत्तरास्वषाढासु सर्वान्कामानवाप्नुयात्॥
दुग्धं त्वभिजितो भागे
दत्त्वा घृतमधुप्लुतम् ॥ 27 ॥
4.192.m: under Uttarāṣāḍhā, he obtains all desires. / But having given milk filled with ghee and honey under the portion of Abhijit,

4.192.s:
dharmanityo manīṣibhyaḥ svarge vasati puṇyabhāk ..
śravaṇe pustakaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ pradadātīha yo naraḥ .. 28 ..
4.192.d:
धर्मनित्यो मनीषिभ्यः स्वर्गे वसति पुण्यभाक् ॥
श्रवणे पुस्तकं श्रेष्ठं प्रददातीह यो नरः ॥ 28 ॥
4.192.m: always devoted to dharma, [giving it] to wise men, he dwells in heaven sharing in merit. / The man who gives an excellent book here under Śravaṇa,

4.192.s:
svecchayā yāti yānena sarvāṃllokānna saṃśayaḥ ..
goyugaṃ ca dhaniṣṭhāsu dattvā viprāya mānavaḥ .. 29 ..
4.192.d:
स्वेच्छया याति यानेन सर्वांल्लोकान्न संशयः ॥
गोयुगं च धनिष्ठासु दत्त्वा विप्राय मानवः ॥ 29 ॥
4.192.m: goes at will in a vehicle to all the worlds; there is no doubt. / And a man, having given a pair of oxen to a vipra under Dhaniṣṭhā,

4.192.s:
sarvatra mānamāpnoti yatra yatreha jāyate ..
tathā śatabhiṣāyoge dattvā sāgaru caṃdanam .. 4.192.30 ..
4.192.d:
सर्वत्र मानमाप्नोति यत्र यत्रेह जायते ॥
तथा शतभिषायोगे दत्त्वा सागरु चंदनम् ॥ 4.192.30 ॥
4.192.m: receives honour everywhere, wherever he is born in this world. / Likewise, having given sandalwood along with aloe under the conjunction of Śatabhiṣaj,

4.192.s:
prāpnotyapsarasāṃ loke pretya gaṃdhāṃśca śobhanān ..
pūrvabhādrapadāyoge rājamāṣānpradāpayet .. 31 ..
4.192.d:
प्राप्नोत्यप्सरसां लोके प्रेत्य गंधांश्च शोभनान् ॥
पूर्वभाद्रपदायोगे राजमाषान्प्रदापयेत् ॥ 31 ॥
4.192.m: after death he reaches the world of the apsarases and lovely perfumes. / Under the conjunction of Pūrvabhādrapadā, he should give royal beans;

4.192.s:
sarvabhakṣaphalopetaḥ sa vai pretya sukhī bhavet ..
ratnamuttarayoge tu suvastraṃ yaḥ prayacchati ..32..
4.192.d:
सर्वभक्षफलोपेतः स वै प्रेत्य सुखी भवेत् ॥
रत्नमुत्तरयोगे तु सुवस्त्रं यः प्रयच्छति ॥32॥
4.192.m: endowed with every edible food and fruit, he becomes happy after death. / But he who gives a gem and fine cloth under the northern conjunction (Uttarabhādrapadā),

4.192.s:
pitṝnprīṇāti sakalānpretya cānaṃtyamaśnute ..
kāṃsyopadohanāṃ dhenuṃ revatyāṃ yaḥ prayacchati .. 33 ..
4.192.d:
पितॄन्प्रीणाति सकलान्प्रेत्य चानंत्यमश्नुते ॥
कांस्योपदोहनां धेनुं रेवत्यां यः प्रयच्छति ॥ 33 ॥
4.192.m: gratifies all the ancestors and enjoys eternity after death. / He who gives a cow with a bronze milking pail under Revatī,

4.192.s:
sa pretya kāmānādāya dātāramupagacchati ..
rathamaśvasamāyuktaṃ dattvāśvinyāṃ narottama .. 34 ..
4.192.d:
स प्रेत्य कामानादाय दातारमुपगच्छति ॥
रथमश्वसमायुक्तं दत्त्वाश्विन्यां नरोत्तम ॥ 34 ॥
4.192.m: after death, having taken his desires, she comes to the giver. / Having given a chariot harnessed with horses under Aśvinī, O best of men,

4.192.s:
hastyaśvarathasaṃpūrṇe varcasvī jāyate kule ..
bharaṇīṣu dvijātibhyastiladhenuṃ pradāya vai .. 35 ..
4.192.d:
हस्त्यश्वरथसंपूर्णे वर्चस्वी जायते कुले ॥
भरणीषु द्विजातिभ्यस्तिलधेनुं प्रदाय वै ॥ 35 ॥
4.192.m: he is born radiant in a family filled with elephants, horses, and chariots. / Indeed, having given a cow made of sesame seeds to the twice-born under Bharaṇī,

4.192.s:
gāvaḥ prabhūtāḥ prāpnoti naraḥ pretya yaśastathā ..
ityeṣa dakṣiṇoddeśaḥ prokto nakṣatrayogataḥ .. 36 ..
4.192.d:
गावः प्रभूताः प्राप्नोति नरः प्रेत्य यशस्तथा ॥
इत्येष दक्षिणोद्देशः प्रोक्तो नक्षत्रयोगतः ॥ 36 ॥
4.192.m: a man obtains abundant cattle and fame after death. / Thus this teaching on donations according to the conjunctions of constellations has been declared,

4.192.s:
devakyai nāradenaiva mayā ca kathitastava ..
sarvapāpapraśamanaḥ sarvopadravanāśanaḥ .. 37 ..
4.192.d:
देवक्यै नारदेनैव मया च कथितस्तव ॥
सर्वपापप्रशमनः सर्वोपद्रवनाशनः ॥ 37 ॥
4.192.m: which was told to Devakī by Nārada and by me to you, / which allays all sins and destroys all afflictions.

4.192.s:
na cātra kālaniyamo nakṣatraprakamastathā ..
vittaṃ śraddhā ca rājendra kāraṇaṃ cātra kathyate .. 38 ..
yadyacca te bhagavatā kamalodbhavasya putreṇa dānamuditaṃ prasamīkṣya vedān..
4.192.d:
न चात्र कालनियमो नक्षत्रप्रकमस्तथा ॥
वित्तं श्रद्धा च राजेन्द्र कारणं चात्र कथ्यते ॥ 38 ॥
यद्यच्च ते भगवता कमलोद्भवस्य पुत्रेण दानमुदितं प्रसमीक्ष्य वेदान्॥
4.192.m:
And here there is no restriction of time, nor the sequence of the constellations; / wealth and faith, O best of kings, are declared to be the cause here.
Whatever gift has been declared to you by the venerable son of the lotus-born (Nārada) having examined the Vedas,

4.192.s:
tadyo dadāti vibhave sati sādhuvṛtte kiṃ tena pārtha na kṛtaṃ bhavatīha loke .. 39 ..
tithidānavarṇanam
4.192.d:
तद्यो ददाति विभवे सति साधुवृत्ते किं तेन पार्थ न कृतं भवतीह लोके ॥ 39 ॥
तिथिदानवर्णनम्
4.192.m:
whoever gives that when wealth is available, being of righteous conduct—what has not been accomplished by him here in this world, O son of Pṛthā?
Description of Gifts on Lunar Days

4.193.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
tithidānamidānīṃ te kathayāmi yudhiṣṭhira ..
sarvapāpapraśamanaṃ sarvavighnavināśanam ..1..
4.193.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
तिथिदानमिदानीं ते कथयामि युधिष्ठिर ॥
सर्वपापप्रशमनं सर्वविघ्नविनाशनम् ॥1॥
4.193.m: The venerable Kṛṣṇa said: / I shall now tell you the gift on lunar days, O Yudhiṣṭhira, / which allays all sins and destroys all obstacles.

4.193.s:
mānasaṃ vācikaṃ cāpi karmajaṃ yadaghaṃ bhavet ..
sarvaṃ praśamamāyāti dānenānena pāṃḍava ..2..
4.193.d:
मानसं वाचिकं चापि कर्मजं यदघं भवेत् ॥
सर्वं प्रशममायाति दानेनानेन पांडव ॥2॥
4.193.m: Whatever sin there may be, whether mental, vocal, or born of action, / it all comes to cessation by this gift, O Pāṇḍava.

4.193.s:
śrāvaṇe kārtike caitre vaiśākhe phālgune tathā ..
sitapakṣātprabhṛtyeva dātavyaṃ puṇyavarddhanam .. 3 ..
4.193.d:
श्रावणे कार्तिके चैत्रे वैशाखे फाल्गुने तथा ॥
सितपक्षात्प्रभृत्येव दातव्यं पुण्यवर्द्धनम् ॥ 3 ॥
4.193.m: In Śrāvaṇa, Kārtika, Caitra, Vaiśākha, and Phālguna, / beginning indeed from the bright fortnight, that which increases merit should be given.

4.193.s:
vittaṃ śraddhāsahāyaśca pātraprāptistathaiva ca ..
dānakālaḥ sadaiveha kathitastattvadarśibhiḥ .. 4 ..
4.193.d:
वित्तं श्रद्धासहायश्च पात्रप्राप्तिस्तथैव च ॥
दानकालः सदैवेह कथितस्तत्त्वदर्शिभिः ॥ 4 ॥
4.193.m: Wealth, the assistance of faith, and likewise the obtaining of a worthy recipient: / this is ever declared by the seers of truth to be the time for giving here.

4.193.s:
tīrthe devālaye goṣṭhe gṛhe vā niyatātmavān ..
yaddadāti naraśreṣṭhastadānaṃtyāya kalpate ..5..
4.193.d:
तीर्थे देवालये गोष्ठे गृहे वा नियतात्मवान् ॥
यद्ददाति नरश्रेष्ठस्तदानंत्याय कल्पते ॥5॥
4.193.m: In a holy bath, a temple of the gods, a cowshed, or at home, self-restrained, / whatever the best of men gives leads to eternity.

4.193.s:
pratipatsu dvijānpūjyapta pūjayitvā prajāpatim..
sauvarṇamaravindaṃ ca kārayitvāṣṭapatrakam .. 6 ..
4.193.d:
प्रतिपत्सु द्विजान्पूज्यप्त पूजयित्वा प्रजापतिम्॥
सौवर्णमरविन्दं च कारयित्वाष्टपत्रकम् ॥ 6 ॥
4.193.m: Having honoured the twice-born on the first lunar days and worshipped Prajāpati, / and having caused a golden eight-petalled lotus to be made,

4.193.s:
kṛtvā caudumbare pātre sugandhavṛtapūrite ..
puṣpairdhūpaiḥ pūjayitvā viprāya pratipāda yet ..7..
4.193.d:
कृत्वा चौदुम्बरे पात्रे सुगन्धवृतपूरिते ॥
पुष्पैर्धूपैः पूजयित्वा विप्राय प्रतिपाद येत् ॥7॥
4.193.m: and having placed it in an udumbara vessel filled with fragrant ghee, / having worshipped it with flowers and incenses, one should offer it to a vipra.

4.193.s:
anena vidhinā dattvā kamalaṃ kamalālayam ..
īpsitāṃllabhate kāmānniṣkāmo brahmasātmyatām ..8..
4.193.d:
अनेन विधिना दत्त्वा कमलं कमलालयम् ॥
ईप्सितांल्लभते कामान्निष्कामो ब्रह्मसात्म्यताम् ॥8॥
4.193.m: Having given the lotus, the abode of Kamalā, according to this rule, / he obtains his sought-after desires, or free from desire, attains unity with Brahman.

4.193.s:
vahniṃ pūjya dvitīyāyāṃ bhūrbhuvaḥsvariti kramāt ..
tilājyena śataṃ hutvā dattvā pūrṇāhutiṃ tataḥ ..9..
vaiśvānaraṃ tu sauvarṇaṃ sthāpayettāmrabhājane ..
guḍājyapūrite rājaṃstoyapūrṇaghaṭopari ..4.193.1 0..
pūjayitvā vastramālyairbhakṣyabhojyairanekadhā ..
tatastaṃ brāhmaṇe dadyādvahnirme prīyatāmiti ..1 1..
4.193.d:
वह्निं पूज्य द्वितीयायां भूर्भुवःस्वरिति क्रमात् ॥
तिलाज्येन शतं हुत्वा दत्त्वा पूर्णाहुतिं ततः ॥9॥
वैश्वानरं तु सौवर्णं स्थापयेत्ताम्रभाजने ॥
गुडाज्यपूरिते राजंस्तोयपूर्णघटोपरि ॥4.193.1 0॥
पूजयित्वा वस्त्रमाल्यैर्भक्ष्यभोज्यैरनेकधा ॥
ततस्तं ब्राह्मणे दद्याद्वह्निर्मे प्रीयतामिति ॥1 1॥
4.193.m:
Having worshipped the sacred fire on the second lunar day with 'bhūr bhuvaḥ svaḥ' in due order, / having made a hundred oblations of sesame and ghee, and then having given the full oblation,
one should place a golden fire in a copper vessel / filled with jaggery and ghee upon a pot filled with water, O king.
Having worshipped it with garments and garlands, and with varied eatables and foodstuffs, / one should then give it to a brāhmaṇa, [saying,] 'May the sacred fire be pleased with me.'

4.193.s:
yāvajjīvakṛtātpāpānmucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ ..
mṛto vahni puraṃ yāti prāhedaṃ nārado muniḥ ..12..
4.193.d:
यावज्जीवकृतात्पापान्मुच्यते नात्र संशयः ॥
मृतो वह्नि पुरं याति प्राहेदं नारदो मुनिः ॥12॥
4.193.m: He is released from sin committed throughout his life; there is no doubt here. / When dead, he goes to the realm of fire; the sage Nārada declared this.

4.193.s:
tṛtīyāyāṃ mahārāja rādhāṃ svarṇamayīṃ śubhām ..
sthāpayitvā tāmrapātre lavaṇopari vinyaset ..13..
4.193.d:
तृतीयायां महाराज राधां स्वर्णमयीं शुभाम् ॥
स्थापयित्वा ताम्रपात्रे लवणोपरि विन्यसेत् ॥13॥
4.193.m: On the third lunar day, O great king, having set up an auspicious golden Rādhā / in a copper vessel, one should place it upon salt.

4.193.s:
jīrakaṃ kaṭukaṃ caiva guḍaṃ pārtheṣu dāpayet ..
raktavastrayugacchannāṃ kuṃkumena vibhūṣitām .. 14 ..
4.193.d:
जीरकं कटुकं चैव गुडं पार्थेषु दापयेत् ॥
रक्तवस्त्रयुगच्छन्नां कुंकुमेन विभूषिताम् ॥ 14 ॥
4.193.m: One should give cumin, pungent spices, and jaggery on earthen dishes, O son of Pṛthā; / covered with a pair of red garments, adorned with saffron,

4.193.s:
puṣpadhūpaiḥ sanaivedyaiḥ pūjayitvā dvijātaye ..
dattvā yatphalamāpnoti pārtha tatkena varṇyate .. 15 ..
4.193.d:
पुष्पधूपैः सनैवेद्यैः पूजयित्वा द्विजातये ॥
दत्त्वा यत्फलमाप्नोति पार्थ तत्केन वर्ण्यते ॥ 15 ॥
4.193.m: having worshipped it with flowers, incenses, and food offerings, / what fruit one obtains by giving it to a twice-born, by whom can that be described, O son of Pṛthā?

4.193.s:
prāsādā yatra sauvarṇā nadyaḥ pāyasakardamāḥ..
gandharvāpsaraso yatra tatra te yāṃti mānavāḥ ..16..
4.193.d:
प्रासादा यत्र सौवर्णा नद्यः पायसकर्दमाः॥
गन्धर्वाप्सरसो यत्र तत्र ते यांति मानवाः ॥16॥
4.193.m: Where there are golden palaces and rivers of rice-milk mud, / where there are gandharvas and apsarases, thither those people go.

4.193.s:
svargādihaitya saṃsāre surūpaḥ subhago bhavet ..
dātā bhoktā bahudhanaḥ putrapautrasamanvitaḥ .. 17 ..
4.193.d:
स्वर्गादिहैत्य संसारे सुरूपः सुभगो भवेत् ॥
दाता भोक्ता बहुधनः पुत्रपौत्रसमन्वितः ॥ 17 ॥
4.193.m: Returning here to the world of transmigration from heaven, he becomes handsome and fortunate, / a giver, an enjoyer, possessing much wealth, endowed with sons and grandsons;

4.193.s:
nārī vā tadguṇairyuktā bhavatīha na saṃśayaḥ ..
caturthyāṃ vāraṇaṃ haimaṃ palādūrddhvaṃ suśobhanam .. 18 ..
4.193.d:
नारी वा तद्गुणैर्युक्ता भवतीह न संशयः ॥
चतुर्थ्यां वारणं हैमं पलादूर्द्ध्वं सुशोभनम् ॥ 18 ॥
4.193.m: or a woman endowed with those virtues comes to be here, without doubt. / On the fourth lunar day, having caused a golden elephant to be made,

4.193.s:
kāmayitvāṃkuśayutaṃ tiladroṇopari nyaset ..
vastraiḥ puṣpaiḥ pūjayitvā naiveyaṃ vinivedya ca .. 19 ..
4.193.d:
कामयित्वांकुशयुतं तिलद्रोणोपरि न्यसेत् ॥
वस्त्रैः पुष्पैः पूजयित्वा नैवेयं विनिवेद्य च ॥ 19 ॥
4.193.m: weighing more than a pala, very beautiful, accompanied by a goad, one should place it on a droṇa of sesame; / having worshipped it with garments and flowers, and having offered a food offering,

4.193.s:
tatastu brāhmaṇe dadyādgaṇeśaḥ prīyatāmiti ..
kāryāraṃbheṣu sarveṣu tasya vighnaṃ na jāyate .. 4.193.20 ..
4.193.d:
ततस्तु ब्राह्मणे दद्याद्गणेशः प्रीयतामिति ॥
कार्यारंभेषु सर्वेषु तस्य विघ्नं न जायते ॥ 4.193.20 ॥
4.193.m: one should then give it to a brāhmaṇa, [saying,] 'May Gaṇeśa be pleased.' / At the beginning of all undertakings, no obstacle arises for him.

4.193.s:
vāraṇāḥ sapta janmāni bhavaṃti madavihvalāḥ ..
vāraṇendrasamārūḍhastrailokyavijayī bhavet .. 21 ..
4.193.d:
वारणाः सप्त जन्मानि भवंति मदविह्वलाः ॥
वारणेन्द्रसमारूढस्त्रैलोक्यविजयी भवेत् ॥ 21 ॥
4.193.m: For seven lifetimes there are elephants frantic with rut [in his possession]; / mounted on an elephant-lord, he becomes a conqueror of the three worlds.

4.193.s:
paṃcamyāṃ pannagaṃ caiva svarṇenaikena kārayet ..
kṣīrājyapatramadhyasthaṃ pūjayitvā pradāpayet .. 22 ..
4.193.d:
पंचम्यां पन्नगं चैव स्वर्णेनैकेन कारयेत् ॥
क्षीराज्यपत्रमध्यस्थं पूजयित्वा प्रदापयेत् ॥ 22 ॥
4.193.m: And on the fifth lunar day, one should cause a serpent to be made of one [measure of] gold; / resting in the middle of a leaf with milk and ghee, having worshipped it, one should give it.

4.193.s:
dvijaṃ saṃpūjya vāsobhiḥ praṇipatya kṣamāpayet ..
iha loke pare caiva dānametatsukhāvaham .. 23 ..
4.193.d:
द्विजं संपूज्य वासोभिः प्रणिपत्य क्षमापयेत् ॥
इह लोके परे चैव दानमेतत्सुखावहम् ॥ 23 ॥
4.193.m: Having honoured the twice-born with garments, having bowed down, one should ask for forbearance; / this gift brings happiness in this world and in the next world.

4.193.s:
nāgopadravavidrāvi sarvaduṣṭanibarhaṇam ..
prāyaścittaṃ tathā proktaṃ nāgadaṣṭasya śaṃbhunā .. 24 ..
4.193.d:
नागोपद्रवविद्रावि सर्वदुष्टनिबर्हणम् ॥
प्रायश्चित्तं तथा प्रोक्तं नागदष्टस्य शंभुना ॥ 24 ॥
4.193.m: It drives away afflictions caused by serpents and destroys all evils; / likewise it has been declared by Śambhu as an expiation for one bitten by a snake.

4.193.s:
ṣaṣṭhyāṃ śaktisamopetaṃ kumāraṃ śikhivāhanam ..
kārayitvā yathāśaktyā hemamālāvibhūṣitam .. 25 ..
4.193.d:
षष्ठ्यां शक्तिसमोपेतं कुमारं शिखिवाहनम् ॥
कारयित्वा यथाशक्त्या हेममालाविभूषितम् ॥ 25 ॥
4.193.m: On the sixth lunar day, having caused Kumāra, who rides the peacock, / to be made according to one's ability, endowed with his spear, adorned with a golden garland,

4.193.s:
taṃḍulenātha śikhare vāsobhiḥ pūjya bhaktitaḥ ..
ṣaṣṭhyāṃ skaṃdaṃ yathāśakti kṛtvā skaṃdaṃ hiraṇmayam .. 26 ..
4.193.d:
तंडुलेनाथ शिखरे वासोभिः पूज्य भक्तितः ॥
षष्ठ्यां स्कंदं यथाशक्ति कृत्वा स्कंदं हिरण्मयम् ॥ 26 ॥
4.193.m: upon a heap of husked grains, having worshipped him with cloths in devotion, / having made Skanda of gold according to one's ability on the sixth lunar day,

4.193.s:
pūjayitvā gaṃdhapuṣpadhūpainaivedyatastathā ..
namaskṛtya tato dadyādbrāhmaṇāya kuṭuṃbine .. 27 ..
4.193.d:
पूजयित्वा गंधपुष्पधूपैनैवेद्यतस्तथा ॥
नमस्कृत्य ततो दद्याद्ब्राह्मणाय कुटुंबिने ॥ 27 ॥
4.193.m: having worshipped him with perfumes, flowers, incenses, and food offerings, / and having bowed down, one should then give it to a householder brāhmaṇa.

4.193.s:
iha bhūtiṃ parāṃ prāpya pretya svarge mahīyate ..
śūdro brāhmaṇatāmeti brāhmaṇo brahmalokatām .. 28 ..
4.193.d:
इह भूतिं परां प्राप्य प्रेत्य स्वर्गे महीयते ॥
शूद्रो ब्राह्मणतामेति ब्राह्मणो ब्रह्मलोकताम् ॥ 28 ॥
4.193.m: Attaining supreme prosperity here, upon death he is magnified in heaven; / a śūdra attains the state of a brāhmaṇa, and a brāhmaṇa attains the world of Brahmā.

4.193.s:
saptamyāṃ bhāskaraṃ pūjya brāhmaṇānaśvamuttamam ..
dadyādalaṃkṛtagrīvaṃ saparyāṇaṃ sadakṣiṇam .. 29 ..
4.193.d:
सप्तम्यां भास्करं पूज्य ब्राह्मणानश्वमुत्तमम् ॥
दद्यादलंकृतग्रीवं सपर्याणं सदक्षिणम् ॥ 29 ॥
4.193.m: On the seventh [tithi], having worshipped the Sun, he should give to a brāhmaṇa an excellent horse, / its neck adorned, fitted with a saddle, along with a sacrificial fee.

4.193.s:
sūryalokamavāpnoti sūryeṇa saha modate ..
gaṃdharvāstuṣṭimāyāṃti datte'śve samalaṃkṛte .. 4.193.30 ..
4.193.d:
सूर्यलोकमवाप्नोति सूर्येण सह मोदते ॥
गंधर्वास्तुष्टिमायांति दत्तेऽश्वे समलंकृते ॥ 4.193.30 ॥
4.193.m: He attains the world of Sūrya and rejoices together with Sūrya; / the gandharvas attain satisfaction when an adorned horse is given.

4.193.s:
aṣṭamyāṃ vṛṣabhaṃ śvetamavyaṃgāṃgaṃ dhuraṃdharam ..
sitavastrayugacchannaṃ ghaṃṭābharaṇabhūṣitam .. 31 ..
4.193.d:
अष्टम्यां वृषभं श्वेतमव्यंगांगं धुरंधरम् ॥
सितवस्त्रयुगच्छन्नं घंटाभरणभूषितम् ॥ 31 ॥
4.193.m: On the eighth [tithi], [he should give] a white bull, unblemished in its limbs, capable of bearing the yoke, / covered with a pair of white garments and adorned with bell-ornaments.

4.193.s:
dadyātpraṇamya viprāya prīyatāṃ vṛṣabhadhvajaḥ ..
pradakṣiṇaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā ādvārāṃtamanuvrajet .. 32 ..
4.193.d:
दद्यात्प्रणम्य विप्राय प्रीयतां वृषभध्वजः ॥
प्रदक्षिणं ततः कृत्वा आद्वारांतमनुव्रजेत् ॥ 32 ॥
4.193.m: Bowing, he should give it to a vipra, [saying,] 'May the Bull-bannered [Śiva] be pleased.' / Then, having circumambulated it, he should follow it as far as the doorway.

4.193.s:
dānenānena nṛpate śivaloko na durlabhaḥ ..
vṛṣaskaṃdhe pratiṣṭhaṃti bhuvanāni caturdaśa .. 33 ..
4.193.d:
दानेनानेन नृपते शिवलोको न दुर्लभः ॥
वृषस्कंधे प्रतिष्ठंति भुवनानि चतुर्दश ॥ 33 ॥
4.193.m: By this gift, O king, the world of Śiva is not difficult to attain; / the fourteen worlds abide upon the shoulder of the bull.

4.193.s:
tasmādvṛṣabhadānena dattā bhavati bhāratī ..
navamyāṃ kāṃcanaṃ siṃhaṃ kārayitvā svaśaktitaḥ .. 34 ..
4.193.d:
तस्माद्वृषभदानेन दत्ता भवति भारती ॥
नवम्यां कांचनं सिंहं कारयित्वा स्वशक्तितः ॥ 34 ॥
4.193.m: Therefore, through the gift of a bull, the earth has been given. / On the ninth [tithi], having a golden lion made according to one's capacity,

4.193.s:
muktāphalāṣṭakayutaṃ nīlavastrāvaguṇṭhitam ..
dadyāddevīmanusmṛtya duṣṭadaityanibarhaṇīm .. 35 ..
4.193.d:
मुक्ताफलाष्टकयुतं नीलवस्त्रावगुण्ठितम् ॥
दद्याद्देवीमनुस्मृत्य दुष्टदैत्यनिबर्हणीम् ॥ 35 ॥
4.193.m: endowed with eight pearls and veiled with a blue cloth, / one should give it, remembering the Goddess who destroys wicked demons,

4.193.s:
dvijātipravarāyetthaṃ sarvānkāmānsamaśnute ..
kāṃtāravanadurgeṣu cauravyālā kule pathi .. 36 ..
4.193.d:
द्विजातिप्रवरायेत्थं सर्वान्कामान्समश्नुते ॥
कांतारवनदुर्गेषु चौरव्याला कुले पथि ॥ 36 ॥
4.193.m: to an eminent twice-born man. In this way he attains all desires. / In dense forests, difficult terrain, and on roads infested with thieves and beasts of prey,

4.193.s:
hiṃsakāstaṃ na hiṃsaṃti dānasyāsya prabhāvataḥ ..
mṛto devīpuraṃ yāti pūjyamānaḥ surāsuraiḥ .. 37 ..
4.193.d:
हिंसकास्तं न हिंसंति दानस्यास्य प्रभावतः ॥
मृतो देवीपुरं याति पूज्यमानः सुरासुरैः ॥ 37 ॥
4.193.m: violent beings do not harm him by the power of this gift. / When he dies, he goes to the city of the Goddess, worshipped by gods and asuras.

4.193.s:
puṇyakṣayādihābhyetya rājā bhavati dhārmikaḥ ..
daśamyāṃ nṛpaśārdūla daśāśāḥ svarṇanirmitāḥ .. 38 ..
4.193.d:
पुण्यक्षयादिहाभ्येत्य राजा भवति धार्मिकः ॥
दशम्यां नृपशार्दूल दशाशाः स्वर्णनिर्मिताः ॥ 38 ॥
4.193.m: When his merit is exhausted, he returns here and becomes a righteous king. / On the tenth [tithi], O tiger among kings, [he should make images of] the ten directions fashioned of gold,

4.193.s:
lavaṇe ca guḍe kṣīre niṣpāveṣu tileṣu ca ..
gavyatraye taṃduleṣu māṣāṇā supari sthitāḥ .. 39 ..
4.193.d:
लवणे च गुडे क्षीरे निष्पावेषु तिलेषु च ॥
गव्यत्रये तंदुलेषु माषाणा सुपरि स्थिताः ॥ 39 ॥
4.193.m: placed upon salt, jaggery, milk, kidney beans, sesame seeds, / the three products of the cow, rice grains, and black gram.

4.193.s:
saṃpūjya vastrapuṣpādyairdvijāya pratipādayet ..
anena vidhinā yastu pumānstrī vātha vā punaḥ .. 4.193.40 ..
4.193.d:
संपूज्य वस्त्रपुष्पाद्यैर्द्विजाय प्रतिपादयेत् ॥
अनेन विधिना यस्तु पुमान्स्त्री वाथ वा पुनः ॥ 4.193.40 ॥
4.193.m: Having worshipped them with garments, flowers, and the like, he should present them to a twice-born man. / Whichever man, or even woman, who according to this rite

4.193.s:
nirvāpayati rājeṃdra tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu ..
iha loke bhūpatiḥ syātpretya svarge mahīyate ..41..
4.193.d:
निर्वापयति राजेंद्र तस्य पुण्यफलं शृणु ॥
इह लोके भूपतिः स्यात्प्रेत्य स्वर्गे महीयते ॥41॥
4.193.m: accomplishes [it], O lord of kings, hear the fruit of that merit: / in this world he becomes a lord of the earth, and upon death he is magnified in heaven.

4.193.s:
sakalāstasya sarvāśā yāḥ kāścinmanasecchitāḥ ..
tataḥ svargādihābhyetya kule mahati jāyate .. 42 ..
4.193.d:
सकलास्तस्य सर्वाशा याः काश्चिन्मनसेच्छिताः ॥
ततः स्वर्गादिहाभ्येत्य कुले महति जायते ॥ 42 ॥
4.193.m: All his hopes whatsoever, desired in his heart, are fulfilled; / then, returning here from heaven, he is born into a great family.

4.193.s:
ekādaśyāṃ garutmaṃtaṃ kārayitvā hiraṇmayam ..
yathāśaktyā tāmrapātre ghṛtasyopari pūjitam .. 43 ..
4.193.d:
एकादश्यां गरुत्मंतं कारयित्वा हिरण्मयम् ॥
यथाशक्त्या ताम्रपात्रे घृतस्योपरि पूजितम् ॥ 43 ॥
4.193.m: On the eleventh [tithi], having a golden Garuda made / according to one's capacity, worshipped upon ghee in a copper vessel,

4.193.s:
paṃcāgnyabhirate vipre purāṇajñe viśeṣataḥ ..
dattvā kiṃ bahunoktena viṣṇuloke mahīyate .. 44 ..
4.193.d:
पंचाग्न्यभिरते विप्रे पुराणज्ञे विशेषतः ॥
दत्त्वा किं बहुनोक्तेन विष्णुलोके महीयते ॥ 44 ॥
4.193.m: and giving it to a vipra devoted to the five sacred fires, especially one knowledgeable in the Purāṇas— / what need of saying more?—he is magnified in the world of Viṣṇu.

4.193.s:
gāṃ vṛṣaṃ mahiṣīṃ hemaṃ saptadhānyānyajāvikam ..
vaḍavāṃ guraḍarasānsa rvāṃstathā bahuphaladrumān .. 45 ..
4.193.d:
गां वृषं महिषीं हेमं सप्तधान्यान्यजाविकम् ॥
वडवां गुरडरसान्स र्वांस्तथा बहुफलद्रुमान् ॥ 45 ॥
4.193.m: A cow, a bull, a female buffalo, gold, the seven grains, goats and sheep, / a mare, sugar-cane juice, all types of fruit trees,

4.193.s:
puṣpāṇi ca vicitrāṇi gaṃdhāṃścoccāvacānbahūn ..
yathāśaktyā melayitvā vastrairācchādayennavaiḥ .. 46 ..
4.193.d:
पुष्पाणि च विचित्राणि गंधांश्चोच्चावचान्बहून् ॥
यथाशक्त्या मेलयित्वा वस्त्रैराच्छादयेन्नवैः ॥ 46 ॥
4.193.m: variegated flowers, and many varied perfumes— / having assembled these according to capacity, he should cover them with fresh garments.

4.193.s:
dvādaśyāṃ dvādaśaitāni brāhmaṇebhyo nivedayet ..
ekasya vā mahārāja yatphalaṃ tanniśāmaya .. 47 ..
4.193.d:
द्वादश्यां द्वादशैतानि ब्राह्मणेभ्यो निवेदयेत् ॥
एकस्य वा महाराज यत्फलं तन्निशामय ॥ 47 ॥
4.193.m: On the twelfth [tithi], he should offer these twelve to brāhmaṇas, / or [all of them] to one alone, O great king. Hear what the fruit is:

4.193.s:
iha kīrtiṃ parāṃ prāpya bhuktvā bhogānyathepsitān ..
tato viṣṇupuraṃ yāti sevyamāno'psaroṇaṇaiḥ .. 48 ..
4.193.d:
इह कीर्तिं परां प्राप्य भुक्त्वा भोगान्यथेप्सितान् ॥
ततो विष्णुपुरं याति सेव्यमानोऽप्सरोणणैः ॥ 48 ॥
4.193.m: having attained supreme renown here and enjoyed desires as he wishes, / he then goes to the city of Viṣṇu, attended by hosts of apsarases.

4.193.s:
karmakṣayādihābhyetya rājā bhavati dhārmikaḥ ..
yajñayājī dānapatirjīvecca śaradāṃ śatam .. 49 ..
4.193.d:
कर्मक्षयादिहाभ्येत्य राजा भवति धार्मिकः ॥
यज्ञयाजी दानपतिर्जीवेच्च शरदां शतम् ॥ 49 ॥
4.193.m: When his karma is exhausted, he returns here and becomes a righteous king; / he performs sacrifices, becomes a lord of generosity, and lives for a hundred autumns.

4.193.s:
snāpayedbrāhmaṇāṃścātra trayodaśyāṃ trayodaśa ..
tānācchādya navairvastrairgaṃdhapuṣpairathārcayet .. .. 4.193.50 ..
4.193.d:
स्नापयेद्ब्राह्मणांश्चात्र त्रयोदश्यां त्रयोदश ॥
तानाच्छाद्य नवैर्वस्त्रैर्गंधपुष्पैरथार्चयेत् ॥ ॥ 4.193.50 ॥
4.193.m: And on the thirteenth [tithi] here, he should bathe thirteen brāhmaṇas; / having covered them with fresh garments, he should then worship them with perfumes and flowers.

4.193.s:
bhojayīta sumiṣṭānnaṃ dakṣiṇāṃ vinivedayet ..
yathāśaktyā hemakhaṇḍāndharmātmā prīyatāmiti .. 51 ..
4.193.d:
भोजयीत सुमिष्टान्नं दक्षिणां विनिवेदयेत् ॥
यथाशक्त्या हेमखण्डान्धर्मात्मा प्रीयतामिति ॥ 51 ॥
4.193.m: He should feed them very sweet food and present a sacrificial fee / of gold pieces according to his capacity, [saying,] 'May the righteous-souled [Yama] be pleased.'

4.193.s:
dharmarājāya kālāya citraguptāya daṃḍine ..
mṛtyave kṣayarūpāya aṃtakāya yamāya ca .. 52 ..
4.193.d:
धर्मराजाय कालाय चित्रगुप्ताय दंडिने ॥
मृत्यवे क्षयरूपाय अंतकाय यमाय च ॥ 52 ॥
4.193.m: To Dharmarāja, to Kāla, to Citragupta, to Daṇḍin, / to Mṛtyu, to Kṣayarūpa, to Antaka, and to Yama,

4.193.s:
pretanāthāya raudrāya tathā vaivasvatāya ca ..
mahiṣasthāya devāya nāmānīha trayodaśa .. 53 ..
4.193.d:
प्रेतनाथाय रौद्राय तथा वैवस्वताय च ॥
महिषस्थाय देवाय नामानीह त्रयोदश ॥ 53 ॥
4.193.m: to the Lord of the Pretas, to Raudra, and likewise to Vaivasvata, / to the god mounted on a buffalo—the thirteen names here—

4.193.s:
uccārya śraddhayā yuktaḥ praṇipatya visarjayet ..
yaḥ karoti mahārāja pūjāmetāṃ manoramām ..54..
4.193.d:
उच्चार्य श्रद्धया युक्तः प्रणिपत्य विसर्जयेत् ॥
यः करोति महाराज पूजामेतां मनोरमाम् ॥54॥
4.193.m: pronouncing [them], endowed with faith, he should bow down and bid them farewell. / The man who performs this delightful worship for Yama, O great king,

4.193.s:
yamāya sa sukhaṃ martye sthitvā vyādhivivarjitaḥ ..
yamamārgagataḥ paścādduḥkhaṃ nāpnotyasau pumān .. 95 ..
4.193.d:
यमाय स सुखं मर्त्ये स्थित्वा व्याधिविवर्जितः ॥
यममार्गगतः पश्चाद्दुःखं नाप्नोत्यसौ पुमान् ॥ 95 ॥
4.193.m: having dwelt happily among mortals free from disease, / does not subsequently incur suffering when proceeding on the path of Yama.

4.193.s:
na paśyati pretamukhaṃ pitṛlokaṃ sa gacchati ..
puṇyakṣayādihābhyetya sa sukhī nīrujo bhavet .. 56 ..
4.193.d:
न पश्यति प्रेतमुखं पितृलोकं स गच्छति ॥
पुण्यक्षयादिहाभ्येत्य स सुखी नीरुजो भवेत् ॥ 56 ॥
4.193.m: He does not look upon the face of a preta; he goes to the world of the ancestors. / When his merit is exhausted, he returns here, becoming happy and free from illness.

4.193.s:
mahiṣaṃ suśubhaṃ kuṃbhaṃ caturdaśyāṃ payobhṛtam ..
taṃ karṣakeṇa saṃyuktaṃ hemnaḥ sadvastrasaṃyutam .. 57 ..
4.193.d:
महिषं सुशुभं कुंभं चतुर्दश्यां पयोभृतम् ॥
तं कर्षकेण संयुक्तं हेम्नः सद्वस्त्रसंयुतम् ॥ 57 ॥
4.193.m: On the fourteenth [tithi], [he should prepare] an auspicious jar filled with milk [symbolising] a buffalo, / together with a ploughman fashioned of gold, accompanied by fine cloth,

4.193.s:
ghaṃṭābharaṇaśobhāḍhyaṃ vṛṣabheṇa samanvitam ..
yo dadyācchivabhaktāya brāhmaṇāya kuṭuṃbine .. 58 ..
4.193.d:
घंटाभरणशोभाढ्यं वृषभेण समन्वितम् ॥
यो दद्याच्छिवभक्ताय ब्राह्मणाय कुटुंबिने ॥ 58 ॥
4.193.m: richly adorned with bell-ornaments, and together with a bull. / Whoever gives it to a brāhmaṇa householder devoted to Śiva,

4.193.s:
vṛṣaṃ dattvā naraśreṣṭha śivaloke mahīyate ..
tatra sthitvā ciraṃ kālaṃ kramādetya mahītalam .. 59 ..
4.193.d:
वृषं दत्त्वा नरश्रेष्ठ शिवलोके महीयते ॥
तत्र स्थित्वा चिरं कालं क्रमादेत्य महीतलम् ॥ 59 ॥
4.193.m: having given a bull, O best of men, is magnified in the world of Śiva. / Having dwelt there for a long time, he gradually returns to the surface of the earth,

4.193.s:
ārogyadhanasaṃyukte kule mahati jāyate ..
sarvakāmasamṛddhyarthaṃ yāvajanmaśatatrayam .. .. 4.193.60 ..
4.193.d:
आरोग्यधनसंयुक्ते कुले महति जायते ॥
सर्वकामसमृद्ध्यर्थं यावजन्मशतत्रयम् ॥ ॥ 4.193.60 ॥
4.193.m: and is born into a great family endowed with health and wealth / for three hundred lives, in order to fulfill all desires.

4.193.s:
paurṇamāsyāṃ vṛṣotsargaṃ kārayitvā vidhānataḥ ..
caṃdrarajataniṣpannaṃ phalenaikena śobhanam .. 61 ..
4.193.d:
पौर्णमास्यां वृषोत्सर्गं कारयित्वा विधानतः ॥
चंद्ररजतनिष्पन्नं फलेनैकेन शोभनम् ॥ 61 ॥
4.193.m: On the full moon day, having performed the release of a bull according to the ordinance, / [an image of] the moon made of silver, adorned with a fruit,

4.193.s:
pūjayedgaṃdhakusumairnaivedyaṃ vinivedya ca ..
dadyādviprāya saṃkalpya vāsolaṃkārabhūṣaṇaiḥ .. 62 ..
4.193.d:
पूजयेद्गंधकुसुमैर्नैवेद्यं विनिवेद्य च ॥
दद्याद्विप्राय संकल्प्य वासोलंकारभूषणैः ॥ 62 ॥
4.193.m: he should worship with fragrant flowers and, having presented food offerings, / he should resolve and give it to a vipra along with garments and ornaments,

4.193.s:
maṃtreṇānena rājendra tannibodha yathoditam ..
kṣīrodārṇavasaṃbhūta trailokyāṃgaṇadīpaka .. 63 ..
4.193.d:
मंत्रेणानेन राजेन्द्र तन्निबोध यथोदितम् ॥
क्षीरोदार्णवसंभूत त्रैलोक्यांगणदीपक ॥ 63 ॥
4.193.m: with this mantra, O lord of kings; understand it as proclaimed: / 'O you who arose from the Ocean of Milk, O lamp in the courtyard of the three worlds,

4.193.s:
umā pateḥ śiroratnaśivaṃ yaccha namonamaḥ ..
dānenānena nṛpate bhrājate caṃdravaddivi .. 64 ..
4.193.d:
उमा पतेः शिरोरत्नशिवं यच्छ नमोनमः ॥
दानेनानेन नृपते भ्राजते चंद्रवद्दिवि ॥ 64 ॥
4.193.m: O crest-jewel of the lord of Umā, bestow well-being! Homage, homage to you!' / By this gift, O king, he shines like the moon in heaven,

4.193.s: apsarobhiḥ parivṛto yāvadābhūtasaṃplavam ..65..
4.193.d: अप्सरोभिः परिवृतो यावदाभूतसंप्लवम् ॥65॥
4.193.m: surrounded by apsarases until the dissolution of all beings.

4.193.s:
dānānyamūni vidhivatprayatikrameṇa yacchaṃti ye dvijavarāya viśuddhasattvāḥ ..
te brahmaviṣṇubhuvaneṣu sukhaṃ vihṛtya yāṃtyekatāṃ saha śivena na saṃśayo me .. 66 ..
varāhadānavidhivarṇanam
4.193.d:
दानान्यमूनि विधिवत्प्रयतिक्रमेण यच्छंति ये द्विजवराय विशुद्धसत्त्वाः ॥
ते ब्रह्मविष्णुभुवनेषु सुखं विहृत्य यांत्येकतां सह शिवेन न संशयो मे ॥ 66 ॥
वराहदानविधिवर्णनम्
4.193.m:
Those whose being is pure, who duly offer these gifts in order of effort to the best of the twice-born, / having sported happily in the realms of Brahmā and Viṣṇu, go to oneness with Śiva; of this I have no doubt.
Description of the Rite of the Gift of the Boar.

4.194.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
ādivārāhadānaṃ ta kathayāmi yudhiṣṭhira ..
dharaṇyai yatpurā proktaṃ varāhavapuṣā mayā .. 1 ..
4.194.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
आदिवाराहदानं त कथयामि युधिष्ठिर ॥
धरण्यै यत्पुरा प्रोक्तं वराहवपुषा मया ॥ 1 ॥
4.194.m: The holy Kṛṣṇa said: / I will declare to you the gift of the primordial Boar, O Yudhiṣṭhira, / which was proclaimed long ago by me to the Earth in the form of a boar.

4.194.s:
puṇyaṃ pavitramāyuṣyaṃ sarva dānottamottamam ..
mahāpāpādidoṣaghnaṃ pūjitaṃ dharmasattamaiḥ.. 2..
4.194.d:
पुण्यं पवित्रमायुष्यं सर्व दानोत्तमोत्तमम् ॥
महापापादिदोषघ्नं पूजितं धर्मसत्तमैः॥ 2॥
4.194.m: It is meritorious, purifying, prolonging life, the best among all gifts, / destroying the defects of great sins and the like, revered by the best among the righteous.

4.194.s:
deyaṃ saṃkramaṇe bhānorgrahaṇe dvādaśīṣvatha..
yajñotsavavivāheṣu duḥsvapnādbhutadarśane ..3..
4.194.d:
देयं संक्रमणे भानोर्ग्रहणे द्वादशीष्वथ॥
यज्ञोत्सवविवाहेषु दुःस्वप्नाद्भुतदर्शने ॥3॥
4.194.m: It is to be given at the sun's ingress into a zodiac sign, at an eclipse, on twelfth [tithi]s, / at sacrifices, festivals, weddings, and upon seeing an ominous dream or a portent.

4.194.s:
yadā ca jāyate vittaṃ cittaṃ śraddhāsamanvitam ..
tadaiva dānakālaḥ syādadhruvaṃ jīvitaṃ yataḥ .. 4 ..
4.194.d:
यदा च जायते वित्तं चित्तं श्रद्धासमन्वितम् ॥
तदैव दानकालः स्यादध्रुवं जीवितं यतः ॥ 4 ॥
4.194.m: And whenever wealth is acquired and the mind is endowed with faith, / that very time is the occasion for giving, since life is fleeting.

4.194.s:
kurukṣetrāditīrtheṣu gaṃgādyāsu nadīṣu ca ..
pureṣu ca pavitreṣu araṇyeṣu vaneṣu ca .. 5 ..
4.194.d:
कुरुक्षेत्रादितीर्थेषु गंगाद्यासु नदीषु च ॥
पुरेषु च पवित्रेषु अरण्येषु वनेषु च ॥ 5 ॥
4.194.m: In holy sites such as Kurukṣetra, and in rivers such as the Gaṅgā, / and in holy cities, in forests, and in groves,

4.194.s:
goṣṭhe devālaye vāpi rathe vā svagṛhāṃgaṇe ..
deyaṃ purāṇavidhinā brāhmaṇāya kuṭuṃbine.. 6 ..
4.194.d:
गोष्ठे देवालये वापि रथे वा स्वगृहांगणे ॥
देयं पुराणविधिना ब्राह्मणाय कुटुंबिने॥ 6 ॥
4.194.m: or in a cowshed, in a temple, in a chariot, or in one’s own house courtyard, / it should be given according to the Purāṇic rite to a householder brāhmaṇa.

4.194.s:
kuśairāstīrya tāṃ pārtha praṇavākṣaramaṃtritaiḥ ..
upariṣṭāttilaisteṣāṃ varāhaṃ parikalpayet .. 7 ..
4.194.d:
कुशैरास्तीर्य तां पार्थ प्रणवाक्षरमंत्रितैः ॥
उपरिष्टात्तिलैस्तेषां वराहं परिकल्पयेत् ॥ 7 ॥
4.194.m: Having spread kuśa grass consecrated with the syllable Oṃ, O Pārtha, / on top of it, one should fashion a boar out of sesame seeds.

4.194.s:
drauṇaiścaturbhiḥ saṃpūrṇaṃ tadardhenātha vā punaḥ ..
āḍhakenātha kurvīta vitta śāṭhyaṃ na kārayet .. 8 ..
4.194.d:
द्रौणैश्चतुर्भिः संपूर्णं तदर्धेनाथ वा पुनः ॥
आढकेनाथ कुर्वीत वित्त शाठ्यं न कारयेत् ॥ 8 ॥
4.194.m: It should be fully made with four droṇas, or else with half of that; / or one may make it with an āḍhaka; one should not practice deceit regarding wealth.

4.194.s:
suvarṇena mukhaṃ kāryaṃ bhujau cakragadānvitau ..
rājatīṃ kārayeddaṃṣṭāṃ padmarāgavibhūṣitām .. 9 ..
4.194.d:
सुवर्णेन मुखं कार्यं भुजौ चक्रगदान्वितौ ॥
राजतीं कारयेद्दंष्टां पद्मरागविभूषिताम् ॥ 9 ॥
4.194.m: Its face should be made of gold, and its arms equipped with the discus and mace; / one should have its tusk made of silver and adorned with rubies.

4.194.s:
śaṃkhaṃ ca sthāpayetpārśve vanamālāṃ hiraṇmayīm ..
puṣpairvā kārayedvidvānpādau rūpyamayau tathā .. 4.194.10 ..
4.194.d:
शंखं च स्थापयेत्पार्श्वे वनमालां हिरण्मयीम् ॥
पुष्पैर्वा कारयेद्विद्वान्पादौ रूप्यमयौ तथा ॥ 4.194.10 ॥
4.194.m: And the wise man should place a conch at its side, and a golden forest garland, / or make it with flowers, and likewise feet of silver.

4.194.s:
daṃṣṭrāgralagnavasudhāṃ sauvarṇīṃ kārayecchubhām ..
sarvadhānyarasopetāṃ vastrālaṃkṛtavigrahām .. 11 ..
4.194.d:
दंष्ट्राग्रलग्नवसुधां सौवर्णीं कारयेच्छुभाम् ॥
सर्वधान्यरसोपेतां वस्त्रालंकृतविग्रहाम् ॥ 11 ॥
4.194.m: One should fashion an auspicious golden earth resting on the tip of its tusk, / furnished with all grains and flavours, its body adorned with garments.

4.194.s:
pracchādya vastrairdeveśaṃ varāhaṃ sarvakāmadam ..
romarājiṃ kuśaiḥ kṛtvā gaṃdhapuṣpairathārcayet .. 12 ..
4.194.d:
प्रच्छाद्य वस्त्रैर्देवेशं वराहं सर्वकामदम् ॥
रोमराजिं कुशैः कृत्वा गंधपुष्पैरथार्चयेत् ॥ 12 ॥
4.194.m: Having covered the Lord of Gods, the boar who grants all desires, with garments, / and having formed his bristles with kuśa grass, one should then worship him with fragrances and flowers.

4.194.s:
navagrahamakhaḥ kāryo homa ścātra tilaiḥ smṛtaḥ ..
evaṃ saṃsthāpya vidhivattataḥ stotramudīrayet .. 13 ..
4.194.d:
नवग्रहमखः कार्यो होम श्चात्र तिलैः स्मृतः ॥
एवं संस्थाप्य विधिवत्ततः स्तोत्रमुदीरयेत् ॥ 13 ॥
4.194.m: A sacrifice to the nine planets should be performed, and the oblation here is taught to be made with sesame seeds. / Having thus installed him according to rule, one should then utter this hymn of praise:

4.194.s:
varāheśa praduṣṭāni sarvapāpaphalāni ca ..
marddamardda mahādaṃṣṭra bhāsvatkana kakuṃḍala .. 14 ..
4.194.d:
वराहेश प्रदुष्टानि सर्वपापफलानि च ॥
मर्द्दमर्द्द महादंष्ट्र भास्वत्कन ककुंडल ॥ 14 ॥
4.194.m: “O Boar Lord, crush, crush the wicked fruits / of all my sins, O great-tusked one, wearing radiant golden earrings!

4.194.s:
śaṃkhacakrāsihastāya hiraṇyākṣāṃtakāya ca ..
daṃṣṭroddhṛtadharābhṛte trayīmūrtimate namaḥ .. 15 ..
4.194.d:
शंखचक्रासिहस्ताय हिरण्याक्षांतकाय च ॥
दंष्ट्रोद्धृतधराभृते त्रयीमूर्तिमते नमः ॥ 15 ॥
4.194.m: Homage to the one whose hands bear the conch, discus, and sword, who slew Hiraṇyākṣa, / who lifted up the mountain-bearing earth with his tusk, whose form is the three Vedas!”

4.194.s:
ityuccārya namaskṛtya pradakṣiṇamanu vrajet ..
tatastaṃ brāhmaṇe dadyādvastrālaṃkārabhūṣitam .. .. 16..
4.194.d:
इत्युच्चार्य नमस्कृत्य प्रदक्षिणमनु व्रजेत् ॥
ततस्तं ब्राह्मणे दद्याद्वस्त्रालंकारभूषितम् ॥ ॥ 16॥
4.194.m: Having spoken thus and bowed down, he should walk in circumambulation. / Then he should give it to a brāhmaṇa, adorned with garments and ornaments.

4.194.s:
prarigrahastu tasyoktaḥ pādayoḥ paramarṣibhiḥ ..
anena vidhinā dattvā praṇipatya kṣamā payet .. 17 ..
4.194.d:
प्ररिग्रहस्तु तस्योक्तः पादयोः परमर्षिभिः ॥
अनेन विधिना दत्त्वा प्रणिपत्य क्षमा पयेत् ॥ 17 ॥
4.194.m: The highest sages say that the reception of it [must be taken] by the feet. / Having given it according to this rite, one should bow down and ask for forgiveness.

4.194.s:
evaṃ dattvā mahīnātha varāhaṃ sarvakāmadam ..
yatphalaṃ samavāpnoti pārtha tatkena varṇyate .. 18 ..
4.194.d:
एवं दत्त्वा महीनाथ वराहं सर्वकामदम् ॥
यत्फलं समवाप्नोति पार्थ तत्केन वर्ण्यते ॥ 18 ॥
4.194.m: Having given the boar that fulfills all desires in this manner, O lord of the earth, / what reward one attains, O Pārtha, by whom can that be described?

4.194.s:
sarvadāneṣu yatpuṇyaṃ sarvakratuṣu yatphalam..
tatphalaṃ samavāpnoti dattvā devaṃ janārdanam.. 19 ..
4.194.d:
सर्वदानेषु यत्पुण्यं सर्वक्रतुषु यत्फलम्॥
तत्फलं समवाप्नोति दत्त्वा देवं जनार्दनम्॥ 19 ॥
4.194.m: Whatever merit is found in all donations, whatever reward in all sacrifices, / that reward one attains by giving the divine Janārdana.

4.194.s:
yathāśaktyā samuddhṛtā varāheṇa vasuṃdharā..
yathākulaṃ samuddhatya viṣṇuloke mahīyate. ... 4.194.20 ..
4.194.d:
यथाशक्त्या समुद्धृता वराहेण वसुंधरा॥
यथाकुलं समुद्धत्य विष्णुलोके महीयते॥॥ 4.194.20 ॥
4.194.m: Just as the earth was lifted up according to power by the Boar, / so having lifted up his family, he is glorified in the world of Viṣṇu.

4.194.s:
brāhmaṇakṣatriyaviśāṃ strīṇāṃ śūdrajanasya ca ..
etatsādhāraṇaṃ dānaṃ śaivavaiṣṇavayoginām .. 21 ..
4.194.d:
ब्राह्मणक्षत्रियविशां स्त्रीणां शूद्रजनस्य च ॥
एतत्साधारणं दानं शैववैष्णवयोगिनाम् ॥ 21 ॥
4.194.m: For brāhmaṇas, kṣatriyas, vaiśyas, women, and śūdras, / and for Śaiva, Vaiṣṇava, and yogin practitioners, this gift is common to all.

4.194.s:
viprāya vedaviduṣe nṛvarāharūpaṃ dattvā tilāmalasuvarṇamayaṃ savastram ..
uddhṛtya pūrvapuruṣānsakalatramitraḥ prāpnoti siddhabhuvanaṃ surasiddhajuṣṭam .. 22 .. ..
dhānyaparvatadānavidhivarṇanam
4.194.d:
विप्राय वेदविदुषे नृवराहरूपं दत्त्वा तिलामलसुवर्णमयं सवस्त्रम् ॥
उद्धृत्य पूर्वपुरुषान्सकलत्रमित्रः प्राप्नोति सिद्धभुवनं सुरसिद्धजुष्टम् ॥ 22 ॥ ॥
धान्यपर्वतदानविधिवर्णनम्
4.194.m:
Having given to a brāhmaṇa who knows the Vedas this form of the Man-Boar, made of flawless sesame seeds and gold, together with garments, / one lifts up one's ancestors and, along with wife and friends, attains the realm of the perfected ones, frequented by gods and siddhas.
Description of the rite of donating the grain mountain
